**śruta-pradīpikā**—
** ॥śrīḥ॥ **

** śrīmatē rāmānujāya namaḥ । **

**śrīsudarśanabhaṭṭārakaviracitā śrībhāṣyavyākhyā **

** śrutapradīpikā । **

** ------------------**

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
śrīḥ॥   
śrīmatē vātsya varadāryamahādēśikāya namaḥ ।  
yatīndrakr̥tabhāṣyārthā   
yadvyākhyānēna darśitāḥ ।  
varaṁ (vyāsaṁ) sudarśanāryaṁ taṁ  
vandē kūrakulādhipam ॥ 

śrīmatsudarśana sūriviracitā ṭīkā śrutaprakāśikā ॥ 

# +1 samanvayaḥ

## +1 ayōga-vyavacchēdaḥ

**prathamādhyāyē prathamaḥ pādaḥ ॥**

**śruta-pradīpikā**—
varadaṁ dviradādriśēkharaṁ  
kamalāyā dayitaṁ dayānidhim ।  
sakalārthijanārthitapradaṁ  
praṇamāmi praṇatārtihāriṇam ॥

**śruta-pradīpikā**—
vēdānta-sūtra-bhāṣyārtham  
ācāryōpāsanāc chr̥tam ।  
tad-girā dīpikēvāhaṁ  
darśayiṣyē yathāmati ॥

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
varadaṁ dviradādrāśaṁ  
śrī-nidhiṁ karuṇānidhim ।  
śaraṇyaṁ **śaraṇaṁ yāmi**  
praṇatārttiharaṁ harim ॥ 1 ॥

**vīrarāghavaḥ**—
śrīḥ  
vātsya-vīrarāghavācāryakr̥tā sudarśanasēvā॥ 

śrībhāṣyakāra-vēdānta-  
dēśikādy-ujjvalāṁ bhajē ।  
gurupaṅktiṁ ramēśādyāṁ  
raṅga-rāmānujāntimām ॥  

adbhutajñānavikhyāta-  
varadārya-dayā-vaśam ।  
vyāsaṁ sudarśanāryaṁ taṁ  
sudarśana-samaṁ śrayē ॥ 

1 varadamiti ।  
varadaṁ dviradādrīśaṁ śrīnidhiṁ karuṇānidhiṁ praṇatārtiharam  
iti tatratya-pañca-bēra-vivakṣayēti sampradāyavidaḥ ।  
varadam iti svācāryō'py anu-sandhīyatē ।  
dviradādri-śikhara ēva vēdānta-pravacanaṁ tat-kr̥taṁ sva-śrutañcēti jñāpanāya  
dviradādrīśam ityapi tadviśēṣaṇam ।  
ata ēva svaśrīraṅganāthāpēkṣayā'pyasya prathamanirdēśaḥ । 

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
bahirar antas tamaś-chēdi  
jyōtir **vandē** sudarśanam ।  
yēnāvyāhata-saṅkalpaṁ  
vastu lakṣmīdharaṁ viduḥ ॥ 2 ॥

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
samyaṅ nyāya-kalāpēna  
mahatā bhāratēna ca ।  
**upabr̥ṁhita**-vēdāya  
**namō** vyāsāya viṣṇavē ॥ 3 ॥

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
tasmai rāmānujāryāya  
namaḥ paramayōginē ।  
yaḥ śruti-smr̥ti-sūtrāṇām  
antar jvaram **aśīśamat** ॥ 4 ॥

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
**vandē** 'haṁ varadāryaṁ taṁ  
vatsābhijana-bhūṣaṇam ।  
bhāṣyāmr̥ta-**pradānād** yaḥ  
**sañjīvayati** māmapi ॥ 5 ॥

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
**prapadyē** praṇavākāraṁ  
bhāṣyaṁ raṅgam ivāparam ।  
parasya brahmaṇō yatra  
śēṣitvaṁ sphuṭam **īkṣyatē** ॥ 6 ॥+++(5)+++

**vīrarāghavaḥ**—
2 praṇavākāramiti ।  
raṅga-vimānasya praṇavākāratvaṁ prasiddham ।  
tatra śēṣitvaṁ - śēṣa-śāyitvam īkṣyatē ।  
śrībhāṣya akārōpakramāta makārēṇōpasaṁhārāt  
prathamādhyāya-caturtha-pādārambha-gata--u-kāra-madhyamatvāc ca **praṇavākāram** ।  
praṇava ivātra jīva-parayōḥ śēṣa-śēṣi-bhāvaḥ  
nārāyaṇē sarva-śēṣitvaṁ sphuṭamīkṣyatē । 

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
śrutyantēṣu **śrutaṁ** bhāṣyē  
**mataṁ dhyātaṁ** hr̥dam-bujē ।  
lakṣmīpatiṁ **prapadyē** 'haṁ  
dr̥ṣṭaṁ śrīraṅgadhāmani ॥ 7 ॥

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
pramāṇaṁ ca pramēyaṁ ca  
pramātāraś ca sāttvikāḥ ।  
**jayantu** kṣapitāriṣṭaṁ  
saha sarvatra sarvadā ॥ 8 ॥

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
a-vistr̥tāḥ su-gambhīrā  
rāmānuja-munēr giraḥ ।  
**darśayantu** prasādēna  
svaṁ bhāvam akhilaṁ dr̥ḍham ॥ 9 ॥

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
śrīraṅgēśājñayā labdha-  
vyāsa-sañjñaṁ sudarśanam ।  
vācō vijayinaḥ+++(=vāgvijaya-bhaṭṭasya)+++ putraṁ  
bhāṣya-bhaktir **acūcudat** ॥ 10 ॥

**vīrarāghavaḥ**—
3 mahācāryavaṁśyakr̥tē śrīvēdānta-dēśika-vaibhava-prakāśikā-viśēṣē,  
śrīrāmap-pillai ityāhvaya-vēdavyāsabhaṭṭa-pautraḥ  
'nāvālvēnān' ity-āhvayasya putraḥ  
śrīsudarśanācāryaḥ  
śrīmad-vātsya-varadācārya-śiṣyēṣv anyatama ityuktam । 

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
gurubhyō'rthaḥ **śrutaḥ**, śabdais  
tat-prayuktaiś ca **yōjitaḥ** ।  
saukaryāya **babhutsūnāṁ**  
**saṅkalayya prakāśyatē** ॥ 11 ॥

**vīrarāghavaḥ**—
1 yōjita iti । asmadvyākhyayā pratipādyamānaḥ gurubhyaḥ śrutō'rthaḥ upadēśakālē tairivēhāpi tatprayuktaśabdayōgaṁ lambhitaḥ । tacchabdānāmapi yathārha svavākyē ghaṭanaṁ kriyata iti yāvat । saṅkalayyēti । anēkādhyāpanā''vr̥ttyavasarēṣu prōktā arthā vibhinnāḥ yathāī paurvāparyakalpanayā'tra samāhiyanta ityuktaṁ bhavati । 

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
kaḥ kr̥tsnaṁ **vētti** bhāṣyārthaṁ  
śrutāṁśa-sthitayē kr̥tiḥ ।  
āḍhyaiḥ kākaṇikēvaiṣā  
**nōpēkṣyā** bhāṣya-vittamaiḥ ॥12 ॥ +++(4)+++

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
bhāṣyaṁ cēd **vyavr̥ṇōt** svayaṁ yati-patir, vyākhyāna-vācāṁ tathā  
gāmbhīryād **anavasthitir** mita-matir dūrē janas tad-girām ।  
**praṣṭavyaḥ** katham īśvaraḥ sa hi na naḥ pratyakṣa-rūpō dr̥śāṁ  
tad bhāṣyaṁ sa ca bhāṣya-kr̥t sa ca hariḥ samyak **prasīdantu** naḥ ॥ 13 ॥

**śruta-prakāśikā - bhāṣyakāra-prēraṇā**—
sarvēṣāṁ puruṣāṇāṁ pramāṇādhīna-pramēya-niścayānām  
upāditsita-jihāsitēṣṭāniṣṭa--tat-sādhanānām  

a-laukika-puruṣārthē tat-sādhana-rūpē ca vastuni śabdaika-samadhigamyē,  

tatrāpy a-puruṣa-śēmuṣī-dōṣa-maṣī-mālinyasya vēdākhyākṣara-rāśēr ēva  
pradhānataḥ pramāṇatayā āśrayaṇīyatvē siddhē,  

tatra ca paśu-putra-vr̥ṣṭy-anna-svargādy-aihikāmuṣmikārvācīna-phala--tat-sādhana-parē 'vagatē pūrvabhāgē +++(sati)+++,  
parama-puruṣārthāvabōdhakē ca tad-uparibhāgē, 

pūrvācāryābhimata-mukti-ghaṇṭā-patha-kaṇṭakāyamāna-  
vividha--ku-dr̥ṣṭi-jana--dur-vacana--**śatōpaplutē**,  
tad-upadarśita--ku-patha-pravr̥rttini jagati ca **mōmuhyamānē**,  

**vīrarāghavaḥ**—
2 kupathēti । nātra pathinśabdaḥ; kāpathētyāpātāt । kintu pathaśabda ēvākārānta iti bhāvaprakāśikā । kuśabdō bhūmivācī san adhōlōkaparō vā । ataḥ kupathaḥ adhōgatiḥ । pāṭhāntaraṁ mr̥gyam 

tad-ujjijīvayiṣayā sad--a-sad-vivēcana-catura-pūrvācāryaparicitaṁ  
prācīnam ēva samīcīnam adhvānaṁ **niṣkaṇṭakī kr̥tya**  
parama-puruṣārthābhyarthi-jana-sārthaṁ **kr̥tārthayituṁ**  

bhava-bhayābhitapta-jana--bhāga-dhēya--vaibhava-bhāvitāvataraṇēna  
parama-kāruṇikēna bhagavatā bhāṣya-kārēṇa  
śārīraka-śāstraṁ **vyācikhyāsitam** । 

**vīrarāghavaḥ**—
3 bhāṣyakārēṇēti bhāvinīṁ vr̥ttimāśritya ; vyākhyākārakālē tattvasya siddhatvādvā । bhagavadrāmānujamuninēti yāvat । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - ārṣa-vacana-grahaṇam**—
parama-rṣi-praṇītāni vyākhyēyāni,  
tēṣāṁ ca maharṣi-praṇītāni vyākhyānāni ca **santi** cēt  
tāny **ēvānurōddhavyāni** ।  
na hy an-r̥ṣēḥ sūkṣma-darśitvam,  
r̥ṣēr abhiprāyam r̥ṣirēva svatō **vēditum arhati**  
na tu jaḍamatir itarō janaḥ । 

r̥ṣi-vacasām ēvābhinna-vaktr̥kāṇāṁ mithō **virōdhē**  
pūrva-pakṣābhiprāya--vaibhava-vādādibhir **avirōdhō nēyaḥ** ।  
bhinna-vaktr̥kāṇāṁ tu virōdhē duṣ-pariharē  
"yukti-yuktaṁ grāhyam" iti na dōṣaḥ ।  

yē punaḥ **santy** api  
tāny **anādr̥tya**  
vyākhyēyāntarāṇi vyākhyānāntarāṇi ca tad-viruddhāni rucayanti  
tēṣām āgraha-gr̥hīta-hr̥dayatvē paṇḍita-mānitvē pāṇḍitya-khyāpana-paratvē ca  
tat-pravr̥ttir ēva pramāṇam ।  

itarēṣāṁ ca vyākhyātr̥̄ṇām ārṣa-vyākhyānātilaṅghitvam  

> "upāsātraividhyāt"  
'sarvatra prasiddhōpadēśāt'  
"bhūmāsamprasādādadhyupadēśāt'  
"dahara uttarēbhyaḥ' 

ity-ādiṣu spaṣṭataram।  
iha tu vr̥ttyanusāraḥ pratijñātaḥ । 

na ca "tatpratijñānam a-hr̥dayam" iti śaṅkanīyam;  
duṣ-parihara-bādhakānupalambhāt ।  

**śruta-prakāśikā - brahma-sūtray ārambhaḥ**—
yady api karma-mīmāṁsāyāṁ ca  
kvacit kvacid arvācīna-vyākhyātr̥bhir **ākulatvam āpāditam**,  
tathāpi tatra prayōga-mārgē **skhalanābhāvād**  
anuṣṭhāna-mātrādhīnāyāḥ svargādi-phala-siddhēr  
dēvatā--sva-rūpa--tad-yāthātmya--sat-kārya-vādādi-jñāna-**nairapēkṣyam**,  

parama-puruṣārthasya jñānaikasādhyatayā  
jñāna-mārga-skhalanasyā''tmahāni-phalakatvēna   
tad-viparīta-jñānānām avaśya-**parihartavyatvam**,  

uttara-bhāgē ca tat-tad-arthaupayikatayā prasaktānāṁ  
pūrva-bhāgārthānāṁ **śikṣaṇīyatvam**,  

pradarśitayaiva diśā  
an-uktānām api śikṣaṇīyārthāntarāṇāṁ su-kara-**nirvāhatvaṁ cābhiprētya**  

brahma-sūtrāṇy ēva  
bhagavān bhāṣya-kāraḥ **prārabhatē vivarītum** ॥ 

### śāstrārthasūcanagarbhitaṁ maṅgalācaraṇam

**vi॰pra॰**—
a-khila-bhuvana-janma-sthēma-bhaṅgādi-līlē  
vinata-vividha-bhūta-vrāta-rakṣaika-dīkṣē ।  
śruti-śirasi vidīptē brahmaṇi śrī-nivāsē  
**bhavatu** mama parasmin śēmuṣī+++(=jñānam)+++ bhakti+++(→smr̥ti-viśēṣa)+++-rūpā ॥

**viśvāsa-ṭippanī**—
brahmasūtragata-śabdā atra prayuktāḥ prāyēṇa - śrīnivāsa-śabdādīn vihāya।  
akārāt prārabdhavyam, makārē samāpanīyam, madhya ukāras syād iti prayukta akhila-śabdō nikhila-sthānē।  
punaḥ sakala-śabdaḥ prāyikārthacchāyāvān iti varjitaḥ। 

prathama-pādē prathama-dvitīyādhyāyārthō jagat-kāraṇatvam abādhitam।  
dvitīyē pādē tr̥tīyādhyāyārtha upāyatvam।  
tr̥tīyē pāday upēyatvam।  
caturthē śāṅkarōkta-śāstra-janya-jñāna-mātrād vyāvartanam,  
tr̥tīyē ca prāpyasya cēśvaratvēnōktatvād vyāvartanam ।  

**Thibaut**—
MAY my mind be filled with devotion towards the highest Brahman, the abode of Lakshmi who is luminously revealed in the Upanishads; who in sport produces, sustains, and reabsorbs the entire Universe; whose only aim is to foster the manifold classes of beings that humbly worship him.

**śruta-pradīpikā**—
prāripsitaprabandhasyāvighnaparisamāptipracayagamanārthamiṣṭadēvatōpāsanalakṣaṇamaṅgalaṁ śrutyākurvannarthaṁ pratipādyaṁ saṅkṣēpataḥ śrōtr̥buddhisamavadhānāya darśayati - akhilēti । prathamēna pādēna prathamadvikārthasaṅkṣēpaḥ, dvitīyēna tūttarasya । bhavatīti bhuvanaṁ kāryajātam । katipayakāraṇacaturmukhādivyāvr̥ttyartham akhila śabdaḥ । prāyikatvanivr̥ttyarthaṁ sakalētya nuktiḥ । ajñātaṁ nāsti itivadakhilēti vyatirēkōktiḥ । akārōpakramatvasiddhayē nikhilētyanuktiḥ । tasya bhagavadvācakatvaśaktiyōgāttadavivakṣāyāmapi māṅgalikatvamakārasya । nañō maṅgalētaratvaṁ niṣēdhyaviśēṣāpēkṣayā, na svataḥ । atra tu vaikalyaniṣēdhēna pauṣkalyaparatvāt māṅgalikatvamēva । janma trividham । sthēmā - antaryāmiviṣṇvavatārādimukhēnaiva karaṇīyā vividhā sthitiḥ । bhaṅgaḥ - nityanaimittikaprākr̥tarūpaḥ । mōkṣasya layāntarbhāvē'pi śāstrasya pradhānaprayōjanatayā viṣayavat pr̥thagēva vaktavyatvādanēkārthasādhāraṇēna śabdēna tamantarbhāvayitumayuktam । atō hi pūrvācāryāḥ pr̥thagūcuḥ - jagajjanmasthitidhvaṁsamahānandaikahētavē jagadudbhavasthitipraṇāśa- saṁsāravimōcanādayaḥ iti । ādi śabdēnānupravēśaniyamanadhāraṇādi gr̥hyatē ; pradēśāntarē jagadutpattisthitisaṁhārāntaḥ pravēśaniyamanādilīlam iti svēnaiva kaṇṭharavēṇōktārthasvīkārasyaivōcitatvāt । apramēyō'niyōjyaśca ityādyuktaprakārēṇa sāpēkṣatvādivyudāsāya līlā śabdaḥ । janayitr̥tvādyanuktvā janmādyuktirupādānābhiprāyā ; bahu syāṁ prajāyēyēti iti hi śrutiḥ । līlā śabdēna nimittatvaṁ dyōtitam । avāptasamastakāmasya vyāpārānupapatiṁta pariharatānēna līlāśabdēna dvitīyalakṣaṇārthaśca sūcitaḥ । atha dvitīyadvikārthaṁ saṅkṣipati - vinatēti । vinatarakṣāpa dābhyāṁ tr̥tīyacaturthalakṣaṇārthau sūcitau । viśēṣēṇa natāḥ prahvībhūtāḥ upāsakāḥ ; tadvaividhyaṁ taduparyapi bādarāyaṇaḥ sambhavāt ityādivakṣyamāṇaprakārēṇa । bhūtāḥ ; bhagavajjñānēna labdhasattākāḥ iti bhāvaḥ ; asti brahmēti cēdvēda, santamēnaṁ tatō viduriti iti śrutēḥ । vinatabhūtasambandhī vrātō vinatabhūtavrātaḥ । vrāta śabdēna āsphōṭayanti pitaraḥ paśurmanuṣyaḥ pakṣī vā ityādyarthō'bhiprētaḥ । rakṣā iṣṭaprāpaṇāniṣṭanivāraṇalakṣaṇā । ēka śabdaḥ prādhānyaparaḥ apyahaṁ jīvitaṁ jahyāṁ kāmamātmānaṁ bhāryāmputraṁ vōparundhyānna tvēva dāsakarmakaram iti hyuktam । sā pradhānā dīkṣā yasya tattathōktam । dīkṣā- śabdēnāvarjanīyatvaṁ garbhitam; ētadvrataṁ mama iti hi taduktiḥ ।

atha śāstrōpōddhātacatuḥsūtryarthamāha - śrutīti । brahmaṇō mānaśūnyatvānyamānakatvavyudāsēna śāstrārambhaṇīyatā hi tadarthaḥ । śruti śabdaḥ pramāṇavailakṣaṇyaṁ dyōtayati ; śrūyatē nityamiti hi śrutiḥ । śiraḥ śabdēnānanyaparabhāgōktiḥ । vidīptiḥ viśēṣēṇa dīptiḥ ; agnyādirūpēṇakarmārādhyatāyā api vēdāntāvagatatvaṁ brahmaṇaḥ svatō'nantapuruṣārthatvaṁ cābhiprētya viśēṣēṇa

dīptatvamuktam । brahmaṇīti sāmānyaśabdaḥ । śrīnivāsa iti viśēṣaśabdaḥ । atra chāgō vā mantravarṇāt iti nyāyō'bhiprētaḥ । śrīnivāsa śabdēna rūḍhitō'vayavataśca trimūrtyaikyasāmyōttīrṇatvādivyudāsō nityavibhūtiyōgaśca phalitaḥ । parasminniti paramataḥ sētūnmāna ityatra nirṇītaṁ prāpyatvaṁ vivakṣitam । athōpāyōpēyātmakē pratipādyē vinatapadasūcitamupāyāṁśaṁ viśinaṣṭi - śēmuṣī bhaktirūpēti । atrāpi chāgapaśunyāyō'bhiprētaḥ । padadvayēna dhīkarmasamuccayavākyārthajñānamātrōpāyatvavyudāsaḥ । svanikarṣābhiprāyēṇāha - mamēti ।

bhavatu - phalāntarādētadviṣayōpāyaḥ svādutama iti bhāvaḥ ।

ēvaṁ paramaviṣayō darśitaḥ । prayōjanaṁ cātrātisaṅkṣiptam ।  
atha svagranthasyāvāntaraviṣayaṁ svavyākhyēyasya vyākhyēyāntarād vaiṣamyaṁ ca vadan  
saṅkṣiptaṁ śāstraprayōjanaṁ ca viśadīkurvan  
vyākhyānāntarēbhyaḥ svagranthasya vailakṣaṇyaṁ ca darśayann  
arthāt gurūpāsanarūpaṁ maṅgalamācarati - pārāśaryēti ।

**śruta-prakāśikā - vighnavāraṇam**—
ēvaṁ prāripsitasya prabandhasyāvidhnaparisamāpti-pracaya-gamanārthaṁ  
smr̥tyācāra-siddham iṣṭa-dēvatōpāsana-rūpaṁ maṅgalaṁ śrautam ācarati -  
akhilētyādinā ślōkēna ।

> maṅgalācārayuktānāṁ  
> nityaṁ ca prayatātmanām ।  
> japatāṁ juhvatāṁ caiva  
> **vinipātō na vidyatē** ॥

iti hi smaryatē ।

**vīrarāghavaḥ**—
1 smaryata iti । maṅgalācārapadamaviśēṣāt ādarśadarśanādinityakarmaṇaḥ kāyikakāryārambhakartavyaviṣvaksēnārādhānādēḥ vācikavyāpārātmakagranthārambhakartavyavācika dēvatānamaskriyādimaṅgalasya ca vācakam । na tu tattvacintāmaṇyuktarītyā ādarśadarśanāthācāramātraparam ; sarvasya prāmāṇikatvēnānuṣādasambhavāditi bhāvaḥ । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - saṅkṣēpaḥ**—
**ācāryatē** ca tat-tat-prabanddhr̥bhiḥ,  
śrōtr̥-buddhi-manas-samādhānārthaṁ śāstrārtha-**saṅkṣēpaś** cārthataḥ kriyatē ।  
yathā cōdanāsūtrēṇa dharma-svarūpaṁ pramāṇañ ca śruty-arthābhyāṁ nirūpitam ।  
prasiddhaṁ hi śrōtuḥ pratipatti-saukaryāya  
vaktur artha-pratipādanasya saṅkṣēpa-pūrvakatvam ।

> iṣṭaṁ hi viduṣāṁ lōkē  
> samāsa-vyāsa-dhāraṇam  

iti "śāstrārtha-saṅkṣēpēṇa vastunirdēśō bhavatv"  
ity-āśīrvādaś ca kr̥tau bhavataḥ ।

**śruta-prakāśikā - vinata**—
"vinatēti' "bhaktirūpē'ti ca brahmaṇi prahvībhāvāvagamāt  
praṇatir api phalitā ।  
ṇamu prahvatvē iti hi dhātuḥ ।  
ēvaṁ trividhaṁ maṅgalamācaritaṁ bhavati ।

**śruta-prakāśikā - adhyāya-dvikau**—
ślōkasya prathamapādēna pūrvasyādhyāyadvikasyārthaḥ saṅkṣiptaḥ । dvitīyēna tūttaradvikasya ।  
karmamīmāṁsāyāṁ pratipādya-bhēdēna ṣaṭka-bhēdavad  
atrāpi viṣaya-viṣayi-rūpa-pratipādya-bhēdēna dvika-bhēdaḥ ।  
śāstra-pratipādyam upāyōpēyātmakaṁ siddhōpāya upēyañca brahma ।  
sādhyōpāyō bhaktiḥ ।

**brahma-bhuvanē**—
tatra saptamy-antaiḥ padaiḥ  
siddhōpāya-rūpam upēyañ ca brahmōcyatē ।  

bhavatīti bhuvanaṁ kārya-vargaḥ ।  
rūḍhi-śaktyā tat-kāraṇasya kulālāditō vyāvr̥ttiḥ ।  
bhuvana-śabdō hi vipulatara-kārya-viśēṣē rūḍhaḥ । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - akhila**—
akhilaśabdēna sarvadēśasarvakālavartīnyaṇḍajātāni vivakṣitāni tēna brahmādi-vyāvr̥ttiḥ ।  
khilaṁ nāstītyakhilaṁ  
kāryēṣu brahmaṇaḥ sr̥ṣṭy-ādi-vyāpārāviṣaya-bhūtaṁ  
na kiñcid ity arthaḥ ।  
anayā vyatirēkōktyā prāyikatvanivr̥ttiḥ ।  
"ajñātaṁ nāsti tē kiñcidi'tivat ।  
ataḥ _sakalam_ ity anvayamukhēnānuktiḥ ।

akārōpakramatvasiddhayē nikhilētyanuktiḥ ।  
"a" iti bhagavatō nārāyaṇasya prathamābhidhānaṁ bhagavatō vācakam,  

> akāraṁ prayuñjānēna  
> kin nāma maṅgalaṁ na kr̥tam 

iti cābhiyuktairabhyadhāyi ।  
atra bhagavad-vācitvāvivakṣāyām api  
bhagavad-vācakatva-śakti-yōgād  
a-kārō māṅgalikaḥ +++(4)+++  
"aiuṇ" ityatrākāravat । 

**vīrarāghavaḥ**—
1 a iti bhagavata iti vākyaṁ bhartr̥harigranthastham ;  
granthaśca mahābhāṣyapradīpikā ।  
vākyamidaṁ bhāṣyē athaśabdānuśāsanamiti akāram,  
aiuṇ iti akāranābhipratītyapi manyantē ।  
'aiuṇ' ityatrākāravat iti samanantaravākyam  
atra ṭīkāyām akṣara-samāmnāya-akāra-grahaṇa-bādhakamiva । 

nañō niṣēdha-vācitvē'pi -  
niṣēdhya-vaśāc chubhatvāśubhatvē,  
atō 'niṣ-pratyūham upāsmaha' ity-ādi-nirdēśasyēva śubhataratvaṁ,  
vaikalya-niṣēdhēna pauṣkalya-paratvāt ।  

+++(bahutvasya bhēdagarbhatayā)+++ akhila-śabdēna cid-acid-bhēdō'py abhiprētaḥ । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - janma-sthēma-bhaṅgāḥ**—
"janma' nityanaimittika-prākr̥tarūpaṁ,  

1"sthēmā' sthitiḥ ।  
sā cāntaryāmi-viṣṇv-avatāra-  
lōkapāla-manvādi-nr̥pa-  
mātā-pitrādi-mukhēna kriyamāṇā bahuvidhāvivakṣitā ।  

"bhaṅgaḥ' । nitya-naimittika-prākr̥tarūpaḥ+++(=??)+++ ।  
mōkṣasya layāntarbhavē 'pi  
śāstrasya paramaprayōjanatvādatra sa nāntarbhāvitaḥ ।  
ata ēvādi-śabdē'pi nāntarbhāvyaḥ ।  
tasya sādhāraṇatayā sphuṭa-pratipatti-hētutvābhāvāt ।  

pr̥thag ēva hi pūrvaś ca spaṣṭataraṁ nirdiṣṭō mōkṣaḥ +++(rakṣā-padēna)+++।  
"jagad-udbhava-sthiti-praṇāśa--saṁsāra-vimōcanādayaḥ' iti ,  
"jagaj-janma-sthiti-dhvaṁsa--mahānandaika-hētava' iti ca bhagavān bhāṣyakāraśca tathā nirdiśati ।  
yathā vēdārthasaṅgrahē "udbhavasthitipralaya--saṁsāra-nivarttanaikahētubhūta' iti,  
bhāṣyē ca "nikhilagajad-udaya-vibhava-laya--mahānandaikakāraṇa'miti।  

'vinatē'ty-ādi-padēna sthēmāntarbhūta-svargādi-saṁsārika-phala-pradatvasya pr̥thag-uktir an-apēkṣitā ।  
śāstrāsādhāraṇasya parama-prayōjanasya mōkṣasyaiva hi pr̥thag-ukty-apēkṣā ।  

**śruta-prakāśikā - maṅgalācaraṇa-bhāṣyatā**—
> nanu, 
> 
>> "sūtrārthō varṇyatē yatra  
> vākyaiḥ sūtrānukāribhiḥ ।  
> svapadāni ca varṇyantē  
> bhāṣyaṁ bhāṣyavidō viduḥ " 
> 
> iti hi bhāṣyalakṣaṇam ।  
> 
> ataḥ sūtra-vyākhyāna-rūpatvābhāvād  
> akhilētyādikaṁ na bhāṣyāntarbhāvi

iti cēn na –  

sūtra-tātparyārtha-paratvāt bhāṣyāntarbhāvy ēva ।  
sūtratātparyārtha-paratvaṁ ca ślōka-vyākhyānē spaṣṭam ।  

kiñca maṅgalācaraṇaṁ prāripsitagranthāvighna-parisamāptyādy-arthatayā  
tad-upayōgīti tadantarbhāvy ēva ॥ 

**śruta-prakāśikā - maṅgalācaraṇa-yōgyatā**—
> śābara-śāṅkarādi-bhāṣyēṣu namaskārādarśanād  
atra namaskāra-kathanam ayuktam 

iti cēn na;  

"namaḥ pravaraguṇaikāspadāya"  
iti dramiḍabhāṣyē dēvatā-guru-namas-kāra śravaṇāt ।  
śābara-śāṅkarayōs tu  
īśvarānabhyupagamāt jīva-brahma-bhēdānabhyupagamāc ca namasyānādaraḥ ।  

atra tu siddhāntānurūpyāt  
namasyā atyantōpapannā ।  
śāṅkaragranthōpakramē ca  
vyākhyātr̥bhir namas-kārādy-abhāvāt ku-granthatvam āśaṅkaya,  
yuṣmad-ity-ādi-granthēna pratyag-arthānusandhānēnārthān maṅgalācāraḥ kr̥taḥ iti parihr̥tam । 

### bhāṣyapraṇayanaprayōjanam

**vi॰pra॰**—
pārāśarya+++(=vyāsa)+++-vacas-sudhām upaniṣad-dugdhābdhi-madhyōddhr̥tāṁ  
saṁsārāgni-vidīpana--vyapagata-prāṇa+++(→brahma-sambandha)++++ātma--sañjīvanīm ।  
pūrvācārya-surakṣitāṁ bahu-mati-+++(paraspara-)+++vyāghāta-dūrasthitām  
+++(gāyatryā'mr̥tam iva)+++ ānītāṁ tu nijākṣaraiḥ +++(na tu svābhiprāyārōpaṇēna)+++ su-manasō bhaumāḥ +++(santō'mr̥ta-vañcitā api)+++ **pibantv** anvaham +++(na tv amr̥tavat sakr̥t)+++ ॥

**Thibaut**—
The nectar of the teaching of Parāsara's son (Vyāsa),--which was brought up from the middle of the milk-ocean of the Upanishads – which restores to life the souls whose vital strength had departed owing to the heat of the fire of transmigratory existence – which was well guarded by the teachers of old – which was obscured by the mutual conflict of manifold opinions,--may intelligent men daily enjoy that as it is now presented to them in my words.

**śruta-pradīpikā**—
vyāsasyaiva bādarāyaṇatvaṁ śrutisiddham । janmataḥ prakarṣaṁ ca sūcayati pārāśaryaśabdēna । vacaḥ- śabdō'rthaparyantaḥ, vēdavit ityatra vēdaśabdavat । vacasaḥ sudhāmiti nirvāhē rūpakaprakaraṇānaucityaṁ sudhāśabdāmukhyatvaṁ ca । amr̥tatvahētutvāt sudhātvarūpaṇam । pūrvabhāgādapyavyavadhānēna brahmapratipādanarūpā sētyabhiprāya upaniṣa cchabdaḥ । upaniṣadāṁ vēdasāratvābhiprāyō dugdhaśabdaḥ ; yathā āraṅkaṁ ca vēdēbhya ōṣadhībhyō yathāmr̥tam iti । abdhi śabda ānantyaparaḥ । madhya śabdēna sarvaśrutimukhyatvamabhiprētam, madhyasya sarvapradēśānuguṇyāt । anēna svavyākhyēyasya pramāṇamūlatā avāntaraviṣayaśca darśitau । uddhr̥taśabdēnātinimnadēśanimagnōdgrahaṇamabhidadhatā niḥśēṣārthagrahaṇaṁ sūcitam । parama prayōjanamāha - saṁsārēti । saṁsārasyāgnitvaṁ tāpatrayātmakatayā । tatrāpyavāntarabhēdaṁ vidyālabdhēḥ pūrvaṁ kadācidapyanirvāpyatvaṁ vaividhyamanuparatatvaṁ ca dyōtayati vidīpana śabdaḥ । anādikālaṁ bahumukhaśravaṇādiṣvanyatamaprakārēṇālabdhaparamātmānō vyapagataprāṇāḥ । prāṇāḥ paramātmā, prāṇamēvābhisaṁviśanti iti śrautaprayōgāt । sañjīvinīm iti paramamōkṣahētutvaṁ vivakṣitam । svagranthasya satsampradāyamūlakatāmāha - pūrvēti । ārthaṁ gurūpāsanaṁ caitatkīrtanamukhēnātra kr̥tam । śaṅkarādivyudāsāya pūrvaśabdaḥ । surakṣitāṁ na paramupadēśēna, granthanirmāṇēnāpīti bhāvaḥ । tarhi sā kimiti na prathitētyatrāha - bahumatīti । bahūnāṁ yā matayaḥ tāsāṁ vyāghātō mithō virōdhaḥ, tēna **dūrasthitām** । na yathāvadapratipattimātram, anyathā ca pratipattirabhūditi bhāvaḥ । tuśabdaḥ svagranthavaiṣamyaparaḥ ।  
sudhāsamākhyānuguṇyāya mamākṣarairityanūktiḥ ; gāyatryavayavāmr̥tākṣarair ityarthaḥ । sumanasaḥ ; sārāsāravivēkādivicakṣaṇāḥ । bhaumāḥ ; adhīta-sāṅga-saśiras-kavēdāḥ śrutakarmamīmāṁsā bhūlōkavāsinaḥ । dēśakālāntarādiṣu vr̥ttyādisāphalyamiti bhāvaḥ । pibantu ; sudhāpānavadasya śravaṇādyapi sukharūpam ityarthaḥ । anvaham ; bhōgyatātiśayāt gabhīratvācca ।

### pratijñā

**vi॰pra॰**—
bhagavad-bōdhāyana-kr̥tāṁ vistīrṇāṁ +++(kāśmīraṁ gatvā paṭhitvā smr̥tāṁ 32*2*10^5 akṣaramayīṁ)+++ brahma-sūtra-vr̥ttiṁ  
pūrvācāryās sañcikṣipus,  
tan-matānusārēṇa sūtrākṣarāṇi  
+++(saṅkṣēpa-vistārayōr madhyamā yathā tathā)+++ vyākhyāsyantē । 

**viśvāsa-ṭippanī**—
śaṅkarāryas tu "(asman-mataṁ) vayamasyāṁ
śārīrakamīmāṁsāyāṁ pradarśayiṣyāmaḥ" iti bahuvacanēna vadati, sva-mataṁ ca puraskarōtīti vyāvr̥ttiḥ। 

**Thibaut**—
The lengthy explanation (vr̥tti) of the Brahma-sūtras which was composed by the Reverend Bodhāyana has been abridged by former teachers; according to their views the words of the Sūtras will be explained in this present work.

**śruta-pradīpikā**—
pūrvācāryagranthāḥ pravartyantām ; kiṁ granthāntaranirmāṇaprayatnagauravēṇētyatrāha - bhagavaditi । pūrvācāryaśabdō'tra vivr̥taḥ । śaṅkarādibhyō'pi jñānādhikyaparō bhagava cchabdaḥ । dramiḍācāryādigranthō'tisaṅkṣiptaḥ । tanmatānusārēṇa ; na tu svōtprēkṣayā । sūtrākṣarāṇi ; prakr̥ti pratyayānuguṇyēna ; na tu yathākathañcidyōjayitavyānīti bhāvaḥ । vyāṅbhyāmupasargābhyāmapēkṣitavistarānapēkṣitasaṅkōcau vivakṣitau । vyākhyēyaṁ padam upādattē - athēti ।

### +01 jijñāsādhikaraṇam

**vi॰pra॰**—
athātō brahmajijñāsā ॥ 1-1-1॥

**Thibaut**—
1. Then therefore the enquiry into Brahman.

#### 1 atha

**vi॰pra॰**—
atrāyam **atha**-śabdaḥ ānantaryē bhavati  
+++(- pūrvōttara-mīmāṁsayōr ēka-śāstratvāt, uttara-padānvaya-balāt)+++। 

**English**—
In this Sūtra the word 'then' expresses immediate sequence; 

**śruta-prakāśikā - vyākhyēyatā**—
athātō brahmajijñāsā ।  
pūrvaṁ padāni vyācikhyāsuḥ prathamam atha-śabdaṁ vyācaṣṭē -  
atrāyam atha-śabda ānantaryē bhavati iti । 

> “pada-cchēdaḥ padārthōktir  
> vigrahō vākyayōjanā ।  
> ākṣēpasya samādhānaṁ  
> vyākhyānaṁ paśñcalakṣaṇam" 

iti hi vyākhyānaprakāraḥ ॥ 

> nanu naitau athātaḥ śabdō vyākhyēyau ; prayōjanābhāvāt ।  
> ajñāna saṁśaya-viparyaya-nivr̥tyarthaṁ hi vyākhyānam ।  
> 
> na tāvad atrājñānam ;  
> ānantaryē, prakr̥tasya hētubhāvē ca  
> tayōḥ prasiddhatvāt ।  
> 
> nāpi saṁśayaḥ,  
> arthāntarēṣu satsvapi tayōr uktārthaparatvēna prasiddhi-prācuryāt ।  
> na hi gōśabdaṁ śr̥ṇvataḥ sāsnādimati saṁśayō jāyatē ।  
> ata ēva viparyayō'pi dūrōtsārita iti ॥ 

atra brūmaḥ । ānantarya-vr̥tta-hētu-bhāva-paratva-nirṇayasya pūrva-vr̥tta-viśēṣāvagama-sāpēkṣatvāt  
tad-apratipattyā prasiddhi-prācuryasya sāpavādatvāt ।  

atha-śabdasyādhikārādiṣu,  
ētac-chabdasya ca 
'ētad uktaṁ bhavatī'ty ādiṣu vakṣyamāṇē'rthē,  
tasēśca sarva-vibhakty-artha-vācinaḥ 'ita' ity-ādiṣu pañcamy-artha-vyatiriktē'rthē [ca] prayōga-darśanāt,  
saṁśayaviparyayau syātām iti tannirāsāyāthātaḥ śabdavyākhyānaṁ 
yuktam (miti) ।  

atastau vyākhyāyētē । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - nādhikārārthaḥ**—
**vīrarāghavaḥ**—
atha-śabdasya ārambha-maṅgalārthāntaratva-praśna-kārtsnya-ānantarya-rūpārthaṣaṭkam,  
'maṅgalānantarārambhapraśnakāryēṣu athō atha',  
'athaiṣa viśva-jyōtiḥ' iti kōśa-prayōgādi-siddham ।  
tatra ānantaryātiriktasyārthasya prakr̥tē'nanvayaṁ darśayati atrētyādinā ।

atra tāvat atha-śabdasyādhikārārthatvam ayuktam ।  
adhikārō hi prastāvaḥ ।  
brahmajijñāsā *prastūyata*  
iti vacō mandra-prayōjanam ;  
prārabhyata ity uktiṁ vināpi, prārambhādēva prārabhyamāṇatvāvagamāt ।  
ucyamānaṁ hi vacanam,  
bravīmīty uktim antarēṇāpi  
sannihita-puruṣēṇa, "ucyata" ity ēvāvagamyatē ;  
na tu nōcyata iti । 

> prastōtavyatvam ucyata 

iti cēt —  
tadānīm api nyāya-pratipādakasya sūtrasya  
+upadēśā''jñāpana-paratvābhāvāt  
yuktitaḥ prārambha-yōgyēty arthaḥ syāt ।  
yōgyatvam aśābdam ॥  

> nanv adhyāhārēṇa +++(yōgyēti)+++ yōjanā syāt ।  
> ānantarya-pakṣē'pi "kartavyē"ti  
> hy adhyāhartavyam 

iti cēn na –  
adhikārārthatva-pakṣē  
adhyāhr̥tasyāpi padasyānvaya-daurghaṭyāt ।  
[[11]]   
yathā, 'ca yōgyā' ity uktē  
"samuccētuṁ  
yōgyē"ty arthō na śakyābhidhānaḥ,  
ēvam 'atha yōgyā' ityuktē 'py  
"adhikartuṁ yōgyē"ty abhidhānaṁ hi na śakyam ।  

ata ēva hi mahābhāṣyē,  

> "śabdānuśāsanaṁ nāma  
> śāstram adhikr̥taṁ vēditavyam" 

ity uktam ;  
na tv adhikartuṁ yōgyam iti । 1 

**vīrarāghavaḥ**—
1 "ca yōgyā", "atha yōgyā" ity-ādāv anvayābhāvē hētuṁ darśayati -  
"adhikr̥tamitī"ti ।  
śabdānuśāsana-padēna  
adhikārasya sva-viśēṣaṇatayā bōdhanāt  
na tasya "yōgyē"tyādi-padēnānvaya iti ca dhyēyam ।

"adhikr̥tam" ity api phalitārtha-kathanam -  
na tu vācanikōktiḥ;  
cādīnāṁ dyōtakatvāt।  

atra tv "adhikr̥tam" ity-artha-paratvē vaiyarthyam ity uktam ।  

śabdānuśāsanōpakramē tv adhikārārthatvam agatyā ''śritam ।  
na hy upanītēna vēdam adhīyānēnādhyētavyasya tad-aṅga-bhūtasya vyākaraṇasyāsādhāraṇō vr̥tta-viśēṣaḥ sambhavati ।  

iha tu prayōjanavad arthāntara-sambhavād  
adhikārārthatvāśrayaṇam ayuktam ।  

ānantaryaparatvē prayōjanavattvaṁ ca vakṣyatē । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - na maṅgalārthaḥ**—
maṅgalaṁ tu nāthaśabdavācyam ;  
api tu śaṅkha-svanādivat śrūyamāṇō 'thaśabdō maṅgalāvaha iti 2  
ōṅkārasyēvārthāntara-paratvē'pi  
maṅgalaṁ siddhayati ।  

**vīrarāghavaḥ**—
2 ōṅkārasyēvēti ।  
na hy atha-śabdasyēva  
tasyāpi maṅgalārthakatvē kōśādikam astīti bhāvaḥ ।  

ōṅkāra-tulyō hy atha-śabdaḥ smayētē, 

> "ōṅkāraścāthaśabdaśca  
> dvāvētau brahmaṇaḥ purā ।  
> kaṇṭhaṁ bhittvā viniryātau  
> tasmānmāṅgalikāvubhau " 

iti ।  
maṅgala-vācitvādyupagamē'pi  
maṅgalarūpā brahma-jijñāsēti  
brahmajijñāsā stutā syāt ।  
tataś ca sūtrasyārthavādatā syāt,  
na tu nyāya-nibandhanatvam ।+++(5)+++ 

jijñāsā-viśēṣaṇatvābhāvē  
maṅgalaṁ bhavatīti vākyabhēdaḥ syāt ।  

**śruta-prakāśikā - na viṣayāntarārthaḥ**—
prakr̥tād arthād arthāntara-paratvaṁ cāyuktam ।  
tad +dhi prakr̥tam apēkṣya vakṣyamāṇasyārthāntaratva-jñāpanam ।  
tac ca kalpāntarōpanyāsa-vivakṣāyām ēva dr̥ṣṭam ।  
atra tu kalpāntarōpanyāsābhāvāt  
tad anupapannam । 

**vīrarāghavaḥ**—
kalpāntaraṁ kōṭyantaram ।  
idam upalakṣaṇam - athaiṣa viśvajyōtir ityādidr̥ṣṭēḥ ।

**śruta-prakāśikā - na praśnārthakaḥ**—
praśnaparatvam apy ayuktam ;  
vacana-vyaktēḥ praśna-prativacana-rūpatvābhāvāt ।  
tadā hi,  
"kiṁ brahmajijñāsā kartavyē"ty uktaṁ syāt ।  
"sā kartavyē"ti vākyāntarēṇa prativacanaṁ syāt ।  
na ca prativacanarūpaṁ vākyāntaram upalabhyatē । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - na kārtsnyārthaḥ**—
athaśabdasya kārtsnya-paratvē  
"kārtsnyēna sā kartavyē"ty arthaḥ syāt ।  
sō'nupapannaḥ; ēkadēśa kartavyatāyāḥ śaṅkitatvābhāvāt ।  
kartavyatāmātraṁ hi saṁśayapadam ।  
tan-nirāsārthaṁ ca sūtram ।

**śruta-prakāśikā - ataḥśabdānvayāpēkṣā**—
**vīrarāghavaḥ**—
ēvam atha-śabdasyānantaryātiriktārtha-paratvē 'nupapattiruktā ।  
atha ataśśabdō'pi tan-nivāraka ityāha kiñcēti ।  
brahmajijñāsāpadam api tan-nivārakamiti caitan nigamanē darśayiṣyati ।  

kiñca adhikārādy-arthāntara-paratvam "ataś"-śabdānvayō 'pi nivārayati ।  
ataś--śabdō hi prakr̥tam arthaṁ hētutayā parāmr̥śan  
atha-śabdōpasthāpitaṁ vā  
brahma-jijñāsā--pada-sāmarthyākṣiptaṁ vā parāmr̥śēt ।  

tatra yadi atha-śabdōpasthāpitam adhikr̥tatvaṁ hētutayā parāmr̥śēt,  
tadā adhikr̥tatvād adhikartavyēti,  
hētōḥ sādhyāviśiṣṭatvaṁ syāt । 

maṅgalasyānabhidhēyatayā  
na padāntara-parāmarśa-yōgyatā ।  

vācyatvābhyupagamē'pi,  
tasya ca prakr̥tāpēkṣatvasya+++(→viṣayaparivartanaṁ)+++ ca kārtsnyasya ca pūrva-pakṣa-yukti-pratyanīkatvābhāvān  
na tāni hētutayā parāmarśanīyāni । 

**vīrarāghavaḥ**—
prakr̥tāpēkṣatvaṁ prakr̥ta-pratiyōgikatvam, prakr̥tād arthāntaratvamiti yāvat । 

na hy amaṅgalatva-prakr̥tānapēkṣatvākārtsnyaiḥ pūrvapakṣōtthānam ।  
nayasūtrāṇi ca viruddhārtha-vyudāsa-parāṇi ।+++(4)+++  

[[12]]  
praśna-vākya-gata-praśnas tu tasminnēva vākyē  
ataś-śabdō hētutayā parāmarśānarha ēva ।  
"kiṁ brahmajijñāsā kartavyē"ti  
vākyē'parisamāptē,  
kathaṁ kiṁśabdārthōṁ hētutayā parāmr̥śyēta !+++(4)+++  

atō'taś-śabda-parāmarśa-yōgyārthaś cēd atha-śabdō 'bhyupagamyatē,  
tadā adhikārādy-arthatvaṁ na ghaṭatē ।  

yadi brahma-jijñāsā-pada-sāmārthyākṣiptasya pūrva-vr̥ttatvēna  
tat-tad-vyākhyātr-abhimatasya vastunō 'taś-śabdēna parāmarśa *iṣyēta*  

tadānīṁ 

> jijñāsā'nupayōginas tad-ākṣēpyatvāyōgāt  
upayōgy-artha ēva tadā ''kṣēpya  

iti tat-parāmarśinātaḥśabdēna  
jijñāsōpayōgitayā tat-pūrva bhāvy-artha-viśēṣōpasthāpanāt  
atha-śabdasya svārasikānantarya-paratvē sambhavati  
a-svarasa-viphalārthāntara-svīkārō na ghaṭatē ।  

tataś cātaś-śabdavat  
brahma-jijñāsā-pada-sāmarthyam apy adhikārādy-artha-paratva-nivārakaṁ syāt । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - ānantaryārtha-pratijñā**—
ēvam arthāntarāṇām anupapannatām  
arthatō darśayan  
ānantaryārthatvam apy **atha**-śabdasyōpapādayati — atrāyamathaśabda ānantaryē bhavatīti ।  
'**atha-śabda ānantaryē**' iti pratijñā,  
tad-upapādakam "**atrāyaṁ bhavatī**"ti pada-trayam ।  

**śruta-prakāśikā - atrāyam bhavati**—
tatra **bhavatī**ti padēna ānantaryē svārasyaṁ sūcyatē ।  

svārasyāpavādikāṁ pūrva-vr̥ttāpratipattiṁ pariharati **atrēti** ।  
**atra** vēdasyōttara-bhāga-vicāra-rūpa-brahma-mīmāṁsārambha-sūtrē ityarthaḥ ।  
brahma-jijñāsā-pada-sāmarthyāt pūrva-bhāga-vicāra-rūpa--vr̥tta-viśēṣa ākṣipta ityabhiprāyaḥ ।  

hētv-antaram abhiprayann āha **ayam** iti ।  
**ayam atha-śabdaḥ**  
“atha śabdānuśāsanam",  
"atha yōgānuśāsanam"  
ityādi-sūtrāntara-gatātha-śabda-vyāvr̥tta ity arthaḥ ।  

**vīrarāghavaḥ**—
1 sūtrāntarēti । "atha śabdānuśāsanam" ity-asya bhāṣyatvē'pi  
tad-vyākhyēya-saṅgraha-vacana-rūpatvāt sūtratvam ।  
vastuta idaṁ pāṇini-sūtram ēva  
bhāṣya-kārēṇa prathamam anūdya vyākhyātam  
iti +++(bhartr̥)+++haryādi-granthāvagamyam iti  
tat-pakṣēṇātra sūtratvōktir ity apy āhuḥ । 

+++(ētat-sūtra-gata-)+++ataś-śabda-śiraska ity-uktaṁ bhavati ।  

vēdānta-sārē hy ayam arthaḥ kaṇṭhōktaḥ । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - nigamanam**—
prakr̥ta-paramarśinaitac-chabdēna  
pūrva-vr̥tta-sāmānyam abhihitam ity abhiprāyaḥ ।  
ēvaṁ samabhivyāhr̥tōbhaya+++(←"atrāyaṁ")+++-pada-svārasyāt  
sāmānyatō'bhihitaṁ, viśēṣata ākṣiptaṁ ca  
pūrva-vr̥ttaṁ siddham iti  
vr̥tta-viśēṣāpratipatti-rūpasya svārasyāpavādakasyābhāvād  
**atha**-śabda **ānantaryārtha** ēvēti vākyārthaḥ । 

ēvam athaśabdasyōttara-bhāga-vicārārambha-sūtra-gatatvam, ataḥśabda-śiraskatvam ānantarya-svārasyaṁ ca darśayadbhiḥ  
ānantaryōpapādakaiḥ **atra ayaṁ bhavatī**ti padair ēva  
asmin sūtrē arthāntarāṇāṁ gaty-abhāva-svīkāryāṇām anādaraṇīyatvaṁ phalitam । 

#### 2 ataḥ

**vi॰pra॰**—
**ataś**-śabdō +++(vakṣyamāṇasya)+++ vr̥ttasya hētu-bhāvē ।  

**Thibaut**—
the word 'therefore' intimates that what has taken place (viz. the study of the karmakāṇḍa of the Veda) constitutes the reason (of the enquiry into Brahman). 

**śruta-pradīpikā**—
adhīta-sāṅgasaśiraska-vēdasya ... brahmajijñāsā hyanantarabhāvinī ॥1॥

pūrvavr̥ttāpratipattirūpāpavādēna prasiddhiprakarṣasyākiññcitkaratayā saṁśayaviparyayau sta iti tadvyudāsāyāthaśabdaṁ vyācaṣṭē - atrēti । athaśabda ānantarya iti pratijñā । bhavatīti svārasyaṁ sūcitam । atrāyamiti tadapavādaparihāraḥ । atra; vēdōttarabhāgārthavicārārambhē । anēna pūrvabhāgārthavicārasya vr̥ttatvamākṣiptam । ēvaṁ brahmajijñāsāpadasāmarthyasūcitam atha śabdānuśāsanam ityādyathaśabdādasya vyāvr̥tiṁta sūcayatā ayaṁ śabdēna ataḥśabdaśiraskatvaṁ darśitam । anēna vr̥ttasāmānyasyātaḥ padēnābhidhānaṁ jñāpitam, ētacchabdasya prakr̥tavācitvasvārasyāt । ēvaṁ vr̥ttaviśēṣākṣēpakatatsāmānyābhidhāyakapadadvayasamabhivyāhāralabdhamathaśabdasyānantaryaparatvamityarthāduktaṁ bhavati । atō'tha maunam ityādiṣu prakr̥tipratyayayōra nēkārthasādhāraṇyadarśanādataḥśabdaṁ vyācaṣṭē - ata iti । 

atrāyaṁ bhavati ityanuṣaṅgaḥ । atra bhavati śabdau pūrvavat । ayam; athaśabdapūrvakaḥ ; prakr̥tipratyayasvārasyāt athaśabdasvārasyāt brahmajijñāsāpadasāmarthyāccētyarthaḥ । na ca athātaḥ śabdārthanirṇayasyānyōnyasāpēkṣatvādanyōnyāśrayaḥ śaṅkyaḥ. tayōrānantaryavr̥ttaparatvasvārasyasya vyutpattyavagatatayānyōnyānapēkṣatvāt । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - pratijñā**—
ataḥśabdaṁ vyācaṣṭē -  
**ataśśabdō vr̥ttasya hētubhāvē** iti ।  
**vr̥ttasyēti** prakr̥ty-artha uktaḥ;  
**hētubhāva** iti pratyayārthaḥ ।  
iyaṁ pratijñā । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - atrāyam bhavati**—
**atrāyaṁ bhavatī**ty anuṣaktaṁ pada-trayam upapādakam ।  
prakr̥ti-pratyayayōr uktārtha-paratvēna prasiddhi-prācuryaṁ  
bhavatinā darśitam ।  

atrētyasya pūrvavad arthaḥ ।  
anēna vr̥tta-viśēṣaḥ,  
tasya hētubhāvārhatvaṁ cā''kṣiptam ।  
tadarhatvaṁ ca anantaram ēva vyaktaṁ bhaviṣyati ।  
**ayam** ānantarya-svarasātha-śabda-pūrvakaḥ ।  
anēna vr̥tta-sāmānyam ākṣiptam ॥ 

**śruta-prakāśikā - anyōnyāśrayābhāvaḥ**—
> nanv atha-śabdārtha-nirṇayō 'taś-śabdārtha-nirṇaya-sāpēkṣaḥ  
ataś-śabdārtha-nirṇayaś cātha-śabdārtha-nirṇaya-sāpēkṣa ity anyōnyāśrayaḥ ॥ 

naivam । atha-śabdasyānantarya-svārasyaṁ hi  
nātaś-śabdārtha-nirṇaya-sāpēkṣam । ataḥ śabdasya vr̥tta-hētu-bhāva-paratva-svārasyaṁ  
na atha--śabdārtha-nirṇaya-sāpēkṣam ।  

> 'atha-śabda ānantarya-paraḥ sva-svārasyāt, samabhivyāhr̥ta-padāntara-svārasyācca ;  
> ataḥ-śabdōpi vr̥ttasya hētu-bhāvaparaḥ sva-svārasyāt, samabhivyāhr̥ta-padāntara-svārasyāc ca' 

[[13]] 

iti **bhavaty-ayaṁ**-śabdābhyāṁ darśitaṁ bhavati ।  

imē cābhyuccaya-yuktī; **atra**-padābhiprēta-**brahma-jijñāsā**-pada-sāmarthyād ēva pada-dvayasyōktārtha-paratva-siddhēḥ ।  
ataḥ sva-para-pada-svārasyāt  
brahma-jijñāsā-padasāmarthyāc ca  
**athātaḥ**-śabdau yathōktārtha-parāv  
iti na dōṣaḥ । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - śabda-dvayāpēkṣā**—
> nanu athātaḥ śabdayōr anyatarēṇālam iti 

cēt na;  

**atha**-śabdasyānantara-kālam upasthāpayatō vartiṣyamāṇa-**brahma-jijñāsā**-viśēṣaṇatayā,  
**ataḥ**-śabdasya-vr̥tta-hētu-bhāva-paratayā cāparyāyatvāt  

pratijñā-hētu-rūpēṇa padayōr bhinna-prayōjanatvāc ca ॥ 

> brahma-jijñāsā kartavyēti hi pratijñā

+iti cēt, na ; 

brahmajijñāsēti +++(sādhya-)+++dharmi--nirdēśaḥ, athēti sādhya-dharmōktiḥ ।
na kartavyatā-mātraṁ sādhya-dharmaḥ ; 
api tv ānantarya-viśiṣṭa-kartavyatvam ।  

**vīrarāghavaḥ**—
1 kartavyatvamiti । idaṁ cārambhaṇīyatvam ārambha-yōgyatva-rūpam,  
na tv ājñāpanādi-viṣayatva-rūpam  
iti atha-śabdasya prastāvārthakatva-khaṇḍaka-ṭīkāta ēva sugamam ।  
tatrārambha ēva na bhavati kāraṇābhāvād  
iti śaṅkāyāṁ  
kāraṇa-sad-bhāvō hētū kriyatē **ata** iti ।  

pūrvōttara-mīmāṁsayōr ēka-vyākhyāna-granthatvāt pūrva-siddhaḥ karma-vicāra ēva  
'**ata**' iti gr̥hyatē ।  
ētad-dhētu-sattvē'pi hētv-antarasya nityānitya-vastu-vivēkādēr apēkṣitatayā  
ārambha-vilamba-śaṅkādi-bhāvāt  
tat-parihāraḥ kriyatē **athēti** ।  

ēvaṁ karma-vicārānantarya-viśiṣṭam ārambha-yōgyatvam astīti sādhyē sthitē,  
'ata' ity ucyamānō hētur  
na karma-vicāra-mātram ;  
kiṁ tu puṣkala-sāmagrī -  
ēka-kāraṇa-mātrēṇānantaryasya dus-sādhatvāt ।  

tatra brahma-viṣayakāpāta-pratītiḥ karma-nirṇayaś cēti  
dvayam ēva vivāda-viṣaya iti  
tad-astitva-sūcanāya tad-dhētū-karaṇam ēva ataḥ-śabdābhiprētama ।  
idaṁ dvayam api prakr̥tam ēva,  
karma-vicārāt prāk-kāla-prabhr̥ti brahmāpāta-pratītēr api sad-bhāvāt । 

ēvam api pūrvaṁ brahma-jijñāsāyā akaraṇaṁ  
karma-jijñāsāyās tat-prati-bandhakatvāt ।  

> atha karma-vicārasya +++(brahma-nibha-)+++siddha-vyutpatty-abhāva-nirṇaya-ghaṭitatayā  
brahmāpāta-pratīti-vighaṭakatva-cintayā,  
pūrvam āpāta-pratīti-sthityā kartum arhā'pi brahmajijñāsā  
karma-vicārāt paścād akartavyaiva siddhā

iti śaṅkāyāṁ  
tan-nirāsāya **athātaś**-śabdau ।  
tathā karma-nirṇayasya karma-phala-sthairya-viṣayakatva-sambhavāt pratibandhakatvam ēvēti śaṅkā-parihārārthañ cātaḥśabdaḥ ।  
ēvañ cālpāsthira-phalakatva-prakāraka-karma-nirṇayō brahmāpāta-pratītiś ca militau hētuḥ । +++(5)+++  
idam ēva vakṣyati, hētuś ca viśiṣṭa iti । 

ēvam **athātaḥ**-padayōḥ pratijñā-hētv-arthatvēna vibhāgaḥ,  
"athātō dharmajijñāsā" ity-atrāpi samānaḥ ।  
ēvam artha-bhēdasyāvivakṣitatvēna hi,  
"atha yōgānuśāsanam", "atha śabdānuśāsanam" ityādiṣv ataś-śabdāprayōgaḥ ॥+++(5)+++ 

> nanu brahma-jijñāsā-pada-sāmarthyākṣiptatayā  
> buddhi-sthasya karma-vicārasya hētu-bhāvō  
> 'taś-śabdāvagantavya  
> iti kim atha-śabdēna ॥ 

maivam ।  
ānantaryōkti-mukhēna  
tasya hētōḥ śāstrāntara-śravaṇa-vyavadhāna-nairapēkṣya-dyōtanārthatvād **atha**-śabdasya ।  
tataś ca vēdānta-śravaṇāt pūrvaṁ  
śāstrāntara-śravaṇēna vinā  
sampādayitum aśakyatvāt, śāstrāntarāṇām anavasara-grastatvāc ca  
śāstrāntara-sāpēkṣāṇāṁ nityānitya-vastu-vivēkādīnāṁ pūrva-vr̥ttatva-vyudāsaḥ phalitaḥ syāt ॥ 

> nanu na yat kiñcidatītaṁ  
pūrvavr̥ttatvēna vaktavyam ;  
atiprasaṅgāt ।  
atō vartiṣyamāṇōpayuktam ēva pūrva-vr̥ttam atha-śabdōpasthāpitam iti,  
tasya hētutvam api śāstrāntara-śravaṇa-nairapēkṣyavat  
tēnaiva vastu-sāmarthyēna siddham  
iti kim ataḥ-śabdēna ? ॥ 

naivam । 2 atha-śabdākṣipta-hētv-asiddhi-śaṅkā parihārārthatvād ataś-śabdasya ।  
hētuś ca viśiṣṭaḥ ।  
tasya viśēṣaṇāṁśa-viśēṣyāṁśayōr a-siddhi-śaṅkā tat-parihāra-prakārau  
sūtra-kārābhiprētau parastāt darśayiṣyētē  
iti prayōjanavattaraṁ pada-dvayam ॥ 

**vīrarāghavaḥ**—
2 atha-śabdākṣipta-hētv iti kathanaṁ  
hētutvārhasyaivānantarya-pratiyōgitayā  
atha-śabdēnā''kṣēpāt ।  
na punarhētutvam apyātha-śabdākṣiptam । 

**vi॰pra॰**—
adhīta-sāṅga--sa-śiraska--vēdasya  
+++("svargakāmō jyōtiṣā yajēta; prativasantaṁ yajēta" ityādīnām āpātatō vicārēṇāpi)+++  
+adhigatālpāsthira-phala-kēvala-karma-jñānatayā  
sañjāta-mōkṣābhilāṣasya  
+ananta-sthira-phala--brahma-jijñāsā hy anantara-bhāvinī । 

**Thibaut**—
For the fact is that the enquiry into (lit.'the desire to know') Brahman – the fruit of which enquiry is infinite in nature and permanent – follows immediately in the case of him who, having read the Veda together with its auxiliary disciplines, has reached the knowledge that the fruit of mere works is limited and non-permanent, and hence has conceived the desire of final release.

**śruta-pradīpikā**—
atrētyādisūcitaṁ vr̥ttaṁ vartiṣyamāṇaṁ tayōrhētuhētumadbhāvaṁ ca vivr̥ṇvan vartiṣyamāṇasyānantaryaṁ ca ghaṭayati - adhītēti ।  

sāṅgaśabdēnādhyayanasyāpātapratītihētutvaṁ dyōtitam ;  
saśiraska śabdēna vyākhyānapaurvāparya-nimitta-vyākhyēya-paurvāparyaṁ  
bhāga-dvayasyaika-prabandhatvaṁ kr̥tsnādhyayanaṁ ca;  
karma-jñāna--brahma-jijñāsā padābhyāṁ vr̥tta-vartiṣyamāṇē ;  
kēvala-śabdēna brahmajñānavaidhuryam ; alpāsthirānantasthira śabdābhyāṁ hētuhētumadbhāvaḥ ; anantarabhāvinīti padēna athātaḥ śabdadvayaphalitaṁ hētupauṣkalyaṁ ca । tasmin sati hi phalānantaryam । anantasthiraphala śabdō brahmaviśēṣaṇam ; brahmajijñāsāyā vā ; tasyāstathātvaṁ sadvārakam ।

**śruta-prakāśikā - adhīta-sāṅga-saśiraska-vēdasya**—
[[14]] 

athēti-pada-sūcita-brahma-jijñāsā-pada-sāmarthya-siddhaṁ vr̥ttam, vartiṣyamāṇam,  
tayōr hētu-hētumad-bhāvaṁ ca vivr̥ṇvan  
uktam ānantaryam upapādayati **adhītēti** ।  
karma-jñāna--śabdēna vr̥ttam uktam ;  
brahma-jijñāsā-padēna vartiṣyamāṇam uktam ।  
alpāsthira-phala-  
ananta-sthira-phala-śabdābhyāṁ hētu-hētumad-bhāvō darśitaḥ ।  

**kēvala**-śabdēna brahma-jñāna-pūrvaka karma-vyāvr̥ttiḥ ।  

karma-jñānasyaiva pūrva-vr̥ttatvaṁ katham,  
ananta-sthira-phalāpāta-pratītiś ca katham iti śaṅkāyām  
**adhītēty**-ādipadēna tad-upapādanam । 

**sa-śiraska--vēda**-śabdēna kr̥tsnādhyayanasya vihitatvaṁ,  
vyākhyāna-paurvāparya-hētu-bhūta vyākhyēya-paurvāparya-niyamaḥ bhāga-dvayasyaika-prabandhatvaṁ ca sūcyatē । 

**sāṅga**-śabdēnānanta-sthira-phalāpāta-pratīti-janakatvē hētur-darśitaḥ ।  

> " kr̥ṣṇapakṣē tathā'ṅgāni ",  

> "upanīya tu yaḥ śiṣyaṁ  
vēdamadhyāpayēd dvijaḥ ।  
sakalpaṁ sarahasyaṁ ca  
tam ācāryaṁ pracakṣatē " 

ity-ādi-vacanāni  
adhīta-sāṅga--sa-śiraska-vēdasyēty-atrābhiprētāni । 

ēvam **adhītēty**-ādi-ṣaṣṭhy-anta-viśēṣaṇa-dvayēna brahma-jijñāsā-pada-sāmarthyānugr̥hīta-  
+**athātaḥ**-śabdōpasthāpitō 'dhikāri-viśēṣaḥ pradarśitō bhavati ।  
samadhigata-karmā sāṁsārika-phala-nirviṇṇō 'nanta-sthira-phalākāṅkṣī hi  
śāstram adhikarōti।  

**vīrarāghavaḥ**—
śāstram adhikarōtīti ।  
puruṣaṁ śāstram adhikarōti,  
puruṣaḥ śāstrēṇādhikriyata iti prayōgaḥ tantraprasiddhaḥ ।  
tadvat puruṣaḥ śāstrē adhikarōti,  
puruṣaḥ śāstram adhikarōtīti prayōgō 'py astīti dhyēyam । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - ananta-sthira-phalā**—
**ananta-sthira-phala**--brahma-jijñāsēti -  
ananta-sthira-phala-rūpasya brahmaṇō jijñāsētyarthaḥ ।  

ananta-sthira-phalatvasya brahma-jijñāsā-viśēṣaṇatvē jijñāsāyās tathātvam  
āgamōttha-vivēkādi-janya-jñāna-dvārēṇēti draṣṭavyam ।  

**śruta-prakāśikā - hētuḥ**—
**anantara-bhāvinīti** padēna  
+**athātaś**-śabda-phalitaṁ  
hētōḥ śāstrāntara-nairapēkṣyaṁ vivakṣitam ।  

karma-vicārānantaraṁ brahma-vicārasya kartavyatvē  

karmaṇām alpāsthira-phalatva-nirṇaya-sahita--  
+ananta-sthira-phalāpāta-pratītir ity ayaṁ viśiṣṭa-hētuḥ -  

**ataś**-śabdēna vr̥ttasya karma-vicārasya hētutayōktatvāt,  

karma-vicārasya sāṅgādhyayana-janyānanta-sthira-phalāpāta pratīti-pūrvakatvāt, 

+++(karma-)+++āvr̥tti-vidhānādibhiḥ +++(←prativatsara-svarga-phalaka-cāturmāsya-vidhānavat)+++ karmaṇām alpāsthira phalatvāvagama-hētutvāc ca ।+++(5)+++  

ayaṁ viśiṣṭa-hētuḥ adhigatālpāsthira-phala--kēvala-karma-jñānatayā  
**sañjāta-mōkṣābhilāṣasyēty** anēnōktaḥ ।  

**śruta-prakāśikā - karmādhīty-apēkṣā**—
atra **adhigatēti**  
karmaṇaḥ  
phala-dvārā +++(→phala-tyāgēna)+++ hānāya  
jñātavyatvaṁ kaṇṭhōktam ।  
sva-rūpēṇa+++(→bhagavacchēṣatayā)+++ +upādānāya +++(karmaṇō)+++ jñātavyatvam api karma-vicāra-pūrva-vr̥ttatvē hētuḥ ।+++(5)+++ 

> "apēkṣita-karma--sva-rūpa--jñānaṁ  
kēvala-karmaṇām alpāsthira-phalatva-jñānaṁ ca  
karma-mīmāṁsāvasēyam” 

iti hi vakṣyatē । 

tatra svarūpēṇōpādēyatā-pratītir  
ananta-sthira-phalāpāta-pratīty-antarbhūtā;  
upāya--tad-iti-kartavyatā-viśēṣaiḥ sahaiva  
hy ananta-sthira-phalāpāta-pratītir iti  
viśiṣṭa-hētv-antarbhāvaḥ;  
uparitana-granthāvirōdhaś ca । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - pratibandhakābhāvaḥ**—
> nanu karma-vicārō brahma-vicārasya nir-apēkṣa-hētuś cēt,  
kr̥ta-karma-vicāraiḥ sarvair api  
brahma vicāryēta –  
iti svargārtha-karmānuṣṭhātr--a-bhāva--prasaṅgaḥ ॥ 

maivam -  
a-śruta--mīmāṁsatvē 'py upādhyāyādi-vacanād yē 'nutiṣṭhanti   
tēṣāṁ svargārthānuṣṭhānāvirōdhāt, 

śrutvā 'pi yē svargārthinaḥ,  
tēṣām a-dr̥ṣṭa--vaiguṇyāt asamīcīna-vyākhyāna-śravaṇa-mūlasyāmumukṣatvasya sambhavāc ca ।

sāṅgādhyayanaṁ karma-vicāra--pūrva-vr̥ttaṁ cēt,  
adhīta-sāṅgavēdaiḥ sarvair api karma vicāryēta ।  
na ca tathā kriyatē ।  
vēdē'dhītē'py aśruta-karma-mīmāṁsā hi bahavō dr̥śyantē ॥ 

[[15]] 

> tēṣāṁ karma-vicārānadhigatir  
a-dr̥ṣṭa--dēśa-kālādi-vaiguṇyāt;  
na tu sāṅgādhyayanasya pūrva-vr̥ttatvābhāvād 

iti cēt-  
tad ihāpi tulyam ।  

tathā 

> sādhana-catuṣṭayādi+++(=vivēkaḥ, śamadamādiḥ, viraktiḥ, mumukṣutā)+++-lābhē 'py  
anadhigata--brahma-vicārānēka-puruṣa-darśanāt  
sādhana-catuṣṭayādēr brahma-vicāraṁ prati niyamēna hētutvaṁ katham 

iti paricōditē,  
tat-pūrva-vr̥ttatva-vādibhir api  
a-dr̥ṣṭādi--vaiguṇyād a-dōṣa  
iti parihartavyam;  
tad ihāpi tulyam ।  
duṣ-parihara-dūṣaṇāntara--sad-bhāvas tēṣāṁ vaiṣamyam ।  

tasmāt ghaṭa-niṣpattēḥ  
kulālādivat  
brahma-vicārasya karma-vicāraḥ pūrva bhāvitvēna niyataḥ;  
dr̥ṣṭādr̥ṣṭa-pratibandhaka-virahitasya samīcīnaḥ karmavicārō brahma-vicāra-sāmagrīti  
na kaścit dōṣaḥ ।  

ēvam **athātaḥ**śabdārthō nirūpitaḥ । 

#### 3 brahmaṇō jijñāsā

**vi॰pra॰**—
brahmaṇō jijñāsā - brahma-jijñāsā,  
brahmaṇa iti karmāṇi ṣaṣṭhī  
"kartr̥-karmaṇōḥ kr̥tī"ti viśēṣa-vidhānāt ।  

**Thibaut**—
The compound 'brahmajijñāsā' is to be explained as 'the enquiry of Brahman,'  
the genitive case 'of Brahman' being understood to denote the object;  
in agreement with the special rule as to the meaning of the genitive case, Pāṇini II, 3, 65.  

**viśvāsa-ṭippanī**—
"athātō dharmajijñāsā" ityatra mīmāṁsakaiḥ  
"dharmāya jijñāsā" iti vigrahē darśitaḥ।  
vēṅkaṭanāthāryēṇa cānyathā pratipāditam।  
tādr̥śō bhramō 'tra vāraṇīya iti prayāsaḥ। 

**śruta-pradīpikā**—
athaikapadyahētubhūtasamāsārthaṁ nirūpayan vibhaktyantaravyāvr̥ttyarthaṁ vyasya nirdiśati - brahmaṇa iti । pañcamīmarthāntaraśaṅkāṁ ca vyapanudannāha - brahmaṇa itīti । kuta ityatra āha - kartr̥karmaṇōḥ kr̥tīti । karmatvē sati viṣayatvaṁ prayōjanatvaṁ ca sidhyēditi bhāvaḥ । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - saṅgatiḥ**—
atha brahmajijñāsāpadārtha vivakṣus  
tadaikapadyasya samāsanibandhanatvāt prathamaṁ samāsārthaṁ nirūpayati brahmaṇa ityādinā । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - ṣaṣṭhī-niścayaḥ**—
karmatvakaraṇatvādisambandhaviśēṣēṣu itarāḥ vibhaktayaḥ, “karmaṇi dvitīyā" ityādibhiḥ sūtrairvihitāḥ । “ṣaṣṭhī śēṣē " iti sūtrēṇa sambandhasāmānyē ṣaṣṭhī vihitā । 

atra tasyāḥ sāmānya-viṣayatvam āśaṅkaya  
karma-viṣayatvaṁ niścīyatē :  
tatra sāmānyēna samāsasyānēka-vibhakti-sādhāraṇatvāt vibhakty-antara-śaṅkā-vyāvr̥tyartham  
iha tēṣām anupapattim abhiprayan  
padaṁ vigr̥hṇāti "brahmaṇō jijñāsē"ti ।  

caturthī-parigrahē prayōjanatva-siddhāv api prakr̥tivikārabhāvābhāvē caturthīsamāsāyōgāt tadaparigrahaḥ ।  
"saptamī" iti yōgavibhāgād brahmaṇi jijñāsēti samāsē'pi brahmaṇō viṣayatvamātraṁ syāt,  
na tu prayōjanatvamiti saptamyaparigrahaḥ ।  
śaṅkulā (layā) khaṇḍa itivat tr̥tīyā-samāsē  
viṣayatva-prayōjanatvē na siddhyata ityabhiprāyaḥ ॥  

brahmaṇa iti śabdarūpasya ṣaṣṭhīpañcamīsādhāraṇyāt  
ṣaṣṭhayāś cānēkārthatvāt tannirṇayārtham āha "brahmaṇa itī"ti ।  
kuta ityatrāha - kartr̥karmaṇōr iti ।  

**śruta-prakāśikā - karmatva-niścayaḥ**—
ṣaṣṭhyāḥ kartr̥karmasādhāraṇyē'pi jijñāsā-kartr̥tvaṁ tāpa-trayāturasyaiva,  
brahmaṇastu karmatvam ity abhiprāyēṇa  
brahmaṇa iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhītyuktam । 

karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhīsvīkārē brahmaṇō viṣayatvaprayōjanatvē siddhayētāmiti bhāvaḥ । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - ābhidhānikatākṣēpaḥ**—
[[17]] 

> nanu vigraha-vākyē'pi  
kathaṁ karmatvam ābhidhānikam ? prayujyamānā'pi hy upapada-vibhaktir nirarthikā ।  
tad-vidhānaṁ - dārāḥ, kalatram iti+++(patnyarthē-nirarthaka-liṅga-vacana-)+++vat prayōga-sādhutvāya +++(na tv artha-bōdhanāya)+++।  
arthas tv artha-sāmarthyākṣiptaḥ ।  
ata +++(prācuryāt, pada-mātra-śravaṇatō grāhyatvāt)+++ ēva hi kāraka-vibhaktēr upapada-vibhakti-daurbalyam ।+++(5)+++  
+++(vigraha-vākyē hy ēvaṁ cēt)+++  
samāsē tv a-prayuktāyā upapada-vibhaktēḥ kathantarāṁ karmatvābhidhāyakatvam  

iti cēt - ucyatē ।  

**śruta-prakāśikā - kr̥danta-śravaṇāt parihāraḥ**—
ābhidhānikavat kr̥danta-pada-prayōgēṇa śīghra-dhī-viṣayatva-sāmyād ābhidhānikatvōktiḥ +++(na lākṣaṇikatā kācit)+++।  
padāntara-śravaṇāpēkṣāmātrāt  
nākṣēpādivat vilambādhikyam  
+++(←"jijñāsā-karma kim" ityatra)+++ ।  
sāmānya-ṣaṣṭhī-pakṣē sambandha-sāmānyaṁ pratipadya  
jijñāsā-śabdārtha-gata-sakarmakatva-svabhāvālōcanayā 'rtha-viśēṣāvagamād api  
kr̥danta-śravaṇamātra-bhuvaḥ karmatva-dhiyaḥ śīghratvād  

iti kaścit parihāraḥ । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - vilambita-dhītvē'py abhidhēti parihāraḥ**—
" karmaṇi dvitīyā" itivat,  
"kartr̥karmaṇōḥ kr̥ti" iti saptamy-anta-nirdiṣṭayōḥ kartr̥-karmaṇōr abhidhēyatvam  
+++(vyākaraṇa-)+++anuśāsana-svārasyānuguṇam  
iti bhāṣyakārābhiprētaḥ parihāra  
iti sampradāyaḥ ।  

kāraka-vibhaktēr upapada-vibhakti-vaiṣamyaṁ  
padāntara-yōga-vihitatva-rūpam asty ēva ।  
na ca padāntara-yōgāvagamyatvam ābhidhānikatva-virōdhi;  
tasya kvacin mukhyārtha-vyavasthāpakatva-dr̥ṣṭēḥ -  
yathā 'ādityasya gāvaḥ+++(=kiraṇāni)+++ prakāśayanti' ityādiṣu ।  
na hi tatrā''dityādi-padāntara-yōgēna gōśabdasya kiraṇa-paratvaṁ lākṣaṇikam ।  

+++(ēvaṁ vilambita-dhī-hētutā na sarvatra dōṣāya - abhidhābādhābhāvē।  
ayaṁ nyāyō 'grē "tattvamasī"tyatra tvac-chabdasya bhagavat-paryantābhidhāyitvē 'pi prayōkṣyatē।)+++  
+++(5)+++

padāntara-parāmarśa-sāpēkṣatvēna vilambita-dhī-hētur upapada-vibhaktiḥ,  
kāraka-vibhaktis tu tan-nirapēkṣatvāt śīghradhī-hētur iti prābalya-daurbalya-vibhāga ēva;  
na tu sārthakatva-nirarthakatvābhyāṁ vaiṣamyam ।  
vibhakty-aśravaṇād  
amukhyatvaṁ tu parihr̥tam ।  

**vi॰pra॰**—
yady api sambandha-sāmānya-parigrahē 'pi jijñāsāyāḥ karmāpēkṣatvēna karmārthatva-siddhiḥ,  
tathā 'py ākṣēpataḥ prāptād ābhidhānikasyaiva grāhyatvāt  
karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī gr̥hyatē ।  

**viśvāsa-ṭippanī**—
atra vyākaraṇa-viśēṣa-pradarśanaṁ sva-prāmāṇikatāyāḥ, sūtraprāmāṇyaṁ cābhivyañjayitum,  
api cātrōktāḥ kēcid viṣayā agrē vēda-vākya-mīmāṁsāyām prayōkṣyanta iti।  
śruta-prakāśikāyām itō'pi vistāraḥ।  

**Thibaut**—
It might be said that even if we accepted the general meaning of the genitive case – which is that of connexion in general--  
Brahman's position (in the above compound) as an object would be established by the circumstance that the 'enquiry' demands an object;  
but in agreement with the principle that the direct denotation of a word is to be preferred to a meaning inferred  
we take the genitive case 'of Brahman' as denoting the object.

**śruta-pradīpikā**—
sāmānyavidhyapēkṣayā pratipadavidhērbalīyastvē'pi pratipadē samāsaniṣēdhāt paramparāsambandhasyāpi sambandhasāmānyāntarbhāvēna brahmānubandhināmupāyādīnāmapi jijñāsyatvasiddhēḥ sāmarthyāt brahmaṇaḥ karmatvākṣēpācca sāmānyaparatvamāśaṅkyāha - yadyapīti । parigrahē'pi ityatra pariṇā anubandhināṁ jijñāsyatāsiddhirdyōtitā । karmārthatvasiddhiḥ ; ṣaṣṭhyā iti śēṣaḥ । ābhidhānikasyaiva grāhyatvāditi ; upapadavibhaktirapi kārakavibhaktivat karmaṇi dvitīyā ityādivat kartr̥karmaṇōḥ kr̥ti ityādiśabdānuśāsanasvārasyādarthavatīti bhāṣyakārābhiprāyaḥ । ēva kārēṇa vilambitadhīhētvapēkṣayā śīghradhīhētōrbalīyastvamabhiprētam । pradhānasyāpradhānānāṁ ca karmatvākṣēpādapi pradhānasyābhidhānikatvamitarēṣāmākṣiptatvaṁ ca yuktamityarthaḥ । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - sambandha-sāmānya-śaṅkā-kāraṇam**—
> nanu tarhi kathaṁ yadyapītyādēḥ sambandha sāmānyaparigrahaśaṅkāviṣayasya bhāṣyasyōtthānaṁ yujyatē ! 

॥ ucyatē । 

sambandha-sāmānya-svīkārē'pi  
jijñāsā-pada-sāmarthyād brahmaṇaḥ karmatvasiddhēḥ,  
paramparayā sambandhinām upāyōpāsaka-pratibandhādīnām api jijñāsyatvasiddhēḥ ; pratipada-vihita-ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsa-niṣēdhāc ca ।  

tatra sāmarthyāt ṣaṣṭhyāḥ karmārthatvasiddhiṁ  
brahmānubandhinām api jijñāsyatvasiddhiñca śaṅkatē "yadyapī"ti ।  

**śruta-prakāśikā - parigraha-śabdaḥ**—
sambandhasāmānyaparigraha ityatra pariṇā brahmānubandhināmapi jijñāsyatvasiddhiḥ sūcyatē ।  

paritō grahaṇēna hi paritaḥ sthitānāmapi grāhyatvaṁ labhyatē । ata ēvaṁ hyattaratra 'gr̥hyata' ityuktam ; na tu 'parigr̥hyata' iti । 

(1 pratibandhēti ; parita iti । brahmaṇō vicārasya ca yaḥ sambandhaḥ tasya paritō grahaṇaṁ nāma paramparāsambandhaiḥ saha sambandhatvēna grahaṇam । tēnārthapañcakāntargatānāṁ brahmaprāpti-tatkartr̥-tadupāya-tadvirōdhināṁ brahma paritaḥ sthitānāmapi vicāryatvaṁ labhyata iti । )

**śruta-prakāśikā - karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhēḥ śīghradhī-grāhitā**—
tadubhayaṁ pariharati tathāpīti ।  
atrāyam arthaḥ -  
pradhānasya brahmaṇaḥ apradhānānām anyēṣāṁ ca karmatvasyākṣēpa-siddhatvād api  
pradhāna-karmatvasyā''bhidhānikatvam,  
itairaṣāṁ pradhānasambandhād ākāṅkṣāvaśāc ca  
karmatvasya sāmarthya-siddhatvaṁ ca svīkartuṁ yuktam iti ।  

ataḥ pratipadavihitā ṣaṣṭhī grāhyā;  
“vilambitadhīhētōḥ śīghradhī-hētur balīyān" iti nyāyāt ।+++(5)+++  

ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sambandha-sāmānya-vivakṣāyāṁ hi karmatvadhīr vilambitā syāt,  
kr̥dyōga-ṣaṣṭhī-vivakṣāyāṁ tu śīghra-bhāvinī ॥  

> nanu kartr̥karmaṇōr ubhayōr apy arthayōḥ sūtra-pratipannatvāda vilambitā karmadhīr 

iti cēnna –  
kartur jijñāsōr adhigata-karmaṇaḥ pratipannatvāt  
karmārthatvam ēva hi  
prathamataraṁ dhiyam adhirōhēt । 

**vi॰pra॰**—
na ca "pratipada-vidhānā ṣaṣṭhī na samasyata"  
iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsa-niṣēdhaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ -  
"kr̥d-yōgā ca ṣaṣṭhī samasyata"  
iti pratiprasava-sadbhāvāt । ॥1॥

**śruta-pradīpikā**—
samāsaniṣēdhamāśaṅkya pariharati - na cēti । pratiprasavō 'pavādāpavādaḥ । aprayuktavibhaktēranabhidhāyakatvē'pyanuśāsanādhīnalakṣyārthaviśēṣa nirṇayāya ṣaṣṭhī vyākhyātā । prātipadikēna vibhaktyarthalakṣaṇāyāṁ tu na kēvalaṁ yōgyatādi kāraṇam, anuśāsanaṁ cāpēkṣitamiti tadanusārēṇa vyākhyātam ।

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
16 

samāsa-niṣēdham āśaṅkaya pariharati nacēti ।  
caḥ śaṅkāsamuccayē ।  
**pratiprasavō** 'pavādāpavādaḥ ।  

**śruta-prakāśikā - sarpiṣō jñānam**—
sarpiṣō jñānam+++(=pravr̥ttiḥ)+++ ity-ādi-prayōgēṣu, "jñō'vid-arthasya karaṇē" ity-ādi-sūtra-vihitāyāṁ ṣaṣṭhayāṁ samāsa-niṣēdhasya sāvakāśatvam ।  
sarpiṣā pravr̥ttiriti hi tasya vākyasyārthaḥ ।  

yadyapi jñānapadaṁ kr̥dantam-  
tathāpi sarpiṣa iti ṣaṣṭhī  
na kr̥dyōgavihitā ।  
"sarpiṣō+++(→sarpiṣā)+++ jānītē+++(=pravartatē)+++" iti tiṅanta-padānvayārhatvāt,  
[jñā]dhātōr vibhaktēśca pravr̥tti--tat-karaṇārthatvāc ca ।  

na hi tat sarvaṁ kr̥dyōgavihitatvē siddhayati ।  
atō nātra pratiprasava-prāptir iti samāsa-niṣēdhasya sāvakāśatvam । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - ṣaṣṭhī-vyākhyēyatā**—
> nanu nēyaṁ ṣaṣṭhī vyākhyēyā - aprayuktatvāt sūtrē ।  
prayukta ēva hi śabdō'rthabōdhakaḥ ;  
na tv aprayuktaḥ ।  
bōdhaka-śabda ēva hi vyākhyēyaḥ ॥  
> 
> "aprayuktā'pi smr̥tā vibhaktir  
bōdhikēti sā vyākhyēyē"ti cēn na -  
tat-smaraṇēna vinā 'py artha-pratipattēḥ ।  
artha-pratipattiś ca prātipadikēna lakṣaṇayā ।  
lakṣaṇā ca yōgyatādinā ।  
atō'nuśāsanēna tad-vyākhyānam ayuktam ॥ 

ucyatē ।  
a-prayukta-vibhakty-arthasya  
prātipadikēna lakṣaṇā hi samāsaḥ ।  
atra lakṣyārthōpalakṣaṇatayā  
vibhaktir anupraviṣṭā ।  
atō lakṣyārtha-viśēṣa-nirṇayāya  
vigraha-vākya-sthā ṣaṣṭhī vyākhyēyā ॥ 

> tarhi nānuśāsanēna sā vyākhyēyā । lākṣaṇikārthē hi yōgyatādinā'vasīyatē । na hi gaṅgāyāṁ ghōṣaḥ ityatrānuśāsanavaśāt kūlaṁ lakṣyatē ; api tu yōgyatādinaivēti ॥ 

naivam । sarvāsu lakṣaṇāsu yōgyatādinaivārthanirṇaya [ iti ] niyamābhāvāt ।  
sa tu niyamaḥ prātipadikēna prātipadikāntarārthalakṣaṇāyām । prātipadikēna vibhaktyarthalakṣaṇāyāṁ tu; 'ētadvibhaktyarthō lakṣyaḥ ; na vibhaktyantarārthaḥ' iti niyamō bhavati । sa ca śabdānuśāsanādhīna iti tadnurōdhēna tannirūpaṇaṁ yuktam । 

tatra sambandhasāmānyaṁ lakṣayitvā tēna karmatvasyākṣēpād api  
prathamata ēva karmatvasyaiva lakṣaṇā śabdānnuśāsanānumatā yuktā । ataḥ samastapadalakṣyārtha viśēṣa nirṇayāyānuśāsanānurōdhēna lakṣyārthōpalakṣaṇabhūtā vigrahavākyasthā ṣaṣṭhī vyākhyēyēti । 

yadvā luptavibhaktikaśabdēna vibhaktyarthōpasthāpanaṁ mukhyaṁ syāt । sambandhinō hi lakṣaṇā dr̥ṣṭā ; na sambandhamātrasya । vibhaktyarthaśca svayaṁ sambandharūpaḥ । na ca sambandhasya sambandhāntarānapēkṣatvēna svasmin sambandhi (ndha) kāryakaratvālakṣaṇā sambhavatīti vācyam; sambandhasya svaparanirvāhakatvānabhijñānāmapi vibhaktyarthapratītēḥ । na hi sambandhaḥ [sva] sattayā lakṣaṇāhētuḥ; kintu jñāyamānatayaiva । na cēt, atiprasaṅgāt । ēvaṁ lakṣaṇānupapattyā prayōgasyānanyathāsiddhatvāt samastaśabdēna vibhaktyarthabōdhanaṁ (rthōpasthāpanaṁ) mukhyam । amukhyatvēpi vā kā naḥ kṣatiḥ । 

#### 4 brahma

**vi॰pra॰**—
brahmaśabdēna ca  
svabhāvatō nirasta-nikhila-dōṣō  
+++(svabhāvatō→)+++ 'navadhikātiśayāsaṅkhayēya-kalyāṇa-guṇa-gaṇaḥ  
**puruṣōttamō 'bhidhīyatē** ।  

**Thibaut**—
The word 'Brahman' denotes the hightest Person (purushottama), who is essentially free from all imperfections and possesses numberless classes of auspicious qualities of unsurpassable excellence.  

**śruta-pradīpikā**—
atha samastayōḥ padayōḥ prathama-padam  
anēkārtha-sādhāraṇyēna prasiddhēḥ  
parair anyathā vyākhyātatvācca  
saṁśaya-viparyayau sta iti  
tadvyudāsāya vyācaṣṭē - brahmēti । 

"parītya lōkān" iti śrutyanusārēṇa puruṣōttama ity uktam ।  
svētara-cid--a-cid--vilakṣaṇatvaṁ tac-chabdārthaḥ ।  
svētarānyatvaṁ tr̥ṇādēr apy astīti  
tad-vyāvr̥ttyartham  
ubhayaliṅgatvēna vailakṣaṇyamāha - svabhāvataḥ ityādinā । 

nikhilēti baddhādi-vyudāsaḥ ।  

svabhāvataḥ iti mukta-vyāvr̥ttiḥ । 

sāvadhikātiśaya-nitya-vyudāsāya  
**anavadhikātiśaya** śabdaḥ ।+++(5)+++ 

pratyēkaṁ tādr̥śā guṇā asaṅkhyēyāḥ । 

ēkasya guṇasya vidhā-bhēda-rūpa-guṇa-puñjābhiprāyō **gaṇa**-śabdaḥ । satya-saṅkalpatvāntarbhūtā hi vaśitvādayaḥ । 

**abhidhīyatē** ; mukhyavr̥ttyā bōdhyatē । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - vyākhyēyatā**—
ēvaṁ samāsāntargatavibhaktyarthē nirūpitē samastayōḥ padayōḥ prathamaṁ brahmaśabdaṁ vyācaṣṭē  
brahmaśabdēna cēti ।  
brahmaśabdasya pradhānādy-arvācīnārthāntarēṣu prayōgadarśanāt,  
itara--vyākhyātr̥bhir īśvarātirikta-vastu-paratvēna vyākhyātatvāt,  
dēvatāntara-paratvasya kaiścid abhyupagatatvācca  
tad-vyāvr̥tyarthaṁ  
brahma-śabdēna puruṣōttamō'bhidhīyatē iti pratijānītē ।

**śruta-prakāśikā - puruṣōttamaśabdaḥ**—
puruṣōttama-śabdasya rūḍhyā  
brahma-śabdasya dēvatāntara-paratvādi-vyudāsaḥ ;  
avayava-śaktyā baddha-muktāvastha-cētana-vailakṣaṇyam uktam ।  

**śruta-prakāśikā - viśēṣaṇa-yōgaḥ**—
svētara-vailakṣaṇya-mātraṁ tr̥ṇādēr apy astīti  
tad-vyāvr̥tty-arthaṁ **svabhāvata**-ityādinā viśēṣaṇadvayēna (tadvai)vai-lakṣaṇyaṁ viśinaṣṭi ।  

idaṁ ca viśēṣaṇa-dvayaṁ  
śabda-śaktēr artha-sāmarthyāc ca  
brahma-śabdasya puruṣōttama-paratva-pratipādanōpayōgitayōktam ;  
na tu pravr̥tti-nimittatayā +++(br̥hattva-rūpayā)+++;  
+++(muktādāv iva)+++ guṇatō'pi br̥hattvē sati śabda-śakty--a-saṅkōca siddhēḥ;  
mumukṣōr a-śēṣa-dōṣa-nivr̥tti--  
niratiśayānanda-prāpti-hētutvāc ca । 

vādy-antarōktasya nirguṇatvasya a-vidyādi-dōṣānvayasya ca vyāvr̥tty-artham,  
upādhy-upahita-brahma-svarūpasyaiva karma-vaśyatva-duḥkhitvādi-vyāvr̥ty-artham, 

> jñānādi-śakti-yōga ēvāsya svābhāvikaḥ;  
> sārvajñya-niratiśayānandādi-yōgas tu kādācitkaḥ 

iti matasya ca vyāvr̥tyartham idaṁ viśēṣaṇadvayam uktam ।  

nirasta-katipaya-dōṣatvaṁ nirasta-nikhiladōṣatvaṁ ca  
kēṣāñcid baddhānāṁ, muktānāṁ nityānām apy astīti  
tadvyāvr̥tty-arthaṁ **svabhāvatō nirasta-nikhila-dōṣa** ity uktam । 

nitya-siddhānām api +++(garuḍādīnāṁ)+++  
bhagavan-nitya-saṅkalpādhīnaṁ hi nitya-nirdōṣatvam ।  

svabhāvata ity uttaratrāpy +++(…←kalyāṇa-guṇa-gaṇaḥ)+++ anuṣaṅgaḥ;  
tēna guṇānām avidyā-kalpitatva[pakṣa]-vyāvr̥ttiḥ ।  
"tē yē śatam" ity-atra pūrva-pūrva-guṇēbhya uttarōttara-guṇānām atiśayaḥ sāvadhika  
iti tathyāvr̥tty-artham anavadhikātiśaya-śabdaḥ ।  
tatra hi brahma-guṇātiśayasya vāṅ-manasāgōcaratayā 'navadhikatvam uktam । satya-saṅkalpasyāntarbhūtāḥ vaśitvādi-guṇā iti hi vakṣyatē ।  

**śruta-prakāśikā - gaṇa-śabdaḥ**—
ataḥ kasmiṁścid guṇē tad-vidhābhēda-rūpatayā guṇānāṁ bahūnām antarbhāvābhiprāyō gaṇa-śabdaḥ ॥  

[[30]]  

> +++("anavadhikātiśayaguṇā gaṇēṣu yasya sa" iti)+++  
> nanv anavadhikātiśaya-śabdasya guṇa-viśēṣaṇatvē  
> gaṇa-śabda-sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvād bahuvrīhir na syāt ।  
> gaṇa-viśēṣaṇatvam apy ayuktam ; guṇa-svarūpasya hy anavadhikātiśayatvam ; na tu gaṇa-svarūpasya ॥ 

naivam ।  
+++("anavadhikātiśayā guṇagaṇā yasya sa" iti)+++  
gaṇa ēva viśēṣya iti bahu-brīhi-siddhiḥ ।  
tathāpy artha-vaśād gaṇāntarbhūtaikaika-guṇa-vyaktēr anavadhikātiśayatvaṁ phalitaṁ syāt ;  
yathā,  

> 'ēṣā pariṣad abhijanavatī śruta-śīla-śālinī' 

ity-atra śrutaśīlādīnāṁ pariṣad-viśēṣaṇatvē pratītē'pi  
tad-antarbhūtānām ēva śrutādy-anvayaḥ;  
na tu samūhasya;  
tatō nirgatānāṁ śrutādy-abhāva-prasaṅgāt ।  

a-saṅkhyēyatvam api gaṇa-viśēṣaṇaṁ yuktam ;  
gaṇāsaṅkhyēyatvē guṇāsaṅkhyēyatvaṁ kaimutya-siddham ।  

**śruta-prakāśikā - anavadhikātiśayaśabdaḥ**—
anavadhikātiśaya-śabdēna nitya-siddha-vyāvr̥ttiś ca ;  
tad-guṇānāṁ jagad-vyāpārānanuguṇatvēna  
bhagavad-guṇāpēkṣayā sātiśayatvāt ।  

tēṣām īśvara-tad-guṇa-vibhūti--sākṣāt-kārasyātyantānukūlasya niravadhikātiśayatvē 'pi  
tādr̥śāsaṅkhyēya-guṇābhāvāt tad-vyāvr̥ttiḥ ।  

anuṣaktēna "svabhāvata" iti padēna vā nitya-siddha-vyāvr̥ttiḥ ।  
tēṣāṁ tādr̥śa-guṇakatvaṁ hi bhagavan-nityēcchādhīnam ।  
svarūpēṇānavadhikātiśayatvābhāvāc ca  
nitya-siddhavyāvr̥ttiḥ ।  
tē hy aṇu-svarūpāḥ ।+++(5)+++  
atra sva-rūpasyānavadhikātiśayatvaṁ garbhitam ;  
vibhutvasyāpi guṇāntarbhāvāt;  
'br̥hattvaṁ ca svarūpēṇa guṇaiś ca' ity upapādaka-granthōktēḥ ।  

**śruta-prakāśikā - abhidhāna-puruṣa-śabdau**—
**abhidhīyatē** - mukhyayā vr̥ttyā bōdhyatē । 

asmin granthē,  

> “yēnākṣaraṁ puruṣaṁ vēda satyam ”  

iti śrutiś caitat-sūtrārthānuvādinī anusaṁhitā bhavati ।  
tatra hi,  

> " prōvāca tāṁ tattvatō brahma-vidyām" 

iti puruṣa-pada-paryāyatayā 
brahma-śabdaḥ prayuktaḥ । 

**vi॰pra॰**—
sarvatra br̥hattva-guṇa-yōgēna hi brahma-śabdaḥ।  
br̥hattvaṁ ca +++(vibhutva-)+++svarūpēṇa guṇaiś ca yatrānavadhikātiśayaṁ  
sō 'sya mukhyōrthaḥ । 

**Thibaut**—
The term 'Brahman' is applied to any things which possess the quality of greatness (br̥hattva, from the root 'br̥h'); but primarily denotes that which possesses greatness, of essential nature as well as of qualities, in unlimited fulness; and such is only the Lord of all.  

**śruta-pradīpikā**—
śabdasāmarthyād arthasāmarthyavaśāc ca  
bhagavatparatvaṁ vaktuṁ  
prathamaṁ śabda-sāmarthyam upapipādayiṣur  
anyatra gauṇatvaṁ hr̥di nidhāya  
brahma-śabdasya guṇa-yōgataḥ pravr̥ttatvam āha - sarvatrēti ।

sarvatra prayōgēṣu viṣayēṣu ।  
tataḥ kim ityatrāha - br̥hattvaṁ cēti ।  

**śruta-prakāśikā - sarvatra**—
ēvaṁ pratijñātam arthaṁ  
śabda-sāmarthyāt prathamam upapādayati  
sarvatrēty-ādinā ।  

tatrārthāntarēṣu brahma-śabda-prayōgasyānyathā-siddhi-vivakṣus  
tad-upayuktaṁ guṇa-yōgaṁ darśayati sarvatrēti ।  
**sarvatra** — brahma-śabda-prayōgaviṣayēṣu sarvēṣu  
br̥hattva-guṇayōgō 'stīty arthaḥ । 

**śruta-prakāśikā - puruṣōttamē mukhyavr̥ttiḥ**—
> puruṣōttamē gauṇatvam  
anyatra mukhyatvaṁ ca kiṁ na syād 

ity-atrāha **br̥hattvañ** cēti । 

br̥hattva-guṇa-mātra-yōniṣu sarvēṣu brahma-śabda-prayōgābhāvāt  
svarūpatō guṇataś cānavadhikātiśaya-br̥hattvaṁ pravr̥tti-nimittam ity arthaḥ ॥ 

**śruta-prakāśikā - br̥ṁhaṇatvāntarbhāvaḥ**—
> nanu, 
> 
>> "br̥hati+++(=barhati)+++ br̥ṁhayati tasmād ucyatē paraṁ brahma",  
>
>> "br̥hattvād br̥ṁhaṇatvāc ca  
> tad brahmēty abhidhīyatē" 
> 
> iti 1śrutismr̥tibhyāṁ br̥hattvē br̥ṁhaṇatvē ca  
> pravr̥tti-nimittatayā 'vagatē  
> katham iha (ba) br̥hattva-mātraṁ nimittam ucyatē ॥ 

(1. śrutīti । atharvaśirasi, 

> "atha kasmād ucyatē paraṁ brahma ? yasmāt param aparaṁ parāyaṇaś ca br̥ṁhat br̥hatyābr̥hayati tasmāt paraṁ brahma" 

ityupalabhyamānapāṭhaḥ ।  
br̥hatīti chāndasam ।  
barhati, br̥ṁhati iti ca śuddhama ।)

guṇatō br̥hattvē br̥ṁhaṇatvasyāntargatatvād iti brūmaḥ । 

“sa cā''nantyāya kalpatē" 

ity-ādi-śruti-prasiddha sa-kala--saṅkōca-nivr̥tti-pūrvaka-  
niravadhika-jñāna-vikāsa-rūpānantyāvahatvaṁ hi br̥ṁhaṇatvam ।  
tad+dhi sa-kala--hēya-pratyanīkatva--kṣānti-kāruṇyādi--  
mōkṣa-prada-syaupayika-guṇavatvam ।  
ata ēva hi,  
'svabhāvatō nirasta-nikhiladōṣa' 
ityādikaṁ  
pratijñā-vākyē 'bhihitam ॥ 

**śruta-prakāśikā - guṇaiḥ svarūpēṇa ca**—
> nanu svarūpatō br̥hatvam ēva nimittam astu;  
kiṁ gauravēṇa

iti cēt- na;  
brahma-guṇādēr api svarūpēṇa br̥hatvād brahma-śabda-vācyatva-prasaṅgāt ॥ 

> tarhi guṇatō br̥hattvam ēvāstu nimittam 

iti cēnna -  
śabdaśaktēr asaṅkōcasya  
svataḥ prāptatvāt ;  
svarūpē ca br̥hattva-sad-bhāvāt । 

"satyaṁ jñānamanantaṁ brahma" iti hi śrutiḥ ।  
guṇatō br̥hattvaṁ nāma sa-dvārakaṁ br̥hatvam ।  
guṇa-dvārā hi tat । 

**vi॰pra॰**—
sa ca sarvēśvara ēva,  
atō brahma-śabdas tatraiva mukhya-vr̥ttaḥ ।  

**Thibaut**—
Hence the word 'Brahman' primarily denotes him alone, 

**śruta-pradīpikā**—
anyasyāpi kiṁ na syād ity atrāha - sa cēti ।  
caḥ śaṅkā-nivr̥ttau ।  

**śruta-prakāśikā - sarvēśvara ēva**—
[[19]] 

> svarūpēṇa guṇaiśca niratiśaya-br̥hatvavad vastu  
puruṣōttamād anyad api syāt,  
anyad ēva vā syād 

ityatrāha sa cēti ।  
**caḥ** śaṅkānivr̥ttau ।  

sarvēśvara-śabdēnaivakārēṇa ca 

> "tamīśvarāṇāṁ paramaṁ mahēśvaram ", 

> "na tatsamaścābhyadhikaśca dr̥śyatē" 

iti vākya-yugalārthō vivakṣitaḥ ।  

**śruta-prakāśikā - ataḥ**—
tataḥ kimityatrāha **ata** iti ।  
**ataḥ** - anavadhikātiśaya-br̥hati brahma-śabdasya mukhyatvāt,  
sarvēśvarasyaiva tādr̥śa-br̥hattva-guṇa-yōgitvāc cētyarthaḥ ।  

**vi॰pra॰**—
tasmād anyatra +++(vēda-brāhmaṇādau)+++ tad-guṇa-lēśa-yōgād aupacārikaḥ +++("gauṇārthē 'sambhavē hi śaktiṁ kalpayēd" iti nayēna)+++,  
+++(lakṣyāvalōkanēna)+++  
anēkārtha+++(←śaktitaḥ)+++-kalpanā'yōgāt,  
+++(vyāsa-pitr̥-vyākhyāta-)+++bhagavac-chabdavat । 

**Thibaut**—
and in a secondary derivative sense only those things which possess some small part of the Lord's qualities; for it would be improper to assume several meanings for the word (so that it would denote primarily or directly more than one thing).  
The case is analogous to that of the term 'bhagavat [#fn_0].' 

[#fn_0]: 4:1 'Bhagavat' denotes primarily the Lord, the divintiy; secondarily any holy person.

**śruta-pradīpikā**—
> kathamēvakāraḥ ? anyatrāpi hi prayujyata 

ityatrāha - tasmāditi ।  

sarvēṣāṁ mukhyatvaṁ kiṁ na syādityatrāha - anēkēti ।  

ananyathā-siddha-prayōgō hi śakti-kalpakaḥ । atra tv anyathāsiddha iti bhāvaḥ । 

> nātrānēka-śakti-kl̥pti-prasaṅgaḥ ;  
na cānyatrāmukhyatvam ;  
ēkayaivāvayava-śaktyā  
sarvatra mukhyatvād 

ityatrāha - bhagavaditi । 

paṅkaja-śabdasyōtpalādi-vyāvr̥tta--tāma-rasānuvr̥tta-padmatvavat 

prayōga-viṣayānugata--  
tad-a-viṣaya--vyāvr̥tta--  
pravr̥tti-nimittābhāvēna  

+++(brahma-bhagavac-chabdhayōḥ)+++  
+anēka-śakti-kalpanē prāptē  

prayōgasyānyathā+++(→gauṇa-vr̥ttyā)+++-siddhatvāt  

puṣkala-pravr̥tti-nimitta ēva viṣayē mukhyō  
'nyatrāmukhyaś ca  
yathā bhagavac-chabdō nirṇītas  
tathā brahma-śabdō 'pītyarthaḥ ।+++(5)+++ 

**śruta-prakāśikā - ēkatraiva mukhyā vr̥ttiḥ**—
> kathaṁ tatraiva mukhya-vr̥ttaḥ,  
anyatrāpi hi brahmaśabdaḥ prayujyata 

ityatrāha  
tasmād iti ।  
**tasmāt** — brahmaṇaḥ ।  

sarvatra mukhyaḥ kutō na syād ity-atrāha **anēkārthēti** ।  
parasmād brahmaṇō 'nyatra  
prayōgasyānyathā-siddhatvān  
na tatra śakti-kalpanam,  

'ananyathāsiddhaḥ prayōgaḥ śaktiṁ kalpayatī'ti nyāyād ityarthaḥ ; ।+++(5)+++  

**śruta-prakāśikā - avayava-śakti-nimittatā na sarvatra**—
> anēka-śakti-kalpanaṁ gauṇatvaṁ vā na syāt, br̥hattva-guṇa-yōgi-sarva-vyaktiṣv ēkayaiva śaktyā mukhyatva-sambhavād 

ity-atrāha **bhagavac-chabdavad** iti ।  
tathā ca śrīmati vaiṣṇavē purāṇē

> "tatra pūjyapadārthōkti-  
> paribhāṣā-samanvitaḥ ।  
> śabdō'yaṁ nōpacārēṇa  
> tv anyatra hy upacārata:" 

iti ॥  

> anēna prastutacōdyasya kaḥ parihāra uktō bhavati ? 

ucyatē ।  
br̥ṁhati-dhātōr manin-pratyayāntatvēna niṣpannasya brahma-śabdasya  
pradhānādiṣu dr̥śyamānaḥ prayōgō  
nāvayava-śakti-nibandhanaḥ ।+++(5)+++  
tathā hi sati br̥han-mahac-chabdādivat āpēkṣika-br̥hattva-yōgiṣu sarva-vastuṣu
