pramāṇāntarāṇi ca 

> sad ēva sōmyēdam agra āsīt (chā.6.2.3) 

ity ēvam-ādīny ēva vākyāni। 

**English**—
Now these other means required are, in our case,  
supplied by such texts as  

> 'Being only was this in the beginning,' 

**vi॰pra॰**—
tāni ca  
yathōdita-prakārēṇaiva brahma pratipādayantīti  
tat-pratipāditaṁ brahmākāśa-śabdēna prasiddhavan nirdiśyatē। 

**English**—
and these, as we have shown, establish the existence of Brahman.  
To Brahman thus established, the text mentioning the ether  
merely refers as to something well known. 

##### ākāśābhidhēyatā
**vi॰pra॰**—
sambhavati ca parasya brahmaṇaḥ prakāśakatvād ākāśa-śabdābhidhēyatvam –  
ākāśatē, ākāśayati ca iti ॥

**English**—
Brahman may suitably be called 'ether' (ākāśa),  
because being of the nature of light it shines (ākāśate) itself,  
and makes other things shine forth (ākāśayati). 

**vi॰pra॰**—
kiñca anēnākāśa-śabdēna viśēṣa+++(-artha)+++-samarpaṇa-kṣamēṇāpi  
+++(kāryē jagati)+++ cētanāṁśaṁ praty a-sambhāvita-kāraṇa-bhāvam a-cētana-viśēṣam +++(khākhyam)+++ abhidadhānēna 

**English**—
Moreover, the word 'ether' is indeed capable of conveying the idea of a special being (as cause),  
but as it denotes a special non-intelligent thing which cannot be admitted as the cause of the intelligent part of the world  

**vi॰pra॰**—
> tadaikṣata - bahu syāṁ prajāyēya (chā.6.2.3) 

**English**—
> 'it thought, may I be many, may I grow forth,' 

**vi॰pra॰**—
> sō'kāmayata। bahusyāṁ prajāyēya (tai.āna.6) 

**English**—
and 

> 'it desired, may I be many, may I grow forth.' 

**vi॰pra॰**—
ityādi vākya-śēṣāvadhārita-sārvajñya--satya-saṅkalpatvādi-  
viśiṣṭāpūrvārtha-pratipādana-samartha--vākyārthānyathā-karaṇaṁ  
na pramāṇa-padavīm adhirōhati। 

**English**—
we must deny all authoritativeness to the attempt to tamper,  
in the interest of that one word,  
with the sense of other texts  
which have the power of giving instruction as to an entirely new thing (viz. Brahman),  
distinguished by the possession of omniscience,  
the power of realising its purposes and similar attributes,  
which we ascertain from certain complementary texts-such as (the above).

**vi॰pra॰**—
ēvam apūrvānanta-viśēṣaṇa-viśiṣṭa-- 
+apūrvārtha-pratipādana-samartha-  
+anēka-vākya--gati-sāmānyaṁ ca  
+ēkēnānuvāda--sva-rūpēṇa +++(na tv-apūrvārtha-jñāpakēna)+++  
+anyathā karttuṁ na śakyatē।

**English**—
We also point out that the agreement in purport of a number of texts capable of establishing the existence of a wonderful being possessing infinite wonderful attributes  
is not lightly to be disregarded  
in favour of one single text  
which moreover (has not the power of intimating something not known before, but)  
only makes a reference to what is already established by other texts.

##### ātma-śabdānaikāntyaṁ na

**vi॰pra॰**—
yat tu 

> ātma-śabdaś cētanaikāntō na bhavati,  
mr̥d-ātmakō ghaṭaḥ ity-ādi-darśanād 

ity uktam; tatrōcyatē – 

**English**—
As to the averment that 

> the word 'Self' is not exclusively limited to sentient beings,  

we remark that  

**vi॰pra॰**—
yady api cētanād anyatrāpi kvacid ātma-śabdaḥ prayujyatē; 

**English**—
that word is indeed applied occasionally to non-sentient things, 

**vi॰pra॰**—
tathāpi śarīra-pratisambandhiny ātma-śabdasya prayōga-prācuryāt +++(4)+++

**English**—
but prevailingly to that which is the correlative of a body, i.e. the soul or spirit; 

**vi॰pra॰**—
> ātmā vā idam ēka ēvāgra āsīt (aita.1.1.1) 

**English**—
in texts such as 

> 'the Self only was this in the beginning,' 

**vi॰pra॰**—
> ātmana ākāśas sambhūtaḥ (tai.āna.1.2) 

ity-ādiṣu

**English**—
> 'from the Self there sprang the ether,' 

**vi॰pra॰**—
śarīra-pratisambandhi-cētana ēva pratīyatē। 

**English**—
we must therefore understand by the 'Self,' the universal spirit. 

**vi॰pra॰**—
yathā gō-śabdasyānēkārtha-vācitvē'pi  
prayōga-prācuryāt sāsnādimān ēva svataḥ pratīyatē; 

**vi॰pra॰**—
arthāntara-pratītis tu tat-tad--a-sādhāraṇa-nirdēśāpēkṣā; 

**vi॰pra॰**—
tathā svataḥ prāptaṁ śarīra-pratisambandhi-cētanābhidhānam ēva 

**English**—
The denotative power of the term 'atman,'  
which is thus proved by itself,  

**vi॰pra॰**—
> sa īkṣata - lōkānnu sr̥jā iti (ai.1.1.1), 

**English**—
'it desired, may I send forth the worlds', 

**vi॰pra॰**—
sō'kāmayata, bahu syāṁ prajāyēya (chā.1.9.1) 

**English**—
> 'it desired, may I be many, may I grow forth.'

**vi॰pra॰**—
ity-ādi--tat-tad-vākya-viśēṣā ēva sthirīkurvanti। 

**English**—
is moreover confirmed by the(se) complementary passages 

##### nigamanam
**vi॰pra॰**—
ēvaṁ vākya-śēṣāvadhārita--ananya-sādhāraṇānēkāpūrvārtha-viśiṣṭaṁ 

**English**—
We thus arrive at the following conclusion:  

Brahman, possessing all those manifold wonderful attributes  
which are ascertained from the complementary passages, 

**vi॰pra॰**—
nikhila-jagad-ēka-kāraṇaṁ 

> sad ēva sōmya (chāṁ.6.2.1) 

ityādi-vākya-siddhaṁ brahmaiva  

**English**—
which -- by the passage  

> 'Being only this was in the beginning'--

is established as the sole cause of the world,  

**vi॰pra॰**—
akāśaśabdēna prasiddhavat 

> sarvāṇi ha vā imāni bhūtāni (chāṁ.1.9.1) 

ity-ādi-vākyēna nirdiśyata  
iti siddham ॥ 23॥

**English**—
is, in the text under discussion,  
referred to as something already known,  
by means of the term 'ether.'

**vi॰pra॰**—
**iti śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē ākāśādhikaraṇam ॥ 8 ॥**

**English**—
--Here terminates the adhikaraṇa of' ether.'

### 09 prāṇādhikaraṇam

**॥ śārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē prāṇādhikaraṇam ॥**

**adhikaraṇārthaḥ**—
prāṇatvēnōpāsyaḥ paramātmaiva, na bhūtacaturthō vāyuḥ

#### prāṇavidyā chā.u.1-10,11

24. ata ēva prāṇaḥ ॥ 1-1-24॥

#### viṣayavākyapradarśanam

idamāmnāyatē chāndōgyē – prastōtaryā dēvatā prastāvamanvāyattā (chā.u.1.10.9) iti prastutya, katamā sā dēvatēti prāṇa iti hōvāca sarvāṇi ha vā imāni bhūtāni prāṇamēvābhisaṁviśanti prāṇamabhyujjihatē saiṣā dēvatā prastāvamanvāyattā tāṁ cēdavidvān prāstōṣyō mūrdhā tē vyapatiṣyat (chāṁ.1.11.4,5) iti॥

#### siddhāntārthaḥ

atra prāṇaśabdō'pyākāśaśabdavatprasiddhaprāṇavyatiraktē parasminnēva brahmaṇi vartatē। tadasādhāraṇanikhilajagatpravēśa-niṣkramaṇādiliṅgātprasiddhavarnnirdiṣṭāt ॥

#### adhikaraṇabhēdaprayōjakau śaṅkāparihārau

adhikāśaṅkā tu – kr̥tsnsya bhūtajātasya prāṇādhīnasthitipravr̥ttyādidarśanāt prasiddha ēva prāṇō jagatkāraṇatayā nirdēśamarhāti – iti॥

parihārastu – śilākāṣṭādiṣu cētanasvarūpē ca tadabhāvāt sarvāṇi ha vā imāni bhūtāni prāṇamēvābhisaṁviśanti prāṇamabhyujjihatē (chā.1.11.5) iti nōpapadyata iti। ataḥ prāṇayati sarvāṇi bhūtanīti kr̥tvā paraṁ brahmaiva prāṇaśabdēnābhidhīyatē ॥

#### adhikaraṇadvayārthanigamanam

ataḥ prasiddhākāśaprāṇādēranyadēva nikhilajagadēkakāraṇāpahatapāpmatvasārvajñya-satyasaṅkalpatvādi anantakalyāṇaguṇagaṇaṁ paraṁ brahmaivākāśa prāṇādiśabdābhidhēyamiti siddham॥24॥

**iti śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē prāṇādhikaraṇam ॥ 9 ॥**

### 10 jyōtiradhikaraṇam

**॥ śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē jyōtiradhikaraṇam ॥**

**adhikaraṇārthaḥ**—
jyōtiṣṭvēnōpāsyaṁ, jijñāsyaṁ brahmaiva, na ādityādikam

#### kaukṣēyajyōtirvidyā gāyatrīvidyā ca chā.u. 3-12,13

#### vakṣyamāṇādhikaraṇadvayasya pēṭikāntaratvam

ataḥ paraṁ jagatkāraṇatvavyāptēna yēnakēnāpi niratiśayōtkr̥ṣṭaguṇēna juṣṭaṁ jyōtirindrādiśabdairarthāntaraprasiddhairapyabhidhīyamānaṁ paraṁ brahmaivētyabhidhīyatē – jyōtiścaraṇābhidhānāt ityādinā

25. jyōtiścaraṇābhidhānāt ॥ 1-1-25 ॥

#### viṣayavākyapradarśanam

idamāmnāyatē chāndōgyē – atha yadataḥ parō divō jyōtirdīpyatē viśvataḥ pr̥ṣṭhēṣu sarvataḥ pr̥ṣṭhēṣvanuttamēṣūttamēṣu lōkēṣvidaṁ vāva tadyadidamasminnantaḥ puruṣē jyōtiḥ (chā.3.13.7) iti ॥

#### adhikaraṇāṅgabhūtaḥ saṁśayaḥ

tatra saṁśayaḥ – kimayaṁ jyōtiśśabdēna nirdiṣṭō niratiśayadīptiyuktō'rthaḥ prasiddhamādityādijyōtirēva kāraṇabhūtaṁ brahma, uta samastacidacidvastujātavisajātīyaḥ paramakāraṇabhūtō'mitabhāssarvajñaḥ satyasaṅkalpaḥ puruṣōttamaḥ – iti ॥

#### sayuktikaṁ pūrvapakṣasvarūpam

kiṁ yuktam? prasiddhamēva jyōtiriti। kutaḥ prasiddhavannirdēśē'pyākāśaprāṇādivat svavākyōpāttaparamātmavyāptaliṅgaviśēṣādarśanāt, paramapuruṣa-pratyabhijñānāsambhavāt, kaukṣēyajyōtiṣā aikyōpadēśācca prasiddhamēva jyōtiḥ kāraṇatvavyāptaniratiśayadīptiyōgājjagatkāraṇaṁ brahmēti ॥

#### siddhāntasvarūpam

ēvaṁ prāptē pracakṣmahē jyōtiścaraṇābhidhānāt – dyusambandhitayā nirdiṣṭaṁ niratiśayadīptiyuktaṁ jyōtiḥ paramapuruṣa ēva। kutaḥ pādō'sya sarvā bhūtāni tripādasyāmr̥taṁ divi (chāṁ.3.12.6) ityasyaiva dyusambandhinaścaraṇatvēna sarvabhūtābhidhānāt॥

ētaduktaṁ bhavati – yadyapi atha yadataḥ parō divō jyōtiḥ (chā.3.13.7) ityasminvākyē paramapuruṣāsādhāraṇaliṅgaṁ nōpalabhyatē; tathāpi pūrvavākyē dyusambandhitayā paramapuruṣasya nirdēśādidamapi dyusambandhijyōtissa ēvēti pratyabhijñāyata iti। kaukṣēyajyōtiṣaikyōpadēśaśca phalāya tadātmakatvānusandhānavidhiriti na kaściddōṣaḥ। kaukṣēyajyōtiṣaśca tadātmakatvaṁ bhagavatā svayamēvōktam ahaṁ vaiśvānarō bhūtvā prāṇināṁ dēhamāśritaḥ (bha.gī.15.14) iti॥

26. chandōbhidhānānnēti cēnna tathā cētōrpaṇanigamāttathā hi darśanam ॥ 1-1-26 ॥

pūrvasminvākyē gāyatrī vā idaṁ sarvam (chāṁ.3.12.1) iti gāyatryākhyaṁ chandō'bhidhāya tadētadr̥cā'bhyanūktam (chā.3-12-5) ityudāhr̥tāyāḥ tāvānasya mahimā (chāṁ.3.12.6) ityasyā r̥cō'pi chandōviṣayatvānnātra paramapuruṣābhidhānamiti cēt –

tanna, tathā cētōrpaṇanigamāt na gāyatrīśabdēna chandōmātramihābhidhīyatē, chandōmātrasya sarvātmakatvānupapattēḥ, api tu brahmaṇa ēva gāyatrīcētōrpaṇamiha nigamyatē। brahmaṇi gāyatrīsādr̥śyānusandhānaṁ phalāyōpadiśyata ityarthaḥ । sambhavati ca pādō'sya sarvā bhūtāni। tripādasyāmr̥taṁ divi (chā.3.12.6) iti catuṣpadō brahmaṇaścatuṣpadayā gāyatryā ca sādr̥śyam। catuṣpadā ca gāyatrī kvaciddr̥śyatē। tadyathā indraśśacīpatiḥ। balēna pīḍitaḥ। duścyavanō vr̥ṣā। samitsusāsahiḥ iti। tathā hyanyatrāpi sādr̥śyācchandōbhidhāyī śabdō'rthāntarē prayujyamānō dr̥śyatē। yathā saṁvargavidyāyāṁ tē vā ētē pañcānyē pañcānyē daśa sampadyanta ityārabhya saiṣā virāḍannāt (chā.4.3.8) ityucyatē॥ 26॥

itaśca gāyatrīśabdēna brahmaivābhidhīyatē –

27. bhūtādipādavyapadēśōpapattēścaivam ॥ 1-1-27 ॥

#### yōgyatāyāḥ arthanirṇāyakatvam

bhūtapr̥thivīśarīrahr̥dayāni nirdiśya saiṣā catuṣpadā (chā.3.12.5) iti vyapadēśō brahmaṇyēva gāyatrīśabdābhidhēya upapadyatē।

28. upadēśabhēdānnēti cēnnōbhayasminnapyavirōdhāt ॥ 1-1-28 ॥

#### upadēśākāravailakṣaṇyataḥ pūrvōttaravākyayōḥ anaikārthyam iti śaṅkā, tatparihāraśca

pūrvavākyē tripādasyāmr̥taṁ divi (chāṁ.6.12.6) iti divaḥ adhikaraṇatvēna nirdēśādiha ca divaḥ para ityavadhitvēna nirdēśādupadēśasya bhinnarūpatvēna pūrvavākyōktaṁ brahma parasminna pratyabhijñāyata iti cēt – tanna, ubhayasminnapi upadēśē arthasvabhāvaikyēna pratyabhijñāyā avirōdhāt; yathā vr̥kṣāgrē śyēnō vr̥kṣāgrātparataśśyēnaḥ iti। tasmātparamapuruṣa ēva niratiśayatējaskō divaḥ parō jyōtirdīpyata iti pratipādyatē ॥

#### adhikaraṇārthanigamanam

ētāvānasya mahimā। atō jyāyāṁśca puruṣaḥ। pādō'sya viśvābhūtāni। tripādasyāmr̥taṁ divi (yaju.āra.3.12) iti pratipāditasya catuṣpadaḥ paramapuruṣasya vēdāhamētaṁ puruṣaṁ mahāntam। ādityavarṇaṁ tamasstu pārē (tē.āra.3.12) ityabhihitāprākr̥tarūpasya tējō'pyaprākr̥tamiti tadvattayā sa ēva jyōtiśśabdābhidhēya iti niravadyam॥

**iti śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē jyōtiradhikaraṇam॥10॥**

### 11 indraprāṇādhikaraṇam

**śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē indraprāṇādhikaraṇam॥11॥**

**(adhikaraṇārthaḥ – indratvēnōpāsyaḥ, na tu śacīpatirindraḥ**

#### pratardanavidyā (kauṣī.u.3)

#### avāntarasaṅgatiḥ

niratiśayadīptiyuktaṁ jyōtiśśabdābhidhēyaṁ prasiddhavannirdiṣṭaṁ paramapuruṣa ēvētyuktam। idānīṁ kāraṇatvavyāptāmr̥tatvaprāptyupāyatayōpāsyatvēna śruta indraprāṇādiśabdābhidhēyō'pi paramapuruṣa ēvētyāha

29. prāṇastathā'nugamāt ॥ 1-1-29 ॥

**(viṣayavākyapratipādanaṁ**

kauṣītakībrāhmaṇē pratardanavidyāyāṁ pratardanō ha vai daivōdāsirindrasya priyaṁ dhāmōpajagāma yuddhēna ca pauruṣēṇa ca (kau.3-1) ityārabhya varaṁ vr̥ṇīṣva (kau.3.1) iti vaktāramindraṁ prati tvamēva mē varaṁ vr̥ṇīṣva yaṁ tva manuṣyāya hitatamaṁ manyasē (kau.3.1) iti pratardanēnōktē sa hōvāca prāṇō'smi prajñātmā taṁ māmāyuramr̥tamityupāssva (kau.3.1) iti śrūyatē ॥

#### adhikaraṇāṅgabhūtaḥ saṁśayaḥ

tatra saṁśayaḥ – kimayaṁ hitatamōpāsanakarmatayēndraprāṇaśabdanirdiṣṭō jīva ēva; uta tadatiriktaḥ paramātmā iti।

#### sayuktikaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ

kiṁ yuktam, jīva ēvēti। kutaḥ? indraśabdasya jīvaviśēṣa ēva prasiddhēḥ, tatsamānādhikaraṇasya prāṇaśabdasyāpi tatraiva vr̥ttēḥ। ayamindrābhidhānō jīvaḥ pratardanēna tvamēva mē varaṁ vr̥ṇīṣva yaṁ tvaṁ manuṣyāya hitatamaṁ manyasē (kau.3.1) ityuktaḥ māmupāsva (kau.3.1) iti svātmōpāsanaṁ hitatamamupadidēśa। hitatamaścāmr̥tatvaprāptyupāya ēva। jagatkāraṇōpāsanasyaiva amr̥tatvaprāptihētutā tasya tāvadēva ciraṁ yāvanna vimōkṣyē atha sampatsyē (chā.6.14.2) ityavagatā। ataḥ prasiddhajīvabhāva indra ēva kāraṇaṁ braha – ityāśaṅkāyām

#### siddhāntārambhaḥ

abhidhīyatē prāṇastathānugamāt – iti; ayamindraprāṇaśabdanirdiṣṭō na jīvamātram, api tu jīvādarthāntarabhūtaṁ paraṁ brahma। sa ēṣa prāṇa ēva prajñātmā ānandō'jarōmr̥taḥ (kau.3.1) itīndraprāṇaśabdābhyāṁ prastutasyā'nandajarāmr̥taśabda sāmānādhikaraṇyēnānugamō hi tathā satyēvōpapadyatē ॥29॥

#### uktasya siddhāntasyārthasya ākṣēpapūrvakaṁ sthirīkaraṇam

30. na vakturātmōpēdaśāditi cēdadhyātmasambandhabhūmā hyasmin ॥ 1-1-30 ॥

#### siddhāntinaṁ prati madhyē pūrvapakṣaḥ, samādhānaṁ ca

yaduktamindraprāṇaśabdanirdiṣṭasya ānandō'jarō'mr̥taḥ (kau.3.9) ityanēnaikārthyādayaṁ paraṁ brahmēti tat nōpapadyatē, māmēva vijānīhi (kau.3.1), prāṇō'smi prajñātmā taṁ māmāyuramr̥tamityupāssva (kau.3.1) iti vaktā hīndraḥ triśīrṣāṇaṁ tvāṣṭramahanam (kau.3.1) ityēvamādinā tvāṣṭravadhādibhiḥ prajñātajīvabhāvasya svātmana ēvōpāsyatāṁ pratardanāyōpadiśati। ata upakramē jīviviśēṣa ityavagatē sati ānandō'jarō'mr̥taḥ (kau.3.9) ityādibhirupasaṁhārastadanuguṇa ēva varṇanīya iti cēt –

pariharati- adhyātmasambandhabhūmā hyasman – ātmani yassambandhassō'dhyātmasambandhaḥ। tasya bhūmā – bhūyastvam – bahutvamityarthaḥ। ātmanyādhēyatayā sambadhyamānānāṁ bahutvēna sambandhabahutvam। taccāsminvaktari paramātmanyēva hi sambhavati। tadyathā rathasyārēṣu nēmirarpitā nābhāvarā arpitā ēvamēvaitā bhūtamātrāḥ prajñāmātrāsvarpitāḥ prajñāmātrāḥ prāṇē'rpitāssa ēṣa prāṇa ēva prajñātmā'jarō'mr̥taḥ (kau.3.9) iti bhūtamātrāśabdēnācētanavastujātamabhidhāya prajñāmātrāśabdēna tadādhāratayā cētanavargaṁ cābhidhāya tasyāpyādhāratayā prakr̥tamindraprāṇaśabdābhidhēyaṁ nirdiśya tamēva ānandō'jarō'mr̥taḥ, (kau.3.9) ityupadiśati। tadētaccētanācētanātmakakr̥tsnavastvādhāratvaṁ jīvādarthāntarabhūtē'smin paramātmanyēvōpapadyata ityarthaḥ।

#### mukhāntarēṇa yōjanam

athavā adhyātmasambandhabhūmā hyasmin
paramātmāsādhāraṇadharmasambandhō'dhyātmasambandhaḥ। tasya bhūmā bahutvaṁ hi asmin prakaraṇē vidyatē। tathā hi – prathamaṁ tvamēva mē varaṁ vr̥ṇīṣva yaṁ tvaṁ manuṣyāya hitatamaṁ manyasē (kau.3.9) iti māmupāssva (kau.3.9) iti ca paramātmāsādhāraṇamōkṣasādhānōpāsanakarmatvaṁ prāṇaśabdanirdiṣṭasyēndrasya pratīyatē। tathā ēṣa ēva sādhu karma kārayati taṁ yamēbhyō lōkēbhya unninīṣati ēṣa ēvāsādhu karma kārayati taṁ yamadhō ninīṣati, (kau.3.9) iti sarvasya karmaṇaḥ kārayitr̥tvaṁ ca paramātmadharmaḥ। tathā tadyathā rathasyārēṣu nēmirarpitā nābhāvarā
arpitāḥ ēvamēvaitā bhūtamātrāḥ prajñāmātrāsvarpitāḥ prajñāmātrāḥ prāṇē'rpitāḥ (kau.3.9) iti sarvādhāratvaṁ ca tasyaiva dharmaḥ। tathā sa ēṣa prāṇa ēva prajñātmā'nandō'jarō'mr̥taḥ (kau.3.9) ityētē'pi paramātmana ēva dharmāḥ।
ēṣa lōkādhipatirēṣa sarvēśaḥ (kōṣī.3.9) iti ca paramātmanyēva sambhavati। tadēvamadhyātmasambandhabhūmnō'tra vidyamānatvātparamātmaivātrēndraprāṇaśabdanirdiṣṭaḥ॥30॥

#### indrēṇa svātmanaḥ upāsyatvōpadēśasāṅgatyam

kathaṁ tarhi prajñātajīvabhāvasyēndrasya svātmana upāsyatvōpadēśassaṅgacchatē; tatrāha-

31. śāstradr̥ṣṭyā tūpadēśō vāmadēvavat ॥ 1-1-31 ॥

prajñātajīvabhāvēnēndrēṇa māmēva vijānīhi (kau.3.1.) māmupāssva (kau.3.1.) ityupāsyasya brahmaṇassvātmatvēnōpadēśō'yaṁ na pramāṇāntaraprāptasvātmāvalōkanakr̥taḥ, apitu śāstrēṇa svātmadr̥ṣṭikr̥taḥ ॥

#### jīvavāciśabdānāṁ paramātmaparyantatvasamarthanam

ētaduktaṁ bhavati – anēna jīvēnā'tmanā'nupraviśya nāmarūpē vyākaravāṇi (chā.6.3.2), aitadātmyamidaṁ sarvam (chāṁ.6.8.7), antaḥpraviṣṭaśśāstājanānāṁ sarvātmā (yaju.āra), ya ātmani tiṣṭhannātmanō'ntarō yamātmā na vēda yasyā'tmā śarīraṁ ya ātmānamantarō yamayati (br̥.5.7.22), ēṣa sarvabhūtāntarātmā apahatapāpmā divyō dēva ēkō nārāyaṇaḥ (subāla.7) ityēvamādinā śāstrēṇa jīvātmaśarīrakaṁ paramātmānamavagamya jīvātmavācinām ahantvamādiśabdānāmapi paramātmanyēva paryavasānaṁ jñātvā māmēva vijānīhi (kauṣī.3.9) māmupāssva (kau.3.1) iti svātmaśarīrakaṁ paramātmānamēvōpāsyatvēnōpadidēśa – iti। vāmadēvavat – yathā vāmadēvaḥ parasya brahmaṇaḥ sarvāntarātmatvaṁ sarvasya ca taccharīratvaṁ śarīravācināṁ ca śabdānāṁ śarīriṇi paryavasānaṁ paśyan aham iti svātmaśarīrakaṁ paraṁ brahma nirdiśya tatsāmānādhikaraṇyēna manusūryādīn vyapadiśati taddhaitatpaśyannr̥ṣirvāmadēvaḥ pratipēdē ahaṁ manurabhavaṁ sūryaścāhaṁ kakṣīvānr̥ṣirasmi vipraḥ (br̥.3.4.10) ityādinā। yathā ca prahlādaḥ sarvagatvādanantasya sa ēvāhamavasthitaḥ। mattassarvamahaṁ sarvaṁ mayi sarvaṁ sanātanē (vi.pu.1.19.89) ityādi vadati॥31॥

asmin prakaraṇē jīvavācibhiśśabdairacidviśēṣābhidhāyibhiścōpāsyabhūtasya parasya brahmaṇō'bhidhānē kāraṇaṁ cōdyapūrvakamāha –

32. jīvamukhyaprāṇaliṅgānnēti cēnnōpāsātraividhyādāśritatvādiha tadyōgāt ॥ 1-1-32 ॥

na vācaṁ vijijñāsīta vaktāraṁ vidyāt (kau.1.8), triśīrṣāṇaṁ tvāṣṭramahanam arunmukhānyatīn sālāvr̥kēbhyaḥ prāyaccham (kauṣī 3.1) ityādijīvaliṅgāt, yāvadasmin śarīrē prāṇō vasati tāvadāyuḥ (kau.3.1) atha khalu prāṇa ēva prajñātmēdaṁ śarīraṁ parigr̥hyōtthāpayati (kau.3.1) iti mukhyaprāṇaliṅgācca nādhyātmasambandhabhūmēti cēt – na, upāsātraividhyāt hētōḥ upāsanātraividhyamupadēṣṭuṁ tattacchabdēnābhidhānam – nikhilakāraṇabhūtasya brahmaṇassvarūpēṇānusandhānam, bhōktr̥vargaśarīrakatvānusandhānaṁ bhōgyabhōgōpakaraṇaśarīrakatvānusandhānaṁ cēti trividhamanusandhānam upadēṣṭumityarthaḥ। tadidaṁ trividhaṁ brahmānusandhānaṁ prakaraṇāntarēṣvapyāśritaṁ satyaṁ jñānamanantaṁ brahma (tai.āna.1) ānandō brahma (tai.bhr̥.6.anu) ityādiṣu svarūpānusandhānam; tatsr̥ṣṭvā tadēvānuprāviśat, tadanupraviśya, saccatyaccābhavat, niruktaṁ cāniruktaṁ ca, nilayanaṁ cānilayanaṁ ca, vijñānaṁ cāvijñānaṁ ca, satyaṁ cānr̥taṁ ca satyamabhavat (tai.ana.6.2) ityādiṣu bhōktr̥śarīratayā, bhōgyabhōgōpakāraṇaśarīratayā cānusandhānam। ihāpi prakaraṇē tat trividhamanusandhānaṁ yujyata ēvētyarthaḥ।

#### viśiṣṭōpāsanaparatācihnapradarśanam

ētaduktaṁ bhavati – yatra hiraṇyagarbhādijīvaviśēṣāṇāṁ prakr̥tyādyacētanaviśēṣāṇāṁ ca paramātmāsādhāraṇa-dharmayōgaḥ tadabhidhāyināṁ śabdānāṁ paramātmavāciśabdaissāmānādhikaraṇyaṁ vā dr̥śyatē; tatra paramātmanaḥ tattaccidacidviśēṣāntarātmatvānusandhānaṁ pratipipādayiṣitam – iti।

atō'trēndraprāṇaśabdanirdiṣṭō jīvādarthāntarabhūtaḥ paramātmaivēti
siddham॥ 32॥

**iti śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē indraprāṇādhikaraṇam॥11॥**

**iti śrībhagavadrāmānujaviracitē śārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē prathamasyādhyāyasya prathamaḥpādaḥ ॥1॥**

## +2 aspaṣṭa-jīvādi-liṅgakaḥ

### 12 sarvatraprasiddhyadhikaraṇam

**atha śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē prathamē samanvayādhyāyē**

#### anyayōgavyavacchēdatripādī

**dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ**

**sarvatraprasiddhyadhikaraṇam ॥1॥**

#### aspaṣṭajīvādiliṅgakavēdāntavākyavicārarūpaḥ

#### pādārthaḥ – paramātmanaḥ sarvaśarīrakatvam

#### pūrvapādīyaḥ jijñāsādhikaraṇārthaḥ

prathamē pādē adhītavēdaḥ puruṣaḥ karmamīmāṁsāśravaṇādhigatakarmayāthātmyajñānaḥ kēvalakarmaṇām alpāsthiraphalatvamavagamya, vēdāntavākyēṣu cāpātapratītānantasthiraphalabrahmasvarūpa tadupāsanasamupa-jātaparamapuruṣārthalakṣaṇamōkṣāpēkṣō'vadhāritapariniṣpannavastubōdhanaśabdaśaktiḥ vēdāntavākyānāṁ parasmin brahmaṇi niścitapramāṇabhāvastaditikartavyatārūpaśārīrakamīmāṁsā-śravaṇamārabhētētyuktaṁ śāstrārambhasiddhayē ॥1॥

#### janmādyadhikaraṇārthaḥ

anantavicitrasthiratrasarūpabhōktr̥bhōgyabhōgōpakaraṇabhōgasthānalakṣaṇanikhilajagadudayavibhavalaya-mahānandaikakāraṇaṁ paraṁ brahma yatō vā imāni ityādivākyaṁ bōdhayatīti ca pratyapādi॥2॥

#### śāstrayōnitvādhikaraṇārthaḥ

jagadēkakāraṇaṁ paraṁ brahma sakalētarapramāṇāviṣayatayā śāstraikapramāṇakamityabhyadhāma॥3॥

#### samanvayādhikaraṇārthaḥ

śāstrapramāṇakatvaṁ ca brahma pravr̥ttinivr̥ttyanvayavirahē'pi svarūpēṇaiva paramapuruṣārthabhūtē parasmin brahmaṇi vēdāntavākyānāṁ samanvayānniruhyata ityabrūma॥4॥

#### īkṣatyadhikaraṇārthaḥ

nikhilajagadēkakāraṇatayā vēdāntavēdyaṁ brahma ca īkṣaṇādyanvayādānumānika-pradhānādarthāntarabhūtaḥ cētanaviśēṣa ēvētyupāpīpadāma॥ 5॥

#### ānandamayādhikaraṇārthaḥ

sa ca svābhāvikānavadhikātiśayānandavipaścittvanikhilacētanabhayābhayahētutvasatyasaṅkalpatva-samasta-cētanācētanāntarātmatvādibhirbaddhamuktōbhayāvasthājjīva śabdāābhilapanīyāccārthāntarabhūta iti ca samārtithāmahi॥6॥

#### antaradhikaraṇārthaḥ

sa cāprākr̥tākarmanimittasvāsādhāraṇadivyarūpa ityudairirāma॥ 7॥

#### ākāśādhikaraṇārthaḥ

ākāśaprāṇādyacētanaviśēṣābhidhāyibhirjagatkāraṇatayā prasiddhavannirdiśyamānaḥ sakalētaracētana-acētanavilakṣaṇassa ēvēti samagariṣmahi॥ 8॥

#### jyōtiradhikaraṇārthaḥ

paratattvāsādhāraṇaniratiśayadīptiyuktajyōtiśśabdābhidhēyō dyusambandhitayā pratyabhijñānātsa ēvētyātiṣṭhāmahi॥ 9 ॥

#### indraprāṇādhikaraṇārthaḥ

paramakāraṇasādhāraṇāmr̥tatvaprāptihētubhūtaḥ paramapuruṣa ēva śāstradr̥ṣṭyēndrādiśabdairabhidhīyata ityabrūmahi ॥10॥

#### āhatya prathamapādārthasāraḥ

tadēvamatipatitasakalētarapramāṇasambhāvanābhūmissārvajñyasatyasaṅkalpatvādyaparimitōdāraguṇasāgaratayā svētarasamastavastuvilakṣaṇaḥ paraṁ brahma puruṣōttamō nārāyaṇa ēva vēdāntavēdya ityuktam॥11॥

#### anantaratripādyā arthaḥ

ataḥ paraṁ dvitīyatr̥tīyacaturthēṣu pādēṣu yadyapi vēdāntavēdyaṁ brahmaiva, tathāpi kānicidvēdāntavākyāni pradhānakṣētrajñāntarbhūtavastuviśēṣasvarūpapratipādanaparāṇyēvētyāśaṅkaya tannirasanamukhēna tattadvākyōditakalyāṇaguṇākaratvaṁ brahmaṇaḥ pratipādyatē।

#### tripādyāmapi pratipādam arthasāraḥ

tatrāspaṣṭajīvādiliṅgakāni vākyāni dvitīyē pādē vicāryantē; spaṣṭaliṅgakāni tr̥tīyē, tattatpratipādanacchāyānusārīṇi caturthē॥

33. sarvatra prasiddhōpadēśāt ॥ 1-2-1 ॥

(adhikaraṇārthaḥ – brahmaṇa ēva sarvātmabhāvēnāvasthānam)

(śāṇḍilyavidyā chā.u.3.14)

idamāmnāyatē chāndōgyē – atha khalu kratumayaḥ puruṣō yathākraturasmiṁllōkē puruṣō bhavati tathētaḥ prētya bhavati sa kratuṁ kurvīta manōmayaḥ prāṇaśarīrō bhārūpaḥ (chā.3.14.1) ityādi॥

#### jijñāsyō viṣayaḥ

atra sa kratuṁ kurvīta (chā.3.14.1) iti pratipāditasyōpāsanasyōpāsyaḥ manōmayaḥ prāṇaśarīraḥ (chā.3.14.1) iti nirdiśyata iti pratīyatē ॥

#### saṁśayākāraḥ

tatra saṁśayaḥ – kiṁ manōmayatvādiguṇakaḥ kṣētrajñaḥ; uta paramātmā – iti ॥

#### pūrvapakṣasvarūpam

kiṁ yuktam? kṣētrajña iti। kutaḥ? manaḥprāṇayōḥ kṣētrajñōpakaraṇatvāt, paramātmanastu aprāṇō hyamanāḥ (muṁ.2.1.2) iti tatpratiṣēdhācca। na ca sarvaṁ khalvidaṁ brahma (chāṁ.3.14.1) iti pūrvanirdiṣṭaṁ brahmātrōpāsyatayā sambaddhuṁ śakyatē, śānta upāsīta (chāṁ.3.14.1) ityupāsanōpakaraṇaśānti-nirvr̥ttyupāyabhūtabrahmātmakatvōpadēśāyōpāttatvāt ॥

#### siddhāntamāśaṅkya pūrvapakṣasthirīkaraṇam

na ca sa kratuṁ kurvīta (chāṁ.3.14.1) ityupāsanasyōpāsyasākāṅkṣatvādvākyāntarasthamapi brahma sambadhyata iti yuktaṁ vaktum, svavākyōpāttēna manōmayatvādiguṇakēna nirākāṅkṣatvāt; manōmayaḥ prāṇaśarīraḥ (chāṁ.3.14.1) ityananyārthatayā nirdiṣṭasya vibhaktivipariṇāmamātrēṇa ubhayākāṅkṣānivr̥ttisiddhēḥ। ēvaṁ niścitē jīvatvē ētadbrahma (chāṁ.3.14.1) ityupasaṁhārastha-brahmapadamapi jīva ēva pūjārthaṁ prayuktamityadhyavasīyata iti॥

#### siddhāntārambhaḥ

ēvaṁ prāptē brūmaḥ- sarvatra prasiddhōpadēśāt

#### sūtrārthavivaraṇam

nōmayatvādiguṇakaḥ paramātmā kutaḥ sarvatra – vēdāntēṣu parasminnēva brahmaṇi prasiddhasya manōmayatvādērupadēśāt। prasiddhaṁ hi manōmayatvādi brahmaṇaḥ। yathā manōmayaḥ prāṇaśarīranētā (muṁ.2.2.7) sa ēṣō'ntarhr̥ādaya ākāśaḥ। tasminnayaṁ puruṣō manōmayaḥ। amr̥tō hiraṇmayaḥ (tai.śikṣā 6.3) hr̥dā manīṣā manasā'bhiklr̥ptō ya ēnaṁ viduramr̥tāstē bhavanti (tai.nārā.3) na cakṣuṣā gr̥hyatē nāpi vācā (mu.3.1.8), manasā tu viśuddhēna tathā prāṇasya prāṇaḥ (kēna.1.2), atha khalu prāṇa ēva prajñātmēdaṁ śarīraṁ parigr̥hyōtthāpayati (kauṣī.3.2), sarvāṇi ha vā imāni bhūtāni prāṇamēvābhisaṁviśanti prāṇamabhyujjihatē (chāṁ.1.11.5) ityādiṣu ॥

#### paramātmani manaḥprāṇasambandhōpapādanam

manōmayatvaṁ – viśuddhēna manasā grāhyatvam। prāṇaśarīratvaṁ – prāṇasyāpyādhāratvaṁ niyantr̥tvaṁ ca। ēvaṁ ca sati ēṣa ma ātmā'rntahr̥daya ētadbrahma (chā.3.14.4) iti brahmaśabdō'pi mukhya ēva bhavati। aprāṇō hyamanāḥ (mu.2.1.2) iti mana āyattaṁ jñānaṁ prāṇāyattāṁ sthitiṁ ca brahmaṇō niṣēdhati।

#### svābhimatā adhikaraṇayōjanā, tatra jijñāyaviṣayanirdēśaḥ

athavā sarvaṁ khalvidaṁ brahma tajjalāniti śānta upāsīta (chā.3.14.1) ityatraivōpāsanaṁ vidhīyatē – sarvātmakaṁ brahma śāntassannupāsītēti। sa kratuṁ kurvīta (chā.3.14.1) iti tasyaiva guṇōpādanārthō'nuvādaḥ। upādēyāśca guṇā manōmayatvādayaḥ; yatassarvātmakaṁ brahma manōmayatvādiguṇakamupāsītēti vākyārthaḥ ॥

#### saṁśayasvarūpanirdēśaḥ

tatra sandēhaḥ – kimiha brahmaśabdēna pratyagātmā nirdiśyatē; uta paramātmā – iti।

#### sayuktikaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ

kiṁ yuktam? pratyagātmēti। kutaḥ? tasyaiva sarvapadasāmānādhikaraṇyanirdēśōpapattēḥ। sarvaśabdanirdiṣṭaṁ hi brahmādistambaparyantaṁ kr̥tsnaṁ jagat। brahmādibhāvaśca pratyagātmanō'nādyavidyāmūlakarmaviśēṣōpādhikō vidyata ēva; parasya tu brahmaṇassarvajñasya sarvaśaktērapahatapāpmanō nirastasamastāvidyādidōṣagandhasya samastahēyākarasarvabhāvō nōpapadyatē ॥

#### jīvē brahmaśabdaprayōgōpapattiḥ

pratyagātmanyapi kvacitkvacidbrahmaśabdaḥ prayujyatē। ata ēva paramātmā paraṁ brahmēti paramēśvarasya kvacitsaviśēṣaṇō nirdēśaḥ। pratyagātmanaśca nirmuktōpādhērbr̥hatvaṁ ca vidyatē sa cānantyāya kalpatē (śvē.5.9) iti śrutēḥ। aviduṣastasyaiva karmanimittatvājjanmasthitilayānāṁ tajjalāniti hētunirdēśō'pyupapadyatē। tadayamarthaḥ – ayaṁ jīvātmā svatō'paricchinnasvarūpatvēna brahmabhūtassannanādyavidyayā dēvatiryaṅmanuṣyasthāvarātmanā'vatiṣṭhatē- iti।

#### siddhāntasvarūpam

atra pratividhīyatē – sarvatra prasiddhōpadēśāt – sarvatra – sarva khalvidam (chā.3.14.1) iti nirdiṣṭē sarvasmin jagati brahmaśabdēna tadātmatayā vidhīyamānaṁ paraṁ brahmaiva, na pratyagātmā। kutaḥ? prasiddhōpadēśāt, tajjalān (chāṁ.3.14.1) iti hētutaḥ sarvaṁ khalvidaṁ brahma iti prasiddhavadupadēśāt। brahmaṇō jātatvād brahmaṇi līnatvādbrahmādhīnajīvanatvācca hētōrbrahmātmakaṁ sarvaṁ khalvidaṁ jagadityuktē yasmājjagajjanmasthitilayā vēdāntēṣu prasiddhāstadēvātra brahmēti pratīyatē ॥

#### sūtrōktārthōpapādanam

tacca paramēva brahma; tathā hi yatō vā imāni bhūtāni jāyantē, yēna jātāni jīvanti, yatprayantyabhisaṁviśanti, tadvijijñāsasva tadbrahma (tai.bhr̥.1) ityupakramya ānandō brahmēti vyajānāt, ānandāddhyēva khalvimāni bhūtāni jāyantē (tai.bhr̥.6) ityādinā pūrvānuvākapratipādita- anavadhikātiśayānandayōginō vipiścataḥ parasmādbrahmaṇa ēva jagadutpattisthitalayā nirdiśyantē; tathā sa kāraṇaṁ karaṇādhipādhipō na cāsya kaścijjanitā na cādhipaḥ (śvē.6.9) iti karaṇādhipasya jīvasyādhipaḥ paraṁ brahmaiva kāraṇaṁ vyapadiśyatē। ēvaṁ sarvatra parasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ kāraṇatvaṁ prasiddham ॥

#### jagadbrahmaṇōḥ tādātmyasya sthirīkaraṇam

ataḥ parabrahmaṇō jātatvāttasmin pralīnatvāttēna prāṇanāttadātmakatayā tādātmyamupapannam।atassarvaprakāraṁ sarvaśarīraṁ sarvātmabhūtaṁ paraṁ brahma śāntō bhūtvōpāsītēti śrutirēva parasya brahmaṇassarvātmakatvamupapādya tasyōpāsanamupadiśati। paraṁ brahma hi kāraṇāvasthaṁ kāryāvasthaṁ sūkṣmasthūlacidacidvastuśarīratayā sarvadā sarvātmabhūtam ॥

#### lakṣaṇataḥ sarvatādātmyē'pyapuruṣārthāsaṁsparśaḥ

ēvambhūtatādātmyasya pratipādanē parasya brahmaṇassakalahēyapratyanīkakalyāṇaguṇākaratvaṁ na virudhyatē, prakārabhūtaśarīragatānāṁ dōṣāṇāṁ prakāriṇyātmanyaprasaṅgāt, pratyuta niratiśayaiśvaryāpādanēna guṇāyaiva bhavatīti pūrvamēvōktam॥

#### jīvasya sarvatādātmyāyōgaḥ

yaduktaṁ jīvasya sarvatādātmyamupapadyata iti; tadasat, jīvānāṁ pratiśarīraṁ bhinnānāmanyōnya-tādātmyāsambhavāt। muktasyāpyanavacchinnasvarūpasyāpi jagattādātmyaṁ jagajjanmasthiti-pralayakāraṇatvanimittaṁ na sambhavatīti jagadvyāpāravarjam (śārī.4.4.17) ityatra vakṣyatē । jīvakarmanimittatvāt jagajjanmasthitilayānāṁ sa ēva kāraṇamityapi na sādhīyaḥ, tatkarmanimittatvē'pi śvarasyaiva jagatkāraṇatvāt ॥

#### sūtrārthōpasaṁhāraḥ

ataḥ paramātmaivā'tra brahmaśabdābhidhēyaḥ। imamēva sūtrārthamabhiyuktā bahumanvatē। yathāha vr̥ttikāraḥ – sarvaṁ khalviti sarvātmā brahmēśaḥ iti॥ 1॥

#### śrutyuktaguṇayōgasya brahmaṇi sarvatādātmyōpapādakatvam

34. vivikṣataguṇōpapattēśca ॥ 1-2-2 ॥

vakṣyamāṇāśca guṇāḥ paramātmanyēvōpapadyantē manōmayaḥ prāṇaśarīrō bhārūpassatyasaṅkalpa ākāśātmā sarvakarmā sarvakāmassarvagandhassarvarasassarvamidamabhyāttō'vākyanādaraḥ (chāṁ.3.14.2) iti। manōmayaḥ – pariśuddhēna manasaikēna grāhyaḥ; vivēkavimōkādisādhanasaptakānugr̥hīta-paramātmōpāsananirmalīkr̥tēna hi manasā gr̥hyatē। anēna hēyapratyanīkakalyāṇaikatānatayā sakalētaravilakṣaṇasvarūpatōcyatē; malinamanōbhirmalinānāmēva grāhyatvāt। prāṇaśarīraḥ – jagati sarvēṣāṁ prāṇānāṁ dhārakaḥ। prāṇō yasya śarīram ādhēyaṁ vidhēyaṁ śēṣabhūtaṁ ca sa prāṇaśarīraḥ। ādhēyatvavidhēyatvaśēṣatvāni śarīraśabdapravr̥ttinimittānī- tyupapādayiṣyatē। bhārūpaḥ – bhāsvararūpaḥ; aprākr̥tasvāsādhāraṇaniratiśayakalyāṇadivyarūpatvēna niratiśayadīptiyukta ityarthaḥ। satyasaṅkalpaḥ – apratihatasaṅkalpaḥ। ākāśātmā – ākāśavatsūkṣmasvacchasvarūpaḥ; sakalētarakāraṇabhūtasya ākāśasyāpyātmabhūta iti vā ākāśātmā; svayaṁ ca prakāśatē anyānapi prakāśayatīti vā ākāśātmā। sarvakarmā kriyata iti karma; sarvaṁ jagadyasya karma, asau sarvakarmā; sarvā vā kriyā yasyāsau sarvakarmā। sarvakāmaḥ – kāmyanta iti kāmāḥ- bhōgyabhōgōpakaraṇādayaḥ; tē pariśuddhāḥ sarvavidhāstasya santītyarthaḥ। sarvagandhaḥ sarvarasaḥ – aśabdamasparśam (kaṭha.1.3.15) ityādinā prākr̥tagandharasādiniṣēdhādaprākr̥tāḥ svāsādhāraṇā niravadyā niratiśayāḥ kalyāṇāḥ svabhōgyabhūtāssarvavidhā gandharasāstasya santītyarthaḥ। sarvamidamabhyāttaḥ – uktaṁ rasaparyantaṁ sarvamidaṁ kalyāṇaguṇajātaṁ svīkr̥tavān। abhyāttaḥ iti bhuktā brāhmaṇāḥ itivatkartariktaḥ pratipattavyaḥ। avākī – vākaḥ uktiḥ; sō'sya nāstītyavākī। kuta ityāha – anādara iti avāptasamastakāmatvēnādartavyābhāvādādararahitaḥ। ata ēva avākī-ajalpākaḥ; paripūrṇaiśvaryatvāt brahmādistambaparyantaṁ nikhilaṁ jagattr̥ṇīkr̥tya jōṣamāsīna ityarthaḥ। ta ētē vivikṣatā guṇāḥ paramātmanyēvōpapadyantē॥2॥

#### uktānāṁ guṇānāṁ, vyatirēkataḥ paramātmani dr̥ḍhīkāraḥ

35. anupapattēstu na śārīraḥ॥ 1-2-3 ॥

tamimaṁ guṇasāgaraṁ paryālōcayatāṁ khadyōtakalpasya śarīrasambandhanibandhanāparimita-duḥkhasambandhayōgyasya baddhamuktāvasthasya jīvasya prastutaguṇalēśasambandhagandhō'pi nōpapadyata iti nāsmin prakaraṇē śārīraparigrahaśaṅkā jāyata ityarthaḥ॥3॥

#### ētadadhikaraṇīyaparamasādhyahētukathanam

36. karmakartr̥vyapadēśācca ॥ 1-2-4 ॥

ētamitaḥ prētyābhisambhivatā'smi (chā.3.14.4) iti prāpyatayā paraṁ brahma vyapadiśyatē, prāptatr̥tayā ca jīvaḥ। ataḥ prāptā jīva upāsakaḥ, prāpyaṁ paraṁ brahmōpāsyamiti prāpturanyadēvēdamiti vijñāyatē ॥4॥

#### vibhaktiviśēṣanirdēśāt brahmapadavācyaḥ paramātmā

**3**7. śabdaviśēṣāt ॥ 1-2-5 ॥

ēṣa ma ātmā'ntarhr̥dayē (chā.3.14.3) iti śārīraṣṣaṣṭhyā nirdiṣṭaḥ upāsyastu prathamayā। ēvaṁ samānaprakaraṇē vājināṁ ca śrutau śabdaviśēṣaśśrūyatē jīvaparayōḥ; yathā vrīhirvā yavō vā śyāmākō vā śyāmākataṇḍulō vā ēvamayamantarātman puruṣō hiraṇmayō yathā jyōtiradhūmam (śata.brā.1.6.3) iti। atra antarātman iti saptamyantēna śārīrō nirdiśyatē; puruṣō hiraṇmayaḥ iti prathamayōpāsyaḥ। ataḥ para ēvōpāsyaḥ॥

#### hr̥dayasthē īśvaratāyāḥ upabr̥ṁhaṇataḥ sthāpanam

itaśca śārīrādanyaḥ-

38. smr̥tēśca ॥ 1-2-6 ॥

sarvasya cāhaṁ hr̥di sanniviṣṭō mattaḥ smr̥tirjñānamapōhanañca (bha.gī.15.15) yō māmēvamasammūḍhō jānāti puruṣōttamam (gī.15.19), īśvarassarvabhūtānāṁ hr̥ddēśē'rjuna tiṣṭhati। bhrāmayansarvabhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā। tamēva śaraṇaṁ gaccha (gī.18-61) iti śārīramupāsakaṁ, paramātmānaṁ cōpāsyaṁ smr̥tirdarśayati॥ 6॥

#### hr̥dayākhyālpadēśasthitēḥ jīvatvajñāpakatāśaṅkāparihārau

39. arbhakaukastvāttadvyapadēśācca nēti cēnna nicāyyatvādēvaṁ vyōmavacca ॥ 1-2-7 ॥

alpāyatanatvamarbhakaukastvam, tadvyapadēśaḥ – alpatvavyapadēśaḥ। ēṣa ma ātmā'ntarhr̥ādayē (chā.3.14.3) ityaṇīyasi hr̥dayāyatanē sthitatvāt aṇīyān vrīhērvā yavādvā (chāṁ.3.14.3) ityādinā'ṇīyastvasya svarūpēṇa vyapadēśācca nāyaṁ paramātmā, api tu jīva ēva; sarvagataṁ susūkṣmaṁ tadavyayaṁ yadbhūtayōniṁ paripaśyanti dhīrāḥ (muṇḍa.1.1.6) ityādibhiḥ paramātmanō'paricchannatva -avagamāt, jīvasya cārāgramātratvavyapadēśāditi cēt –

naitadēvam, paramātmaiva hyaṇīyānityēvaṁ nicāyyatvēna vyapadiśyatē; ēvaṁ nicāyyatvēna – ēvaṁ draṣṭavyatvēna, ēvamupāsyatvēnēti yāvat। na punaraṇīyastvamēvāsya svarūpamiti; vyōmavaccāyaṁ vyapadiśyatē, svābhāvikamahattvaṁ cātraiva vyapadiśyatē – jyāyān pr̥thivyā jyāyānantarikṣājjyāyān divō jyāyānēbhyō lōkēbhyaḥ (chāṁ.3.14.1) iti। ata upāsanārthamēvālpatvavyapadēśaḥ। tathā hi –

#### alpāyatanatvādyupadēśasya upāsanārthatvadr̥ḍhīkaraṇam

sarvaṁ khalvidaṁ brahma tajjalāniti śānta upāsīta (muṇḍa.3.14.4) iti sarvōtpattipralayakāraṇatvēna sarvasyā'tmatayā anupravēśakr̥tajīvayitr̥tvēna ca sarvātmakaṁ brahmōpāsītētyupāsanaṁ vidhāya atha khalu kratumayaḥ puruṣō yathākraturasmillōṅkē puruṣō bhavati tathētaḥ prētya bhavati (chāṁ.3.14.4) iti yathōpāsanaṁ prāpyasiddhimabhidhāya sa kratuṁ kurvīta iti guṇavidhānārthamupāsanamanūdya (chāṁ.3.14.4) manōmayaḥ prāṇaśarīrō bhārūpassatyasaṅkalpa ākāśātmā sarvakarmā sarvakāmassarvagandharassarvarasaḥ sarvamidamabhyāttō'vākyanādaraḥ (chāṁ.3.14.4) iti jagadaiśvaryaviśiṣṭasya svarūpaguṇāṁścōpādēyān pratipādya ēṣa ma ātmā'ntarhr̥ādayē'ṇīyān vrīhērvā yavādvā sarṣapādvā śyāmākādvā śyāmāka-taṇḍulādvā (chāṁ.3.14.4) ityupāsakasya hr̥dayē'ṇīyastvēna tadātmatayōpāsyasya paramapuruṣasyōpāsanārthamavasthānamuktvā ēṣa ma ātmā'ntarhr̥ādayē jyāyān pr̥thivyā jyāyānantarakṣājjyāyāndivō jyāyānēbhyōlōkēbhyassarvakarmā sarvakāmassarvarasassarvamidam abhyāttaḥ avākyanādaraḥ (chāṁ.3.14.1,4) ityantarhr̥ādayē'vasthitasya upāsyamānasya prāpyākāraṁ nirdiśya ēṣa ma ātmā'ntarhādaya ētadbrahma ityēvaṁ bhūtaṁ paraṁ brahma paramakāruṇyēnāsmadujjijīvayiṣayā asmaddhr̥dayē sannihitamitīdamanusandhānaṁ vidhāya ētamitaḥ prētyābhisambhavitāsmi (chāṁ.3.14.4) iti yathōpāsanaṁ prāptiniścayānusandhānaṁ ca vidhāya iti yasya syādaddhā na vicikatsā'sti (chāṁ.3.14.4) ityēvaṁvidhaprāpyaprāptiniścayōpētasyōpāsakasya prāptau na saṁśayō'stītyupasaṁhr̥tam। ata upāsanārtham arbhakaukastvamaṇīyastvaṁ ca॥7॥

#### brahmaṇaḥ jīvaśarīrāntarvartitvē sukhaduḥkhōpabhōjaśaṅkāparihārau

40. sambhōgaprāptiriti cēnna vaiśēṣyāt ॥ 1-2-8 ॥

jīvasyēva parasyāpi brahmaṇaśśarīrāntarvartitvamabhyupagataṁ cēt – tadvadēva śarīrasambandhaprayukta-sukhaduḥkhōpabhōgaprāptiriti cēt – tanna, hētuvaiśēṣyāt – na hi śarīrāntarvartitvamēva sukhaduḥkhōpa-bhōgahētuḥ; api tu puṇyapāparūpakarmaparavaśatvam; tattvapahatapāpmanaḥ paramātmanō na sambhavati। tathā ca śrutiḥ tayōranyaḥ pippalaṁ svādvattyanaśnannanyō abhicākaśīti (muṇḍa.3.11) iti ॥8॥

**iti śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē sarvatraprasiddhyadhikaraṇam॥1॥**

### 13 attradhikaraṇam

**śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē attradhikaraṇam ॥2॥**

**adhikaraṇārthaḥ**—
sarvajagat-saṁhāra-rūpam attr̥tvam paramātmana ēva,  
na jīvasya।

**viṣayaḥ**—
nācikētavidyā kaṭha.u.2

#### pūrvādhikaraṇāntimasūtrēṇa avāntarasaṅgatiḥ

**vi॰pra॰**—
> yadi paramātmā na bhōktā,  
ēvaṁ tarhi sarvatra bhōktr̥tayā pratīyamānō jīva ēva syāt  

iti āśaṅkya āha -

**English**—
If the highest Self is not the enjoyer, then in all cases the one perceived as the enjoyer must be the individual soul; with this doubt, the author says—

**vi॰pra॰**—
41. +++(brahma)+++ attā carācara-grahaṇāt ॥ 1-2-9 ॥

**English**—
9. The eater (is the highest Self) on account of there being taken all that is movable and immovable.

#### viṣaya-vākya-darśanam

**vi॰pra॰**—
kaṭha-vallīṣv āmnāyatē -  

> yasya brahma ca kṣatraṁ ca  
> ubhē bhavata ōdanaḥ ।  
> mr̥tyur yasyōpasēcanaṁ  
> ka itthā vēda yatra saḥ  
> (kaṭha.1.2.25) 

iti ।

**English**—
We read in the Kaṭḥavallī (I, 2, 25), 

> 'Who then knows  
> where he is  
> to whom the Brahmans and Kshattriyas are but food,  
> and death itself a condiment?'

#### adhikaraṇāṅgabhūtaḥ saṁśayaḥ

**vi॰pra॰**—
atra 

> ōdanōpasēcana-sūcitō 'ttā  
kiṁ jīva ēva,  
uta paramātmā 

iti sandihyatē ।

**English**—
A doubt here arises whether the 'eater', suggested by the words 'food' and 'condiment,' is the individual soul or the highest Self.

#### pūrvapakṣaḥ

**vi॰pra॰**—
kiṁ yuktam ?

**English**—
What is the right view?

**vi॰pra॰**—
jīva iti ।

**English**—
The individual soul, the Pūrvapakshin maintains;

**vi॰pra॰**—
kutaḥ ? bhōktr̥tvasya karma-nimittatvāt  
jīvasya ēva tat sambhavāt ।

**English**—
for all enjoyment presupposes works, and works belong to the individual soul only.

#### siddhāntaḥ

**vi॰pra॰**—
atra ucyatē – attā carācara-grahaṇāt – attā paramātmaiva ।

**English**—
Of this view the Sūtra disposes. The 'eater' can be the highest Self only,

##### carācaragrahaṇāt
**vi॰pra॰**—
kutaḥ ? carācaragrahaṇāt –  
carācarasya kr̥tsnasya attr̥tvaṁ hi  
tasyaiva sambhavati ।

**English**—
because the taking, i. e. eating, of the whole aggregate of movable and immovable things can be predicated of that Self only.

**vi॰pra॰**—
na cēdaṁ karmanimittaṁ bhōktr̥tvam ;  
api tu jagaj-janma-sthiti-laya-hētu-bhūtasya parasya brahmaṇō viṣṇōḥ saṁhartr̥tvam ।

**English**—
'Eating' does not here mean fruition dependent on work, but rather the act of reabsorption of the world on the part of the highest Brahman, i. e. Vishṇu, who is the cause of the origination, subsistence, and final destruction of the universe.

##### prakaraṇataḥ
**vi॰pra॰**—
> sō'dhvanaḥ pāram āpnōti  
tadviṣṇōḥ paramaṁ padam (kaṭha.1.3.9) 

ity atraiva +++(samānaprakaraṇē 1.2.25 tō'nantaram)+++ darśanāt।

**English**—
This appears from the fact that Vishṇu is mentioned in the same section, 'He reaches the end of his journey, and that is the highest place of Vishṇu' (Ka. Up. I, 3, 9).

##### upasēcanavacanāt
**vi॰pra॰**—
tathā ca "mr̥tyur yasyōpasēcanam" (kaṭha.1.2.25) iti vacanāt ,  

"brahma ca kṣatraṁ ca" (kaṭha.1.2.25) iti kr̥tsnaṁ carācaraṁ jagat  
ihādanīyōdanatvēna gr̥hyatē ।

**English**—
Moreover the clause 'to whom death is a condiment' shows that by the Brahmans and Kshattriyas, mentioned in the text, we have to understand the whole universe of moving and non-moving things, viewed as things to be consumed by the highest Self.

**vi॰pra॰**—
upasēcanaṁ hi nāma svayam adyamānaṁ sat anyasyādanahētuḥ ।

**English**—
For a condiment is a thing which, while itself being eaten, causes other things to be eaten;

**vi॰pra॰**—
ataḥ, upasēcanatvēna mr̥tyōr apy adyamānatvāt  
tad-upasicyamānasya kr̥tsnasya brahma-kṣatra-pūrvakasya jagataś carācarasyādanam atra vivakṣitam  
iti gamyatē ।

**English**—
the meaning of the passage, therefore, is that while death itself is consumed, being a condiment as it were, there is at the same time eaten whatever is flavoured or made palatable by death, and that is the entire world of beings in which the Brahmans and Kshattriyas hold the foremost place.

##### layaḥ
**vi॰pra॰**—
īdr̥śaṁ cādanam upasaṁhāra ēva ।

**English**—
Now such eating of course is destruction or reabsorption,

**vi॰pra॰**—
tasmāt, īdr̥śaṁ jagad-upasaṁhāritva-rūpaṁ bhōktr̥tvaṁ  
paramātmana ēva ॥ 9 ॥

**English**—
and hence such enjoyment – meaning general reabsorption – can belong to the highest Self only.

#### prākaraṇikō hētuḥ

**vi॰pra॰**—
42. prakaraṇāc ca ॥ 1-2-10 ॥

**English**—
10. And on account of the topic of the whole section.

**vi॰pra॰**—
prakaraṇaṁ cēdaṁ parasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ -  

> mahāntaṁ vibhum ātmānaṁ  
matvā dhīrō na śōcati  
(kaṭha.1.2.22), 

**English**—
Moreover the highest Brahman constitutes the topic of the entire section. Cp. 'The wise who knows the Self as great and omnipresent does not grieve' (Ka. Up. I, 2, 22);

**vi॰pra॰**—
> nāyam ātmā pravacanēna labhyō  
na mēdhayā na bahunā śrutēna ।
yam ēvaiṣa vr̥ṇutē tēna labhyas  
tasyaiṣa ātmā vivr̥ṇutē tanūṁ svām  
> (kaṭha.1.2.23) 

iti hi prakr̥tam ।

**English**—
'That Self cannot be gained by the Veda, nor by understanding, nor by much learning. He whom the Self chooses, by him the Self can be gained; the Self chooses him as his own' (I, 2, 23).

**vi॰pra॰**—
> ka itthā vēda yatra saḥ (kaṭha.1-2-25) 

ity api hi tat-prasādād r̥tē  
tasya duravabōdhatvam ēva pūrvaprastutaṁ pratyabhijñāyatē ॥ 10 ॥

**English**—
Moreover, the clause (forming part of the text under discussion), 'Who knows him (i.e. the being which constitutes the topic of the section) where he is?' clearly shows that we have to recognise here the Self of which it had previously been said that it is hard to know unless it assists us with its grace.

#### ānantarika-r̥ta-pāna-śrutyā jīvatvaśaṅkā

**vi॰pra॰**—
atha syāt – 

> nāyaṁ brahma-kṣatraudana-sūcitaḥ puruṣaḥ  
> apahatapāpmā paramātmā ;  
> anantaram 

**English**—
To this conclusion a new objection presents itself.--

> Further on in the same Upanishad (I, 3, 1) we meet with the following text:

**vi॰pra॰**—
> > r̥taṁ pibantau sukr̥tasya lōkē  
guhāṁ praviṣṭau paramē parārdhyē ।
chāyātapau brahmavidō vadanti  
pañcāgnayō yē ca triṇācikētāḥ (kaṭha.1-3-1) 
> 
> iti karmaphalabhōktur ēva sadvitīyasyābhidhānāt ।

**English**—
> 'There are two, drinking their reward in the world of their own works, entered into the cave, dwelling on the highest summit; those who know Brahman call them shade and light, likewise those householders who perform the Triṇāciketa-sacrifice.' Now this text clearly refers to the individual soul which enjoys the reward of its works, together with an associate coupled to it.

**vi॰pra॰**—
> dvitīyaḥ ca prāṇaḥ buddhiḥ vā syāt ।

**English**—
> And this associate is either the vital breath, or the organ of knowledge (buddhi).

**vi॰pra॰**—
> r̥tapānaṁ hi karmaphalabhōga ēva ; sa ca paramātmanō na sambhavati ; buddhi-prāṇayōḥ tu bhōktuḥ jīvasya upakaraṇabhūtayōḥ yathā kathañcit pānē anvayaḥ sambhavati iti tayōḥ anyatarēṇa sadvitīyaḥ jīva ēva pratipādyatē , tadēkaprakaraṇatvāt pūrvaprastutaḥ attā api sa ēva bhavitum arhāti 

– iti ।

**English**—
> For the drinking of 'r̥ta' is the enjoyment of the fruit of works, and such enjoyment does not suit the highest Self. The buddhi, or the vital breath, on the other hand, which are instruments of the enjoying embodied soul, may somehow be brought into connexion with the enjoyment of the fruit of works. As the text is thus seen to refer to the embodied soul coupled with some associate, we infer, on the ground of the two texts belonging to one section, that also the 'eater' described in the former text is none other than the individual soul.

##### guhā-pravēśataḥ samādhānam

**vi॰pra॰**—
tatrōcyatē –

**English**—
To this we reply:

**vi॰pra॰**—
> 43. guhāṁ praviṣṭāv +++(jīva-parama+)+++ātmānau hi - +++(prakaraṇē'smin)+++
 tad-darśanāt ॥ 1-2-11 ॥

**English**—
11\. The 'two entered into the cave' are the two Selfs; on account of this being seen.

**vi॰pra॰**—
na prāṇa-jīvau buddhi-jīvau vā  
"guhāṁ praviṣṭāv r̥taṁ pibantāv" iti ucyētē ;  
api tu jīva-paramātmānau hi tathā vyapadiśyētē ।

**English**—
The two, entered into the cave and drinking their reward, are neither the embodied soul together with the vital breath, nor the embodied soul together with the buddhi; it is rather the embodied Self and the highest Self which are designated by those terms.

**vi॰pra॰**—
kutaḥ ? tad-darśanāt ।  
asmin prakaraṇē jīva-parayōḥ ēva guhā-pravēśa-vyapadēśaḥ dr̥śyatē ।

**English**—
For this is seen, i.e. it is seen that in that section the individual Self and the highest Self only are spoken of as entered into the cave.

**vi॰pra॰**—
paramātmanas tāvat - 

> taṁ durdarśaṁ gūḍham anupraviṣṭaṁ  
> guhāhitaṁ gahvarēṣṭhaṁ purāṇam ।  
> adhyātma-yōgādhigamēna dēvaṁ  
> matvā dhīrō harṣa-śōkau jahāti  
> (kaṭha.1.2.12) 

iti ।

**English**—
To the highest Self there refers I, 2, 12, 'The wise who by meditation on his Self recognises the Ancient who is difficult to see, who has entered into the dark, who is hidden in the cave, who dwells in the abyss, as God, he indeed leaves joy and sorrow far behind.'

**vi॰pra॰**—
jīvasyāpi -  

> yā prāṇēna **sambhavaty**  
> aditir dēvatāmayī।  
> guhāṁ praviśya **tiṣṭhantī**  
> yā bhūtēbhir **vyajāyata** (kaṭha.2.4.7) 

iti।

**English**—
And to the individual soul there refers I, 4, 7, 'Who is together with the vital breath, who is Aditi, who is made of the deities, who entering into the cave abides therein, who was born variously through the elements.'

**vi॰pra॰**—
karmaphalāny attīti "aditir" jīva ucyatē ।+++(4)+++

**English**—
Aditi here means the individual soul which enjoys (atti) the fruits of its works;

**vi॰pra॰**—
prāṇēna sambhavati – prāṇēna saha vartatē ।

**English**—
which is associated with the vital breath;

**vi॰pra॰**—
dēvatāmayī - indriyādhīna-bhōgā ।

**English**—
which is made of the deities, i.e. whose enjoyment is dependent on the different sense-organs;

**vi॰pra॰**—
guhāṁ praviśya tiṣṭhantī – hr̥daya-puṇḍarīkōdara-vartinī । +++(5)+++

**English**—
which abides in the hollow of the heart;

**vi॰pra॰**—
bhūtēbhir vyajāyata –  

pr̥thivyādibhir bhūtaiḥ sahitā  
dēvādi-rūpēṇa vividhā jāyatē ।

**English**—
and which, being connected with the elementary substances, earth, and so on, is born in various forms – human, divine, &c.--

##### r̥ta-pānam
**vi॰pra॰**—
ēvaṁ ca sati  
"r̥taṁ pibantāv" (kaṭha.1.3.1) iti vyapadēśaḥ  
"chatriṇō +++(acchatriṇaś ca)+++ gacchanti" +itivat pratipattavyaḥ ।

**English**—
That the text speaks of the two Selfs as drinking their reward (while actually the individual soul only does so) is to be understood in the same way as the phrase 'there go the umbrella-bearers' (one of whom only carries the umbrella).

**vi॰pra॰**—
yadvā – prayōjya-prayōjaka-rūpēṇa pānē  
kartr̥tvaṁ jīva-parayōr upapadyatē ॥ 11 ॥

**English**—
Or else we may account for this on the ground that both are agents with regard to the drinking, in so far as the 'drinking' individual soul is caused to drink by the highest Self.

##### prāptr̥-prāpyatvē

**vi॰pra॰**—
44. +++(prāptr̥-prāpyatvē→)+++ viśēṣaṇāc ca ॥ 1-2-12 ॥

**English**—
12. And on account of distinctive qualities.

**vi॰pra॰**—
asmin prakaraṇē jīva-paramātmānāv ēva  
upāsyatvōpāsakatva-prāpyatva-prāptr̥tva-viśiṣṭau  
sarvatra pratipādyētē ।

**English**—
Everywhere in that section we meet with statements of distinctive attributes of the two Selfs, the highest Self being represented as the object of meditation and attainment, and the individual Self as the meditating and attaining subject.

**vi॰pra॰**—
tathā hi –  

> brahma-ja-jñaṁ dēvam īḍyaṁ viditvā  
> nicāyyēmāṁ śāntim atyantam ēti (kaṭha.1.1.17) 

iti ।

**English**—
The passage 'When he has known and understood that which is born from Brahman, the intelligent, to be divine and venerable, then he obtains everlasting peace' (I, 1, 17) refers to the meditating individual soul which recognises itself as being of the nature of Brahman.

**vi॰pra॰**—
brahma-ja-jñō – jīvaḥ,  
brahmaṇō jātatvāt, jñatvāc ca ।

**English**—
'Born of Brahman and knowing' refers to the individual soul, because it originates from Brahman and is a knowing subject.

**vi॰pra॰**—
> taṁ dēvam īḍyaṁ viditvā  
jīvātmānam upāsakaṁ brahmātmakatvēnāvagamya 

ity arthaḥ ।

**English**—
'Having known that adorable god' means having understood the meditating soul as having Brahman for its Self.

**vi॰pra॰**—
tathā, 

> yaḥ sētur ījānānām  
> akṣaraṁ brahma yat param ।  
> abhayaṁ titīrṣatāṁ pāraṁ  
> nācikētaṁ śakēmahi  
> (kaṭha.1.3.2) 

ity upāsyaḥ paramātma ucyatē ।

**English**—
On the other hand, I, 3, 2, 'That which is a bridge for sacrificers. the highest imperishable Brahman for those who wish to cross over to the fearless shore, the Nāciketa, may we be able to know that,' refers to the highest Self as the object of meditation;

**vi॰pra॰**—
nācikētam – nācikētasya karmaṇaḥ prāpyam ity arthaḥ ।

**English**—
'Nāciketa' here meaning that which is to be reached through the Nāciketa-rite.

**vi॰pra॰**—
> ātmānaṁ rathinaṁ viddhi  
> śarīraṁ ratham ēva ca (kaṭha.1.3.3) 

ityādinōpāsakō jīva ucyatē ।

**English**—
Again, the passage 'Know the Self to be sitting in the chariot and the body to be the chariot' (I, 3, 3) refers to the meditating individual soul;

**vi॰pra॰**—
tathā 

> vijñāna-sārathir yastu  
> manaḥpragrahavān naraḥ ।  
> sō'dhvanaḥ pāram āpnōti  
> tad viṣṇōḥ paramaṁ padam  
> (kaṭha.1.3.9) 

iti prāpya-prāptārau abhidhīyētē jīva-paramātmānau ।

**English**—
and the verse, I, 3, 9, 'But he who has understanding for his charioteer, and holds the reins of the mind, he reaches the end of his journey, and that is the highest place of Vishṇu.' refers to the embodied and the highest Selfs as that which attains and that which is to be attained.

**vi॰pra॰**—
ihāpi "chāyātapau" (kaṭha.1.3.1) ity ajñatva-sarvajñatvābhyāṁ tāv ēva viśiṣya vyapadiśyētē ॥

**English**—
And in the text under discussion also (I, 3, 1), the two Selfs are distinctly designated as light and shade, the one being all-knowing, the other devoid of knowledge.

#### prakaraṇasya jīvaparatva-śaṅkā

**vi॰pra॰**—
atha syāt – 

> > yēyaṁ prētē vicikitsā manuṣyē  
> astīty ēkē nāyam astīti caikē (kaṭha.1.1.20) 
>
> iti 
> 
> > jīva-svarūpa-yāthātmya-praśnōpakramāt  
sarvam idaṁ prakaraṇaṁ jīvaparam  
>
> iti pratīyatē 

– iti ॥

**English**—
But, a new objection is raised, the initial passage, I, 1, 20, 'That doubt which there is when a man is dead – some saying, he is; others, he is not,' clearly asks a question as to the true nature of the individual soul, and we hence conclude that that soul forms the topic of the whole chapter.

##### varābhyāṁ samādhānam

**vi॰pra॰**—
naitad ēvam,  
na hi jīvasya dēhātiraktasya  
astitva-nāstitva-śaṅkāyām ayaṁ praśnaḥ ,  
tathā sati pūrva-vara-dvaya-varaṇānupapattēḥ ।

**English**—
--Not so, we reply. That question does not spring from any doubt as to the existence or non-existence of the soul apart from the body; for if this were so the two first boons chosen by Nāciketas would be unsuitable.

**vi॰pra॰**—
tathā hi -  

pituḥ sarvavēda-sa-dakṣiṇā-kratu-samāpti-vēlāyāṁ  
dīyamāna-dakṣiṇā-vaiguṇyēna kratu-vaiguṇyaṁ manyamānēna kumārēṇa nacikētasā ''stikāgrēsarēṇa  
svātmadānēnāpi pituḥ kratu-sādguṇyam icchatā  

"kasmai māṁ dāsyasi" (kaṭha.1.2.4)  
ity asakr̥t pitaraṁ pr̥ṣṭavatā  
svanirbandha-ruṣṭa-pitr̥-vacanāt  
mr̥tyu-sadanaṁ praviṣṭēna  
sva-sadanāt prōṣuṣi yamē tad-adarśanāt  
tatra tisrō rātrīr upōṣuṣā  

svōpavāsa-bhīta-tat-pratividhāna-pravr̥tta-- mr̥tyu-pradattē vara-trayē  
āstikyātirēkāt, prathamēna varēṇa svātmānaṁ prati  
pituḥ prasādō vr̥taḥ ,  
ētacca sarvaṁ dēhātiriktātmānam ajānatō nōpapadyatē ।

**English**—
For the story runs as follows: When the sacrifice offered by the father of Nāciketas... Yama on his return... allows him to choose three boons. Nāciketas, thereupon... chooses as his first boon that his father should forgive him. Now it is clear that conduct of this kind would not be possible in the case of one not convinced of the soul having an existence independent of the body.

**vi॰pra॰**—
dvitīyēna ca varēṇa  
uttīrṇa-dēhātmānubhāvya-phala-- sādhana-bhūtā 'gni-vidyā vr̥tā ;  
tad api dēhātiriktātmānabhijñasya na sambhavati ।

**English**—
For his second boon, again, he chooses the knowledge of a sacrificial fire, which has a result to be experienced only by a soul that has departed from the body; and this choice also can clearly be made only by one who knows that the soul is something different from the body.

##### brahma-prāpti-varam
**vi॰pra॰**—
ataḥ tr̥tīyēna varēṇa yad idaṁ vriyatē -  

> yēyaṁ prētē vicikitsā manuṣyē  
astīty ēkē nāyam astīti caikē ।  
ētad-vidyām anuśiṣṭas tvayā 'ham ,  
varāṇām ēṣa varas tr̥tīyaḥ (kaṭha.1.1.20) 

iti ,  
atra parama-puruṣārtha-rūpa-- brahma-prāpti--lakṣaṇa-mōkṣa-yāthātmya-vijñānāya tadupāyā-bhūta-paramātma-upāsana-parāvarātma-tatva-jijñāsayā ayaṁ praśnaḥ kriyatē ।

**English**—
When, therefore, he chooses for his third boon the clearing up of his doubt as to the existence of the soul after death (as stated in v. 20), it is evident that his question is prompted by the desire to acquire knowledge of the true nature of the highest Self – which knowledge has the form of meditation on the highest Self--, and by means thereof, knowledge of the true nature of final Release which consists in obtaining the highest Brahman.

**vi॰pra॰**—
ēvaṁ ca "yēyaṁ prētē" (kaṭha.1.1.20) iti  
na śarīra-viyōga-mātrābhiprāyam ,  
api tu sarva-bandha-vinirmōkṣābhiprāyam ।

**English**—
The passage, therefore, is not concerned merely with the problem as to the separation of the soul from the body, but rather with the problem of the Self freeing itself from all bondage whatever.

**vi॰pra॰**—
yathā - na +++(mōkṣaṁ)+++ prētya sañjñā'sti (br̥.4.4.12) iti ।

**English**—
--the same problem, in fact, with which another scriptural passage also is concerned, viz. 'When he has departed there is no more knowledge' (Br̥. Up. II, 4, 12).

**vi॰pra॰**—
ayam arthaḥ - 

> mōkṣādhikr̥tē manuṣyē prētē sarva-bandha-vinirmuktē  
tat-svarūpa-viṣayā  
vādi-vipratipatti-nimittā 'sti-nāsty-ātmikā yēyaṁ vicikitsā ,  
tad-apanōdanāya  
tat-svarūpa-yāthātmyaṁ tvayā anuśiṣṭō 'haṁ  
vidyām – jānīyām  

\- iti ॥

**English**—
The full purport of Nāciketas' question, therefore, is as follows: When a man qualified for Release has died and thus freed himself from all bondage, there arises a doubt as to his existence or non-existence – a doubt due to the disagreement of philosophers as to the true nature of Release; in order to clear up this doubt I wish to learn from thee the true nature of the state of Release.

##### mōkṣaviṣayiṇyō vipratipattayaḥ

**vi॰pra॰**—
tathā hi bahudhā vipratipadyantē – 

**English**—
Philosophers, indeed, hold many widely differing opinions as to what constitutes Release.

**vi॰pra॰**—
1. kēcid vitti-mātrasya ātmanaḥ svarūpōcchitti-lakṣaṇaṁ mōkṣam ācakṣatē । 

**English**—
1. Some hold that the Self is constituted by consciousness only, and that Release consists in the total destruction of this essential nature of the Self.

**vi॰pra॰**—
2. anyē vitti-mātrasya ēva satō 'vidyā-'stamayam । 

**English**—
2. Others, while holding the same opinion as to the nature of the Self, define Release as the passing away of Nescience (avidyā).

**vi॰pra॰**—
3. aparē – pāṣāṇakalpasyā'tmanō jñānādy-aśēṣa-vaiśēṣika-guṇōcchēda-lakṣaṇaṁ kaivalyarūpam। 

**English**—
3. Others hold that the Self is in itself non-sentient, like a stone, but possesses, in the state of bondage, certain distinctive qualities, such as knowledge, and so on. Release then consists in the total removal of all these qualities, the Self remaining in a state of pure isolation (kaivalya).

**vi॰pra॰**—
4. aparē tu – apahatapāpmānaṁ paramātmānam abhyupagacchantaḥ   
tasyaivōpādhi-saṁsarga-nimitta- jīva-bhāvasya  
upādhy-apagamēna  
tad-bhāva-lakṣaṇaṁ mōkṣam ātiṣṭhantē।

**English**—
4. Others, again, who acknowledge a highest Self free from all imperfection, maintain that through connexion with limiting adjuncts that Self enters on the condition of an individual soul; Release then means the pure existence of the highest Self, consequent on the passing away of the limiting adjuncts.

**vi॰pra॰**—
5. trayyanta-niṣṇātās tu  
nikhila-jagad-ēka-kāraṇasya  
aśēṣa-hēya-pratyanīka-- +ananta-jñānānandaika-svarūpasya  
svābhāvikānavadhikātiśayāsaṅkhyēya- kalyāṇa-guṇākarasya  
sakalētara-vilakṣaṇasya  
sarvātma-bhūtasya parasya brahmaṇaḥ  

śarīratayā prakārabhūtasya  
anukūlāparicchinna-jñāna-svarūpasya  
paramātmānubhavaika-rasasya jīvasya  
anādi-karma-rūpāvidyā-tirōhita-svarūpasya  
avidyōcchēda-pūrvaka-- svābhāvika-paramātmānubhavam ēva  
mōkṣam ācakṣatē ।

**English**—
5. Those, however, who understand the Vedānta, teach as follows: There is a highest Brahman which is the sole cause of the entire universe, which is antagonistic to all evil, whose essential nature is infinite knowledge and blessedness, which comprises within itself numberless auspicious qualities of supreme excellence, which is different in nature from all other beings, and which constitutes the inner Self of all. Of this Brahman, the individual souls – whose true nature is unlimited knowledge, and whose only essential attribute is the intuition of the supreme Self – are modes, in so far, namely, as they constitute its body. The true nature of these souls is, however, obscured by Nescience, i.e. the influence of the beginningless chain of works; and by Release then we have to understand that intuition of the highest Self, which is the natural state of the individual souls, and which follows on the destruction of Nescience.

**vi॰pra॰**—
tatra 

> mōkṣa-svarūpaṁ tat-sādhanaṁ ca  
tvat-prasādād vidyām  

iti nacikētasā pr̥ṣṭō mr̥tyuḥ  
tasyārthasya duravabōdhatva-pradarśanēna  
vividha-bhōga-vitaraṇa-pralōbhanēna cainaṁ parīkṣya  
yōgyatām abhijñāya  
parāvarātma-tattva-vijñānaṁ paramātmōpāsanaṁ  
tat-pada-prāpti-lakṣaṇaṁ mōkṣaṁ ca  

> taṁ durdarśaṁ gūḍham anupraviṣṭam (kaṭha.1.2.12) 

ity ārabhya  

> sō'dhvanaḥ pāramāpnōti  
> tadviṣṇōḥ paramaṁ padam (kaṭha.1.3.9) 

ity-antēnōpadiśya  
tad-apēkṣitāṁś ca viśēṣān upadidēśa 

iti sarvaṁ samañjasam ।

**English**—
When Nāciketas desires Yama graciously to teach him the true nature of Release and the means to attain it, Yama at first tests him by dwelling on the difficulty of comprehending Release, and by tempting him with various worldly enjoyments. But having in this way recognised the boy's thorough fitness, he in the end instructs him as to the kind of meditation on the highest Self which constitutes knowledge of the highest Reality, as to the nature of Release – which consists in reaching the abode of the highest Self--, and as to all the required details. This instruction begins, I, 2, 12, 'The Ancient one who is difficult to see,' &c., and extends up to I, 3, 9. 'and that is the highest place of Vishṇu.'--It thus is an established conclusion that the 'eater' is no other than the highest Self.

**vi॰pra॰**—
ataḥ paramātmaiva attā iti siddham ॥ 12 ॥

**English**—
Hence it is proved that the 'eater' is the highest Self.

**iti śrīśārīrikamīmāṁsāśrībhāṣyē attradhikaraṇam॥2॥**

### 14 antaradhikaraṇam

**śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē antaradhikaraṇam ॥3॥**

**adhikaraṇārthaḥ**—
akṣyādhārapuruṣatvaṁ paramātmana ēva, na jīvādēḥ

#### upakōsalavidyā chā.u.4-10

45. antara upapattēḥ ॥ 1-2-13 ॥

#### viṣayavākyapradarśanam

idamāmananti cchandōgāḥ ya ēṣō'kṣiṇi puruṣō dr̥śyatē। ēṣa ātmēti hōvāca ētadamr̥tamabhayamētadbrahma (chā.4.15.1) iti ॥

#### saṁśayasvarūpam

tatra sandēhaḥ – kimayamakṣyādhāratayā nirdiśyamānaḥ puruṣaḥ pratibimbātmā, uta cakṣurindriyādhiṣṭhātā nirdiśyamānaḥ puruṣaḥ pratibimbātmā, uta cakṣurindriyādhiṣṭhātā dēvatāviśēṣaḥ, uta jīvātmā, atha paramātmā iti ॥

#### sayuktikaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ

kiṁ yuktam? pratibimbātmēti। kutaḥ? prasiddhavannirdēśāt; dr̥śyatē ityaparōkṣābhidhānācca। jīvātmā vā, tasyāpi hi cakṣuṣi viśēṣēṇa sannidhānātprasiddhirupapadyatē? unmīlitaṁ hi cakṣurudvīkṣya jīvātmanaśśarīrē sthitigatī niścinvanti। raśmibhirēṣō'sminpratiṣṭhitaḥ (br̥.7.5.1) iti śrutiprasiddhyā cakṣuḥpratiṣṭhō dēvatāviśēṣō vā; ēṣvēva prasiddhavannirdēśōpapattērēṣāmanyatamaḥ –

#### siddhāntaḥ

iti prāptē pracakṣmahē – antara upapattēḥ – akṣyantaraḥ paramātmā। kutaḥ? ēṣa ātmēti hōvācaitadamr̥tamabhayamētadbrahmēti ētaṁ saṁyadvāma ityācakṣatē। ētaṁ hi sarvāṇi vāmānyabhisaṁyanti ēṣa u ēva vāmaniḥ। ēṣa hi sarvāṇi vāmāni nayati। ēṣa u ēva bhāmaniḥ। ēṣa hi sarvēṣu lōkēṣu bhāti (chāṁ.4.15.3) ityēṣāṁ guṇānāṁ paramātmanyēvōpapattēḥ ॥13॥

#### paramātmanaḥ cakṣuṣyavasthānaṁ śrutisiddham

46. sthānādivyapadēśācca ॥ 1-2-14॥

cakṣuṣi sthitiniyamanādayaḥ paramātmana ēva yaścakṣuṣi tiṣṭhan (br̥.5-7-18) ityēvamādau vyapadiśyantē । ataśca ya ēṣō'kṣaṇi puruṣaḥ (chā.4-15-1) iti sa ēva pratīyatē। ataḥ prasiddhavannirdēśaśca paramātmanyupapadyatē। tata ēva dr̥śyatē iti sākṣātkāravyapadēśō'pi yōgibhirdr̥śyamānatvādupapapadyatē॥14॥

#### prakaraṇapratipāditaṁ niravadhikānandatvaṁ paramātmana ēva

47. sukhaviviśaṣṭābhidhānādēva ca ॥ 1-2-15 ॥

itaścākṣyādhāraḥ puruṣōttamaḥ kaṁ brahma khaṁ brahma (chā.4.10.5) iti prakr̥tasya sukhaviśiṣṭasya brahmaṇaḥ upāsanasthānavidhānārthaṁ saṁyadvāmatvādiguṇavidhānārthaṁ ca ya ēṣō'kṣiṇi puruṣaḥ (chā.4-15-1) ityabhidhānāt। ēvakārō nairapēkṣyaṁ hētōrdyōtayati।

#### prakaraṇavicchēdapradarśanēna paramātmaparatvābhāvaśaṅkā

nanvagnividyāvyavadhānāt kaṁ brahma (chā.4.10.5) iti prakr̥taṁ brahma nēha sannidhattē। tathā hi agnayaḥ, prāṇō brahma kaṁ brahma khaṁ brahma iti brahmavidyāmupadiśya atha hainaṁ gārhāpatyō'nuśaśāsa (chā.4.11.1) ityārabhyāgnīnāmupāsanamupadidiśuḥ। na cāgnividyā brahmavidyāṅgamiti śakyaṁ vaktum; brahmavidyāphalānantargata-tadvirōdhisarvāyuḥ prāptisantatyavicchēdādiphalaśravaṇāt ॥

#### prakaramavicchēdasamarthanēna paramātmaparatvanirṇayaḥ

ucyatē – prāṇō brahma (chā.4.10.5) ētadamr̥tamabhayamētad brahma (chāṁ.4.15.3) ityubhayatra brahmasaṁśabdanāt। ācāryastu tē gatiṁ vaktā (chā.4.14.1) ityagnivacanācca gatyupadēśātpūrvaṁ brahmavidyāyā asamāptēstanmadhyagatāgnividyā brahmavidyāṅgamiti niścīyatē, atha hainaṁ gārhāpatyō'nuśaśāsa (chā.4.11.1) iti brahmavidyādhikr̥tasyaivāgnividyōpadēśācca। kiñca vyādhibhiḥ pratipūrṇō'smi (chā.4.10.3) iti brahmaprāptivyatiriktanānāvidhakāmōpahatipūrvaka-garbhajanmajarā-maraṇādibhavabhayōpataptāya upakōsalāya ēṣā sōmya tē'smadvidyā''tmavidyā ca (chāṁ.4.14.1) iti samuccityōpadēśānmōkṣaikaphalātmavidyāṅgatvamagnividyāyāḥ pratīyatē। ēvaṁ cāṅgatvē'vagatē sati phalānukīrtanamarthavāda iti gamyatē ॥

#### arthavādōktaphalasya mōkṣā'virōdhitā

na cātra mōkṣavirōdhiphalaṁ kiñcicchrūyatē, apahatē pāpakr̥tyāṁ lōkī bhavati sarvamāyurēti jyōgjīvati nāsyāvarapuruṣāḥ kṣīyantē upa vayantaṁ bhuñjāmō'smiṁśca lōkē'muṣmiṁśca (chāṁ.4.13.2) ityamīṣāṁ phalānāṁ mōkṣādhikr̥tasyānuguṇatvāt। apahatē pāpakr̥tyām – brahmaprāptivirōdhi pāpaṁ karmāpahanti। lōkī bhavati – tadvirōdhini pāpē nirastē brahmalōkaṁ prāpnōti। sarvamāyurēti – vyādhyādibhiranupahatō yāvadbrahmaprāpti jīvati। nāsyāvarapuruṣāḥ kṣīyantē – asya śiṣyapraśiṣyādayaḥ putrapautrādayō'pi brahmavida ēva bhavanti। nāsyābrahmavitkulē bhavati (mu.3.2.9) iti ca śrutyantarē brahmavidyāphalatvēna śrūyatē। upa vayantaṁ bhuñjāmō'smiṁśca lōkē'muṣmiṁśca – vayam agnayastamēnamupabhuñjāmaḥ – yāvadbrahmaprāpti vighnēbhyaḥ paripālayāma iti।

#### uktārthanigamanam

atō'gnividyāyā brahmavidyāṅgatvēna tatsinnadhānāvirōdhātsukhaviśiṣṭaṁ prakr̥tamēva brahmōpāsanasthānavidhānārthaṁ guṇavidhānārthaṁ cōcyatē।

#### brahmaṇaḥ punaravaktavyatvākṣēpaḥ

nanu ācāryastu tē gatiṁ vaktā (chā.4.5.1) iti gatimātrapariśēṣaṇādācāryēṇa gatirēvōpadēśyēti gamyatē; tatkathaṁ sthānaguṇavidhyarthatōcyatē ।

#### pūrvōktaśaṅkāparihāraḥ

tadabhidhīyatē ācāryastu tē gatiṁ vaktā (chā.4.5.1) ityasyāyamabhiprāyaḥ – brahmavidyāmanupadiśya prōṣuṣi gurau tadalābhādanāśvāsam upakōsalamujjīvayituṁ svaparicaraṇaprītā gārhāpatyādayō gurōragnayastasmai brahmasvarūpamātraṁ tadaṅgabhūtāṁ cāgnividyāmupadiśya ācāryāddhaiva vidyā viditā sādhiṣṭhaṁ prāpat (chāṁ.4.9.3) iti śrutyarthamālōcya sādhutamatvaprāptyarthamācārya ēvāsya saṁyadvāmatvādiguṇakaṁ brahma tadupāsanasthānamarcirādikāṁ ca gatimupadiśatviti matvā ācāryastu tē gatiṁ vaktā (chāṁ.4.14.1) ityavōcan। gatigrahaṇamupadēśyavidyāśēṣapradarśanārtham। ata ēvācāryō'pi ahaṁ tu tē tadvakṣāmi yathā puṣkarapalāśa āpō na śliṣyantē ēvamēvaṁvidi pāpaṁ karma na śliṣyatē (chāṁ.4.14.3) ityupakramya saṁyadvāmatvādikalyāṇaguṇaviśiṣṭaṁ brahmākṣisthānōpāsyamarcirādikāṁ ca gatimupadidēśa। ataḥ kaṁ brahma khaṁ brahma (chā.4.10.5) iti sukhaviśaṣṭasya prakr̥tasyaiva brahmaṇō'trābhidhānāt ayamakṣyādhāraḥ paramātmā॥15॥

#### kaṁ brahmēti vākyasya brahmaparatvābhāvamāśaṅkya, uttarasūtrasaṅgatiḥ

nanu ca kaṁ brahma khaṁ brahma (chāṁ.4.10.5) iti paraṁ brahmābhihitamiti kathamavagamyatē, yasyēha akṣyādhāratayā'bhidhānaṁ brūṣē; yāvatā kaṁ brahma khaṁ brahma (chāṁ.4.10.5) iti prasiddhākāśalaukikasukhayōrēva brahmadr̥ṣṭirvidhīyata iti pratibhāti, nāma brahma (chāṁ.7.1.5), manō brahma (chāṁ.7.3.2) ityādivacanasārūpyāt। tatrāha –

48. ata ēva ca sa brahma॥ 1-2-16 ॥

yatastatra yadēva kaṁ tadēva kham (chā.4.10.5) iti sukhaviśaṣṭasyākāśasyābhidhānam, ata ēva svaśabdābhidhēyassaḥ ākāśaḥ paraṁ brahma। ētaduktaṁ bhavati – agnibhiḥ prāṇō brahma kaṁ brahma khaṁ brahma (chāṁ.4.10.5) ityuktē upakōsala uvāca vijānāmyahaṁ yatprāṇō brahma kaṁ ca tu khaṁ ca na vijānāmi (chāṁ.4.10.5) iti॥

#### vijānāmyaham iti vākyābhiprāyavivaraṇam

asyāyamabhiprāyaḥ – na tāvatprāṇādipratīkōpāsanamagnibhirabhihitam, janmajarāmaraṇādi-bhavabhayabhītasya mumukṣōrbrahmōpadēśāya pravr̥ttatvāt। atō brahmaivōpāsyamupadiṣṭam। tatra prasiddhaiḥ prāṇādibhissamānādhikaraṇaṁ brahma nirdiṣṭam; tēṣu ca prāṇaviśiṣṭatvaṁ jagadvidharaṇayōgēna vā prāṇaśarīratayā prāṇasya niyantr̥tvēna vā brahmaṇa upapadyata iti vijānāmyahaṁ yatprāṇō brahma (chā.4.10.5) ityuktavān। tathā sukhākāśayōrapi brahmaṇaḥ śarīratayā tanniyāmyatvēna viśēṣaṇatvam; utānyōnyavyavacchēdakatayā niratiśayānandarūpa-brahmasvarūpasamarpaṇaparatvēna vā; tatra pr̥thagbhūtayōśśarīratayā viśēṣaṇatvē vaiṣayikasukhabhūtākāśayōrniyāmakatvaṁ brahmaṇassyāditi svarūpāvagatirna syāt anyōnyavyavacchēdakatvē'paricchannānandaikasvarūpatvaṁ brahmaṇassyādityanyatara-prakāranirdidhārayiṣayā kaṁ ca tu khaṁ ca na vijānāmi (chā.4.10.5) ityuktavān। upakōsalasyēmamāśayaṁ jānantō'gnayaḥ yadvā va kaṁ tadēva khaṁ yadēva khaṁ tadēva kam (chā.4.15.5) ityūcirē। brahmaṇassukharūpatvamēvāparicchinnamityarthaḥ। ataḥ prāṇaśarīratayā prāṇaviśiṣṭaṁ yadbrahma, tadēvāparicchannasukharūpaṁ cēti nigamitam – prāṇaṁ ca hāsmai tadākāśaṁ cōcuḥ (chāṁ.4.10.5) iti। ataḥ kaṁ brahma khaṁ brahma (chāṁ.4.10.5) ityatrāparicchinnasukhaṁ brahma pratipāditamiti paraṁ brahmaiva tatra prakr̥tam, tadēva cātrākṣyādhāratayā'bhidhīyata ityakṣyādhāraḥ paramātmā॥ 16॥

#### akṣipuruṣasya paramātmatvē jñāpakāntaram

49. śrutōpaninaṣatkagatyabhidhānācca ॥ 1-2-17 ॥

śrutōpaniṣatkasya – adhigataparamapuruṣayāthātmyasyānusandhēyatayā śrutyantarapratipādyamānā arcirādikā gatiryā, tāmapunarāvr̥ttilakṣaṇaparamapuruṣaprāptikarīmupakōsalāyākṣipuruṣaṁ śrutavatē tē'rciṣamēvābhisambhavanti arciṣō'harahna āpūryamāṇapakṣam (chāṁ 4.15.5) ityārabhya candramasō vidyutaṁ tatpuruṣō'mānavassa ēnānbrahma gamayatyēṣa dēvapathō brahmapatha ētēna pratipadyamānā imaṁ mānavamāvartaṁ nāvartantē (chāṁ.4.15.5) ityantēnōpadiśati। atō'pyayamakṣipuruṣaḥ paramātmā॥17॥

#### vyatirēkōktyā jīvaniṣēdhaḥ

50. anavasthitērasambhavācca nētaraḥ ॥ 1-2-18 ॥

pratibimbādīnāmakṣiṇi niyamēnānavasthānādamr̥tatvādīnāṁ ca nirupādhikānāṁ tēṣvasambhavānna paramātmana itaraḥ chāyādiḥ akṣipuruṣō bhavitumarhāti। pratibimbasya tāvatpuruṣāntara-sannidhānāyattatvānna niyamēnāvasthānasambhavaḥ। jīvasyāpi sarvēndriyavyāpārānuguṇatvāya sarvēndriyakandabhūtē sthānaviśēṣē vr̥ttiriti cakṣuṣi nāvasthānam। dēvatāyāśca raśmibhirēṣō'smin pratiṣṭhitaḥ (chā.7.5.10) iti raśmidvārēṇāvasthānavacanāt dēśāntarāvasthitasyāpi indriyādhiṣṭhānōpapattēḥ na cakṣuṣyavasthānam। sarvēṣāmēvaiṣāṁ nirupādhikāmr̥tatvādayō na sambhavantyēva। tasmādakṣipuruṣaḥ paramātmā ॥18॥

**iti śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē antaradhikaraṇam॥3॥**

### 15 antaryāmyidhakaraṇam

**śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē antaryāmyadhikaraṇam॥4॥**

**adhikaraṇārthaḥ**—
brahmaṇaḥ sarvāntaryāmitvam, na jīvasya

#### antaryāmividyā (vr̥.u.5-7)

#### pūrvānuvādapurassaraṁ taduktārthasamarthanāt saṅgatiḥ

sthānādivyapadēśācca (bra.sū.1.2.14) ityatra yaścakṣuṣi tiṣṭhan (br̥.5.7.18) ityādinā pratipādyamānaṁ cakṣuṣi sthitiniyamanādikaṁ paramātmana ēvēti siddhaṁ kr̥tvā'kṣipuruṣasya paramātmatvaṁ sādhitam? idānīṁ tadēva samarthayatē-

51. antaryāmyadhidaivādhilōkādiṣu taddharmavyapadēśāt ॥ 1-2-19॥

#### viṣayavākyapradarśanam

kāṇvā mādhyandināśca vājasanēyinassamāmananti – yaḥ pr̥thivyāṁ tiṣṭhan pr̥thivyā antarō yaṁ pr̥thivī na vēda yasya pr̥thivī śarīraṁ yaḥ pr̥thivīmantarō yamayatyēṣa ta ātmā'ntaryāmyamr̥taḥ (br̥.5.7.3), yaḥ pr̥thivyāṁ tiṣṭhan pr̥thivyā antarō yaṁ pr̥thivīṁ na vēda yasya pr̥thivī śarīraṁ yaḥ pr̥thivīmantarō yamayatvēṣa ta ātmā'ntaryāmyamr̥taḥ iti। ēvamambvagnyantarikṣavāyvāditya-dvicandratārakākāśa-tamastējassu daivēṣu ca sarvēṣu bhūtēṣu prāṇavākcakṣuśśrōtramanastvagvijñāna-rētassvātmātmīyēṣu ca tiṣṭhantaṁ tattadanantarabhūtaṁ tattadavēdyaṁ tattaccharīrakaṁ tattadyamayantaṁ kañcinnirdiśya ēṣa ta ātmā'ntaryāmyamr̥taḥ (br̥ha.5.7) ityupadiśyatē। mādhyindanapāṭhē tu yassarvēṣu lōkēṣu tiṣṭhan (br̥.5.7) yassarvēṣu vēdēṣu (br̥.5.6.23) yassarvēṣu yajñēṣu (br̥.5.7.23) iti ca paryāyāḥ। yō vijñānē tiṣṭhan (br̥.5.7) ityasya paryāyasya sthānē ya ātmani tiṣṭhan (br̥.5.7.23) iti paryāyaḥ। sa ta ātmā'ntaryāmyamr̥taḥ (br̥.5.7.23) iti ca viśēṣaḥ।

#### saṁśayasvarūpapradarśanam

tatra saṁśayyatē – kimayamantaryāmī pratyagātmā, uta paramātmā – iti। ki yuktam? pratyagātmēti। kutaḥ? vākyaśēṣē draṣṭā śrōtā (br̥.5.7.23) iti karaṇāyattajñānatāśrutēḥ। ēvaṁ draṣṭurēvāntaryāmitvōpadēśāt, nānyō'tō'sti draṣṭā (br̥.5.7.23) iti draṣṭrantaraniṣēdhāccēti।

#### siddhāntārambhaḥ sayuktikaḥ

ēvaṁ prāptē'bhidhīyatē – antaryāmyadhidaivādhilōkādiṣu taddharmavyapadēśāt –
adhidaivādhilōkādipadacihnitēṣu vākyēṣu śrūyamāṇō'ntaryāmyapahatapāpmā paramātmā nārāyaṇaḥ। kāṇvapāṭhasiddhēbhyō'dhidaivādimadbhyō vākyēbhyō'dhikānyadhilōkādimanti vākyāni mādhyandinapāṭhē santīti jñāpanārthamadhidaivādhilōkādiṣvityubhayōrupādānam। tadēvamubhayēṣvapi vākyēṣvantaryāmī paramātmētyarthaḥ। kutaḥ? taddharmavyapadēśāt; paramātmadharmō hyayam, yadēka ēva san sarvalōkasarvabhūtasarvadēvādīnniyamayatīti। tathā uddālakapraśnaḥ – ya imaṁ ca lōkaṁ paraṁ ca lōkaṁ sarvāṇi ca bhūtāni yō'ntarō yamayati (br̥.5.7.1) ityupakramya tamantaryāmiṇaṁ brūhi (br̥.5.7.1) iti, tasya cōttaraṁ yaḥ pr̥thivyāṁ tiṣṭhan (br̥.5.7.3) ityārabhyōktam ॥dē

#### antaryāmitvasya paramātmāsādhāraṇatā

tadētatsarvāllōkān sarvāṇi ca bhūtāni sarvān dēvān sarvānvēdān sarvāṁśca yajñānantaḥ praviśya sarvaprakāraniyamanam, sarvaśarīratayā sarvasyātmatvaṁ ca sarvajñātsatyasaṅkalpāt puruṣōttamādanyasya na sambhavati। tathā hi antaḥpraviṣṭaśśāstā janānāṁ sarvātmā (tai.āra.11.20) tatsr̥ṣṭvā, tadēvānuprāviśat, tadanupraviśya, sacca tyaccābhavat (tai.āna.3.6.) ityādīnyaupaniṣadāni vākyāni paramātmana ēva sarvasya praśāsitr̥tvaṁ sarvasyā'tmatvam ityādīni vadanti। tathā subālōpinaṣadi naivēha kiñcanāgra āsīdamūlamanādhāramimāḥ prajāḥ prajāyantē divyō dēva ēkō nārāyaṇaḥ। cakṣuśca draṣṭavyaṁ ca nārāyaṇaḥ। śrōtraṁ ca śrōtavyaṁ ca nārāyaṇaḥ (subā.6) ityārabhya antaśśarīrē nihitō guhāyāmaja ēkō nityaḥ yasya pr̥thivī śarīraṁ yaḥ pr̥thivīmantarē sañcaran yaṁ pr̥thivī na vēda yasyāpaśśarīram (subā.6) ityādi, yasya mr̥tyuśśarīraṁ yō mr̥tyumantarē sañcaranyaṁ mr̥tyurna vēda ēṣa sarvabhūtāntarātmā'pahatapāpmā divyō dēva ēkō nārāyaṇaḥ (subā.6) iti parasyaiva brahmaṇassarvātmatvaṁ sarvaśarīratvaṁ sarvasya niyantr̥tvaṁ ca pratipādyatē। svābhāvikaṁ cāmr̥tatvaṁ paramātmana ēva dharmaḥ ॥

#### paramātmanaḥ karaṇāyattajñānarāhityam

na ca parasyātmanaḥ karaṇāyattaṁ draṣṭr̥tvādikam; apitu svabhāvata ēva sarvajñatvātsatyasaṅkalpatvācca svata ēva। tathāca śrutiḥ paśyatyacakṣussa śr̥ṇōtyakarṇaḥ apāṇipādō javanō grahītā (śvē.3.19) iti। na ca darśanaśravaṇādiśabdāścakṣurādikaraṇajanmanō jñānasya vācakāḥ; api tu rūpādisākṣātkārasya। sa ca rūpādisākṣātkāraḥ karmatirōhitasvābhāvikajñānasya jīvasya cakṣurādikaraṇajanmā; parasya tu svata ēva
॥

#### nānyō'taḥ iti draṣṭrantaraniṣēdhasāṅgatyam

nānyō'tō'sti draṣṭā (br̥.5.7.23) ityētadapi pūrvavākyōditānniyanturdraṣṭuranyō draṣṭā nāstīti vadati। yaṁ pr̥thivī na vēda (subā.7) yamātmā na vēda (subā.7) ityēvamādibhirvākyaiḥ pr̥thivyātmādiniyāmyairanupalabhyamāna ēva niyamayatīti yatpūrvamuktam, tadēva adr̥ṣṭō draṣṭā aśrutaśśrōtā (br̥.5.7.23) iti nigamayya nānyō'tō'sti draṣṭā (br̥.5.7.23) ityādinā tasya niyanturniyantrantaraṁ niṣidhyatē ॥

#### vyatirēkanirdēśāt antaryāmiṇaḥ pr̥thaktvam

ēṣa ta ātmā (br̥ha.5.7.23) sa ta ātmā iti ca ta iti vyatirēkavibhaktinirdiṣṭasya jīvasya ātmatayōpadiśyamānaḥ antaryāmī na pratyagātmā bhavitumarhāti॥19॥

#### adhikaraṇadvayārthanigamanam

52. na ca smārtamataddharmābhilāpācchārīraśca ॥ 1-2-20 ॥

smārtaṁ pradhānam। śārīraḥ jīvaḥ। smārtaṁ ca śārīraśca nāntaryāmī, ataddharmābhilāpāt- tayōrasambhāvitadharmābhilāpāt। svabhāvata ēva sarvasya draṣṭr̥tvam, sarvasya niyantr̥tvam, sarvasyā'tmatvam, svata ēvāmr̥tatvaṁ ca tayōrna sambhāvanāgandhamarhāti। ētaduktaṁ bhavati – yathā smārtamacētanaṁ sarvajñatvaniyantr̥tvasarvātmatvādikaṁ nārhāti, tathā jīvō'pi, ataddharmatvāt iti॥

#### uttarasūtrāvataraṇam

amīṣāṁ guṇānāṁ paramātmanyanvayaḥ, pratyagātmani vyatirēkaśca sūtradvayēna darśitaḥ॥20॥

nirapēkṣaṁ ca hētvantaramāha –

53. ubhayē'pi hi bhēdēnainamadhīyatē ॥ 1-2-21 ॥

ubhayē – mādhyindanāḥ kāṇvāśca, antāryāmiṇō niyāmyatvēna vāgādibhiracētanaissamam ēnaṁ śārīramapi vibhajyādhīyatē – ya ātmani tiṣṭhannātmanō'ntarō yamātmā na vēda yasyā'tmā śarīraṁ ya ātmānamantarō yamayati sa ta ātmā'ntaryāmyamr̥taḥ (br̥.5.7.22) iti mādhyandināḥ, yō vijñānē tiṣṭhan (br̥.5.7.22) ityādi ca kāṇvāḥ, paramātmaniyāmyatayā tasmādvilakṣaṇatvēnainamadhīyata ityarthaḥ। atō'ntaryāmī pratyagātmanō vilakṣaṇō'pahatapāpmā paramātmā nārāyaṇa iti siddham॥21॥

**iti śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē antaryāmyidhakaraṇam॥4॥**

### 16 adr̥śyatvādiguṇakādhikaraṇam

**śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē adr̥śyatvādiguṇakādhikaraṇam॥**

**adhikaraṇārthaḥ**—
adr̥śyatvādiguṇakaṁ brahmaiva, na pradhānapuruṣau

#### akṣaravidyā (muṇḍa.u.1-1,2-3)

54. adr̥śyatvādiguṇakō dharmōktēḥ ॥ 1-2-22 ॥

#### viṣayavākyapradarśanam

ātharvaṇikā adhīyatē atha parā yayā tadakṣaramadhigamyatē, yattadadrēśyamagrāhyamagōtram acakṣuśśrōtraṁ tadapāṇipādam। nityaṁ vibhuṁ sarvagataṁ susūkṣmaṁ tadavyayaṁ yadbhūtayōniṁ paripaśyanti dhīrāḥ (mu.1.1.5,6) iti; tathōttaratra akṣarātparataḥ paraḥ (mu.2.1.2) iti।

#### saṁśayākāraḥ

tatra sandihyatē – kimihādr̥śyatvādiguṇakam akṣarātparataḥ paraśca prakr̥tipuruṣau, athōbhayatra paramātmaiva – iti।

#### sayuktikaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ

kiṁ tāvat prāptam? prakr̥tipuruṣāviti। kutaḥ? asyākṣarasya adr̥ṣṭō draṣṭā (br̥.5.7.23) ityādāviva na draṣṭr̥tvādiścētanadharmaviśēṣa iha śrūyatē, akṣarātparataḥ paraḥ (mu.2.1.2) iti ca sarvasmādvikārātparabhūtādakṣarādasmātparaḥ kṣētrajñasamaṣṭipuruṣaḥ pratipādyatē।

#### dr̥ṣṭāntasya cētanakāraṇatvānuguṇyam

taduktaṁ bhavati –

rūpādimatsthūlarūpācētanapr̥thivyādibhūtāśrayaṁ dr̥śyatvādikaṁ pratiṣidhyamānaṁ pr̥thivyādisajātīya-sūkṣmarūpācētanamēva upasthāpayati, tacca pradhānamēva। tasmātparatvaṁ ca samiṣṭapuruṣasyaiva prasiddham। tadadhiṣṭhitaṁ ca pradhānaṁ mahadādiviśēṣaparyantaṁ vikārajātaṁ prasūta iti tatra dr̥ṣṭāntā upanyasyantē yathōrṇanābhissr̥jatē gr̥hṇatē ca yathā pr̥thivyāmōṣadhayassambhavanti। yathā sataḥ puruṣātkēśalōmāni tathā'kṣarātsambhavatīha viśvam (muṇḍa.1.1.7) iti। atō'smin prakaraṇē pradhānapuruṣāvēva pratipādyētē iti॥

#### siddhāntapradarśanam

ēvaṁ prāptē brūmaḥ – adr̥śyatvādiguṇakō dharmōktēḥ – adr̥śyatvādiguṇakō'kṣarātparataḥ paraśca paramapuruṣa ēva; kutaḥ? taddharmōktēḥ yassarvajñassarvavit (mu.1.1.9) ityādinā sarvajñatvādikāstasyaiva dharmā ucyantē; tathā hi yayā tadakṣaramidhagamyatē (mu.1.1.5) ityādinā adr̥śyatvādiguṇakamakṣaramabhidhāya akṣarātsambhavatīha viśvam (mu.1.1.7) iti tasmādviśvasambhavaṁ cābhidhāya yassarvajñassarvividyasya jñānamayaṁ tapaḥ। tasmādētadbrahma nāma rūpamannaṁ ca jāyatē (mu.1.1.9) iti bhūtayōnērakṣarasya sarvajñatvādiḥ pratipādyatē। paścāt, akṣarātparataḥ paraḥ (mu.2.1.2) iti ca prakr̥tamadr̥śyatvādiguṇakaṁ bhūtayōnyakṣaraṁ sarvajñamēva paratvēna vyapadiśyatē। ataḥ akṣarātparataḥ paraḥ (mu.2.1.2) ityakṣaraśabdaḥ pañcamyantaḥ prakr̥tamadr̥śyatvādiguṇakamakṣaraṁ nābhidhattē, tasya sarvajñasya viśvayōnēssarvasmātparatvēna tasmādanyasya paratvāsambhavāt। atō'trākṣaraśabdō bhūtasūkṣmamacētanaṁ brūtē॥22॥

#### brahmaṇaḥ ēvākṣaratvē hētudvayam

itaśca na pradhānapuruṣau

55. viśēṣaṇabhēdavyapadēśābhyāñca nētarau ॥ 1-2-23 ॥

viśinaṣṭi hi prakaraṇaṁ – pradhānācca puruṣācca bhūtayōnyakṣaraṁ vyāvartayatītyarthaḥ; ēkavijñānēna sarvavijñānapratijñōpapādanādibhiḥ। tathā tābhyāmakṣarasya bhēdaśca vyapadiśyatē। akṣarātparataḥ paraḥ (muṇḍa.2.1.2) ityādinā। tathā hi – sa brahmavidyāṁ sarvavidyāpratiṣṭhāmatharvāya jyēṣṭhaputrāya prāha (mu.1.1.1) iti sarvavidyāpratiṣṭhābhūtā brahmavidyā prakrāntā; paravidyaiva ca sarvavidyāpratiṣṭhā; tāmimāṁ sarvavidyāpratiṣṭhāṁ vidyāṁ caturmukhātharvādiguruparamparayā'ṅgirasā prāptāṁ jijñāsuḥ śaunakō ha vai mahāśālō'ṅgirasaṁ vidhivadupasannaḥ papraccha kasminnu bhagavō vijñātē sarvamidaṁ vijñātaṁ bhavati (mu.1.1.3) iti brahmavidyāyāssarvavidyāśrayatvādbrahmavijñānēna sarvaṁ vijñātaṁ bhavatīti kr̥tvā brahmasvarūpamanēna pr̥ṣṭam । tasmai sa hōvāca dvē vidyē vēditavyē iti ha sma yadbrahmavidō vadanti parā caivāparā ca (br̥ha.6.4.22) iti। brahmaprēpsunā dvē vidyē vēditavyē – brahmaviṣayē parōkṣāparōkṣarūpē dvē vijñānē upādēyē ityarthaḥ।

#### vidyāvibhāga-tatphalayōḥ pradarśanam

tatra parōkṣaṁ śāstrajanyaṁ jñānam, aparōkṣaṁ yōgajanyam, tayōrbrahmaprāptyupāyabhūtamaparōkṣaṁ jñānam; tacca bhaktirūpāpannam, yamēvaiṣa vr̥ṇutē tēna labhyaḥ (muṇḍa.3.2.3) ityatraiva viśēṣyamāṇatvāt, tadupāyaścāgamajanyaṁ vivēkādisādhanasaptakānugr̥hītaṁ jñānam, tamētaṁ vēdānuvacanēna brāhmaṇā vividiṣanti yajñēna dānēna tapasā'nāśakēna (br̥ha.6.4.22) iti śrutēḥ। āha ca bhagavānparāśaraḥ tatprāptihēturjñānaṁ ca karma cōktaṁ mahāmunē। āgamōtthaṁ vivēkācca dvidhā jñānaṁ tathōcyatē (vi.pu.6.5.60) iti। tatrāparā r̥gvēdō yajurvēdaḥ (mu.1.1.5) ityādinā dharmaśāstrāṇi (mu.1.1.5) ityantēna āgamōtthaṁ brahmasākṣātkārahētubhūtaṁ parōkṣajñānamuktam। sāṅgasya sētihāsapurāṇasya sadharmaśāstrasya samīmāṁsasya vēdasya brahmajñānōtpattihētutvāt atha parā yayā tadakṣaramidhagamyatē (mu.1.1.5) ityupāsanākhyaṁ brahmasākṣātkāralakṣaṇaṁ bhaktirūpāpannaṁ jñānaṁ yattadadrēśyamagrāhyam ityādinā parōkṣāparōkṣarūpajñānadvayaviṣayasya parasya brahmaṇaḥ svarūpamucyatē ।

#### brahmaṇō jagadutpattiḥ

yathōrṇanābhissr̥jatē gr̥hṇatē ca (mu.1.1.7) ityādinā yathōktasvarūpātparasmāt brahmaṇō'kṣarātkr̥tsnasya cētanācētanātmakaprapañcasya utpattiruktā; viśvamiti vacanānnācētanamātrasya । tapasā cīyatē brahma tatō'nnamabhijāyatē। annātprāṇō manassatyaṁ lōkāḥ karmasu cāmr̥tam (mu.1.1.8) iti brahmaṇō viśvōtpattiprakāra ucyatē । tapasā – jñānēna, yasya jñānamayaṁ tapaḥ (mu..1.1.9) iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt; cīyatē upacīyatē; bahu syām (chā.6.2.3, tai.āna.6) iti saṅkalparūpēṇa jñānēna brahma sr̥ṣṭyunmukhaṁ bhavatītyarthaḥ। tatō'nnamabhijāyatē – adyata ityannam, viśvasya bhōktr̥vargasya bhōgyabhūtaṁ bhūtasūkṣmamavyākr̥taṁ parasmādbrahmaṇō jāyata ityarthaḥ । prāṇamanaḥ prabhr̥ti ca svargāpavargarūpaphalasādhanabhūtakarmaparyantaṁ sarvaṁ vikārajātaṁ tasmādēva jāyatē। yassarvajñassarvavit (mu.1.1.9) ityādinā sr̥ṣṭyupakaraṇabhūtaṁ sārvajñyasatyasaṅkalpatvādikamuktam। sarvajñātsatyasaṅkalpāt parasmādbrahmaṇō'kṣarādētat kāryākāraṁ brahma nāmarūpavibhaktaṁ bhōktr̥bhōgyarūpaṁ ca jāyatē।

#### muṇḍakagatadvitīyakhaṇḍārthōpapādanam

tadētatsatyam (mu.1.2.1) iti parasya brahmaṇō nirupādhikasatyatvamucyatē। mantrēṣu karmāṇi kavayō yānyapaśyaṁstāni trētāyāṁ bahudhā santatāni। tānyācarata niyataṁ satyakāmāḥ (mu.1.2.1) iti sārvajñyasatyasaṅkalpatvādikalyāṇaguṇākaramakṣaraṁ puruṣaṁ svatassatyaṁ kāmayamānāstatprāptayē phalāntarēbhyō viraktā r̥gyajussāmātharvasu kavibhirdr̥ṣṭāni varṇāśramōcitāni trētāgniṣu bahudhā santatāni karmāṇyācaratēti ēṣa vaḥ panthāḥ (mu.1.2.1) ityārabhya ēṣa vaḥ puṇyassukr̥tō brahmalōkaḥ (muṇḍa.1.2.6) ityantēna karmānuṣṭhānaprakāraṁ, śrutismr̥ticōditēṣu karmasvēkatarakarmavaidhuryē'pītarēṣām anuṣṭhitānāmapi niṣphalatvam, ayathānuṣṭhitasya cānanuṣṭhitasamatvam abhidhāya plavā hyētē adr̥ḍhā yajñarūpā aṣṭādaśōktamavaraṁ yēṣu karma। ētacchrēyō yē'bhinandanti mūḍhā jarāmr̥tyū tē punarēvāpi yanti (mu.1.2.7) ityādinā phalābhisandhipūrvakatvēna jñānavidhuratayā cāvaraṁ karmācaratāṁ punarāvr̥ttimuktvā tapaśśraddhē yē hyupavasanti (muṇḍa.1.2.11) ityādinā punarapi phalābhisandhirahitaṁ jñāninānuṣṭhitaṁ karma brahma prāptayē bhavatīti praśasya parīkṣya lōkān (muṇḍa.1.2.12) ityādinā kēvalakarmaphalēṣu viraktasya yathōdita karmānugr̥hītaṁ brahmaprāptyupāyabhūtaṁ jñānaṁ jijñāsamānasya ca ācāryōpasadanaṁ vidhāya,

#### tr̥tīyakhaṇḍārthānuvādaḥ

tadētatsatyaṁ yathā sudīptāt (muṇḍa.2.1.1) ityādinā, sō'vidyāgranthiṁ vikiratīha sōmya (muṇḍa.2.1.10) ityantēna pūrvōktasyākṣarasya bhūtayōnēḥ parasya brahmaṇaḥ paramapuruṣasyānuktaissvarūpaguṇaissaha sarvabhūtāntarātmatayā viśvaśarīratvēna viśvarūpatvam, tasmādviśvasr̥ṣṭiṁ ca vispaṣṭamabhidhāya

#### caturthakhaṇḍārthavivaraṇam
