saśrēṣṭhānāṁ prāṇānāṁ brahmaṇa utpattiriyattāparimāṇaṁ cōktam; tēṣāṁ prāṇānāmagnyādidēvatādhiṣṭhitatvaṁ ca pūrvamēva **abhimānivyapadēśastu viśēṣānugatibhyām** (śārī.2.1.5) ityanēna sūtrēṇa prasaṅgādupapāditam; jīvasya ca svabhōgasādhanānāmēṣāmadhiṣṭhātr̥tvaṁ lōkasiddham, **ēvamēvaiṣa ētān prāṇān gr̥hītvā svē śarīrē yathākāmaṁ parivartatē** (br̥.4.1.18) ityādiśrutisiddhaṁ ca।

#### prakr̥tōpayōgī saṁśayaḥ, pūrvapakṣaśca

tadidaṁ jīvasyāgnyādidēvatānāṁ ca prāṇaviṣayamadhiṣṭhānaṁ kiṁ svāyattam; uta paramātmāyattamiti viṣayē nairapēkṣyātsvāyattam ॥

#### siddhāntamukhēna sūtrārtavarṇanam

iti prāpta ucyatē – jyōtirādyadhiṣṭhānamiti । prāṇavatā – jīvēna saha jyōtirādīnāmagnyādidēvatānāṁ prāṇaviṣayamadhiṣṭhānam, tadāmananāt – tasya paramātmanaḥ āmananādbhavati । āmananam – ābhimukhyēna mananam, paramātmanassaṅkalpādēva bhavatītyarthaḥ। kuta ētat? śabdāt – indriyāṇāṁ sābhimānidēvatānāṁ jīvātmanaśca svakāryēṣu paramapuruṣamananāyattattvaśāstrāt। yathā'ntaryāmibrāhmaṇādiṣu **yō'gnau tiṣṭhannagnērantarō yamagnirna vēda yasyāgniśśarīraṁ yō'gnimantarō yamayati sa ta ātmā'ntaryāmyamr̥taḥ** (br̥.5.7.5) **yō vāyau tiṣṭhan (br̥.5.7.5) ya ādityē tiṣṭhan** (br̥ha.5.7.5) **ya ātmani tiṣṭhan** (br̥ha.5.7.5) **yaścakṣuṣi tiṣṭhan** (br̥ha.5.7.5) ityādi। yathā ca **bhīṣā'smādvātaḥ pavatē bhīṣōdēti sūryaḥ। bhīṣā'smādagniścēndraśca । mr̥tyurdhāvati pañcamaḥ** (tai.āna.8.1) iti । tathā **ētasya vā akṣarasya praśāsanē gārgi sūryācandramasau vidhr̥tau tiṣṭhataḥ** (br̥.5.8.9) ityādi ॥13॥

#### sarvēṣāṁ paramātmādhiṣṭhitatvanaiyatyam

**282. tasya ca nityatvāt ॥ 2–4–14 ॥**

sarvēṣāṁ paramātmādhiṣṭhitatvasya nityatvāt, svarūpānubandhitvēna niyatatvācca tatsaṅkalpādēvaiṣāmadhiṣṭhātr̥tvamavarjanīyam। **tatsr̥ṣṭvā tadēvānuprāviśat tadanupraviśya sacca tyaccābhavat** (tai.u.āna.6-2-3) ityādinā paramapuruṣasya niyantr̥tvēna sarvacidacidvastvanupravēśaḥ svarūpānubandhī śrūyatē; smaryatē ca **viṣṭabhyāhamidaṁ kr̥tsnamēkāṁśēna sthitō jagat** (bha.gī.10.42) iti ॥14॥

**iti śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē jyōtirādyadhiṣṭhānādhikaraṇam ॥6॥**

### 07 indriyādhikaraṇam

**śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē indriyādhikaraṇam॥7॥**

**adhikaraṇārthaḥ**—
śrēṣṭhaprāṇaṁ vihāyaiva prāṇānām indriyarūpatā

**283. ta indriyāṇi tadvyapadēśādanyatra śrēṣṭhāt ॥ 2–4–15 ॥**

#### vicārōpayōgī saṁśayaḥ

kiṁ sarvē prāṇaśabdanirdiṣṭā indriyāṇi, uta śrēṣṭhaprāṇavyatiraktā ēvēti viśayē

#### pūrvapakṣaḥ

prāṇaśabdavācyatvāt, karaṇatvācca sarva ēvēndriyāṇi॥

#### siddhāntamukhēna sūtrārthavivaraṇam

iti prāpta ucyatē – śrēṣṭhavyatiriktā ēva prāṇā indriyāṇi kutaḥ? śrēṣṭhādanyēṣvēva prāṇēṣu tadvyapadēśāt । **indriyāṇi daśaikaṁ ca pañca cēndriyagōcarāḥ** (bha.gī.13.5) ityādibhirhi cakṣurādiṣu samanaskēṣvēva indriyaśabdō vyapadiśyatē॥ 15 ॥

#### prāṇē pr̥thakśravaṇam indriyavailakṣaṇyaṁ ca uktārthasthāpakam

**284. bhēdaśrutērvailakṣaṇyācca ॥ 2–4–16 ॥**

**ētasmājjāyatē prāṇō manassarvēndriyāṇi ca** (mu.2.1.3) ityādiṣvindriyēbhyaḥ prāṇasya pr̥thakchravaṇātprāṇavyatiraktānāmēvēndriyatvamavagamyatē। manasaḥ pr̥thakchravaṇē'pi tasyānyatrēndriyāntarbhāva uktaḥ **manaṣṣaṣṭhānīndriyāṇi** (bha.gī.15.7) ityādau। vailakṣaṇyaṁ ca cakṣurādibhyaḥ śrēṣṭhaprāṇasyōpalabhyatē; suṣuptau hi prāṇasya vr̥ttirupalabhyatē, cakṣurādīnāṁ tu vr̥ttirnōpalabhyatē। kāryaṁ ca cakṣurvāgādīnāṁ samanaskānāṁ jñānakarmasādhanatvam; prāṇasya tu śarīrēndriyadhāraṇam ।

#### indriyāṇāṁ prāṇapadavyapadēśyatvē hētuḥ

prāṇādhīnadhāraṇatvāttvindriyēṣu prāṇaśabdavyapadēśaḥ; tathā ca śrutiḥ ta ētasyaiva sarvē rūpamabhavan tasmādēta ētēnākhyāyantē iti। rūpamabhavan – śarīramabhavan, tadadhīnapravr̥ttayō'bhavannityarthaḥ॥16॥

**iti śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē indriyādhikaraṇam॥7॥**

### 08 saṁjñāmūrtikl̥ptyadhikaraṇam

**śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē sañjñāmūrtikl̥ptyadhikaraṇam॥8॥**

**adhikaraṇārthaḥ**—
nāmarūpavyākaraṇātmakaprapañcavyaṣṭisr̥ṣṭēḥ trivr̥tkartr̥samānakartr̥tā

**285. sañjñāmūrtikl̥ptistu trivr̥rtkuvata upadēśāt ॥ 2–4–17 ॥**

#### pēṭikāsaṅgatiḥ

bhūtēndriyādīnāṁ samaṣṭisr̥ṣṭiḥ, jīvānāṁ kartr̥tvaṁ ca parasmādbrahmaṇa ityuktaṁ purastāt। jīvānāṁ svēndriyādhiṣṭhānaṁ ca parāyattamiti cānantaraṁ sthirīkaraṇāya smāritam।

#### saṁśayō vicārārthaḥ

yā tviyaṁ nāmarūpavyākaraṇātmikā prapañcavyaṣṭisr̥ṣṭiḥ, sā kiṁ samaṣṭijīvarūpasya hiraṇyagarbhasyaiva karma, uta tējaḥ prabhr̥tiśarīrakasya parasyābādisr̥ṣṭivaddhiraṇyagarbhaśarīrakasya parasya brahmaṇa, itīdānīṁ cintyatē।

#### sahētukaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ

kiṁ yuktam? samaṣṭijīvasyēti; kutaḥ? **anēna jīvēnā'tmanā'nupraviśya nāmarūpē vyākaravāṇi** (chāṁ.6.3.2) iti jīvakartr̥katvaśravaṇāt। na hi parā dēvatā svēna rūpēṇa nāmarūpē vyākaravāṇītyaikṣata; api tu svāṁśabhūtēna jīvarūpēṇa, **anēna jīvēnā'tmanā** (chāṁ.6.3.2) iti vacanāt।

#### uktavyākhyānē lākṣaṇikatvāśaṅkā-parihārau

nanvēvaṁ cārēṇānupraviśya parabalaṁ saṅkalayānītivat vyākaravāṇi ityuttamapuruṣaḥ katr̥sthakriyaśca praviśatirlākṣaṇikassyāt।

naivam, tatra rājacārayōḥ svarūpabhēdāllākṣaṇikatvam, iha tu jīvasyāpi svāṁśatvēna svarūpatvāttēna rūpēṇa pravēśō vyākaraṇaṁ cātmana ēvēti na lākṣaṇikatvaprasaṅgaḥ।

na ca sahayōgalakṣaṇēyaṁ tr̥tīyā, kārakavibhaktau sambhavantyāmupapadavibhaktēḥ anyāyyatvāt।

na ca karaṇē tr̥tīyā, brahmakartr̥kayōḥ pravēśavyākaraṇayōrjīvasya sādhakatamatvābhāvāt।

na ca jīvasya kartr̥tvaṁ pravēśamātrē paryavasyati, nāmarūpavyākaraṇaṁ tu brahmaṇa ēvēti śakyaṁ vaktum, ktvāpratyayēna samānakartr̥katvapratītēḥ। jīvasya svāṁśatvēna svarūpatvē'pi parasvarūpavyāvr̥ttyarthaḥ anēna jīvēna (chā.6.3.2) iti parāktvēna parāmarśaḥ। atō hiraṇyagarbhakartr̥kēyaṁ nāmarūpavyākriyā। ata ēva ca smr̥tiṣu caturmukhakartr̥kasr̥ṣṭiprakaraṇē nāmarūpavyākaraṇaṁ saṅkīrtyatē **nāmarūpaṁ ca bhūtānāṁ kr̥tyānāṁ ca prapañcanam। vēdaśabdēbhya ēvādau dēvādīnāṁ cakāra saḥ** (vi.pu.1.5.63) ityādi॥

#### sūtrārthavivr̥tyā siddhāntapradarśanam

ēvaṁ prāptē'bhidhīyatē – sañjñāmūrti ptistu – iti। tuśabdaḥ pakṣaṁ vyāvartayati; sañjñāmūrtikl̥ptiḥ – nāmarūpavyākaraṇam, tat trivr̥tkurvataḥ parasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ, tasyaiva nāmarūpavyākaraṇōpadēśāt। trivr̥tkaraṇaṁ kurvata ēva hi nāmarūpavyākaraṇamupadiśyatē – **sēyaṁ dēvataikṣata hantāhamimāstisrō dēvatā anēna jīvēnā'tmanā'nupraviśya nāmarūpē vyākaravāṇi tāsāṁ trivr̥taṁ trivr̥tamēkaikāṁ karavāṇi** (chā.6.3.2) iti samānakartr̥katvapratītēḥ। trivr̥tkaraṇaṁ tu caturmukhasyāṇḍāntarvartinō na sambhavati, trivr̥tkr̥taistējōbannairhyaṇḍamutpādyatē; caturmukhasya cāṇḍē sambhavaḥ smaryatē – tasminnaṇḍē'bhavadbrahmā sarvalōkapitāmahaḥ iti। atastrivr̥tkaraṇaṁ parasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ; tatsamānakartr̥kaṁ nāmarūpavyākaraṇaṁ ca tasyaivēti vijñāyatē।

#### anēna jīvēnēti śrutyarthasāṅgatyam

kathaṁ tarhi **anēna jīvēna** (chā.6.3.2) iti saṅgacchatē, **ātmanā jīvēna** (chā.6.3.2) iti sāmānādhikaraṇyāt jīvaśarīraṁ paraṁ brahmaiva jīvaśabdēnābhidhīyatē; yathā **tattēja aikṣata** (chā.6.2.3) **tadapō'sr̥jata** (chāṁ.6.2.3) **tā āpa aikṣanta** (chāṁ.6.2.3) **tā annamasr̥janta** (chāṁ.6.2.3) iti tējaḥ prabhr̥tiśarīrakaṁ paramēva brahmābhidhīyatē। atō jīvasamaṣṭibhūtahiraṇyagarbhaśarīrakasya parasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ karma nāmarūpavyākaraṇam।

#### praviśatēḥ uttamapuruṣasya caturmukhasr̥ṣṭau nāmarūpavyākaraṇōpadēśasya ca sāmarasyavarṇanam

ēvaṁ ca praviśya **nāmarūpē vyākaravāṇi** (chā.6.3.2) iti praviśatiruttamapuruṣaścākliṣṭau mukhyārthāvēva bhavataḥ। pravēśavyākaraṇayōssamānakartr̥katvamapyupapadyatē। caturmukhaśarīrakasya parasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ karma dēvādivicitrasr̥ṣṭiriti caturmukhakartr̥kasr̥ṣṭiprakaraṇē nāmarūpavyākriyōpadēśa- ścōpapadyatē।

#### uktārthānuguṇaḥ anupravēśanāmarūpavyākaraṇaśrutyarthaḥ

**ataḥ sēyaṁ dēvatā** (chā.6.3.2) ityādivākyasyāyamarthaḥ – imāḥ – tējō'bannarūpāstisrō dēvatā anēna jīvēna – jīvasamaṣṭiviśiṣṭēnā'tmanā'nupraviśya nāmarūpē vyākaravāṇi – dēvādivicitrasr̥ṣṭiṁ tannāmadhēyāni ca karavāṇi। tadarthamanyōnyasaṁsargamaprāptānāmēṣāṁ tējōbannānāṁ viśēṣasr̥ṣṭyasamarthānāṁ tatsāmarthyāyaikaikāṁ trivr̥taṁ trivr̥taṁ karavāṇi – iti। ataḥ parasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ karmēdaṁ nāmarūpavyākaraṇam॥17॥

#### uktārthē vaighaṭhyaśaṅkāyāḥ parihārarūpatayā uttarasūtrāvataraṇama

atha syāt nāmarūpavyākaraṇasya trivr̥tkaraṇēnaikakartr̥katvātparamātmakartr̥kamiti na śakyatē vaktum, trivr̥tkaraṇasyāpi jīvakartr̥katvasambhavāt। aṇḍasr̥ṣṭyuttarakālaṁ hi caturmukhasr̥ṣṭajīvēṣu trivr̥tkaraṇaprakāra upadiśyatē – **yathā tu khalu sōmyēmāstisrō dēvatāḥ puruṣaṁ prāpya trivr̥ttrivr̥dēkaikā bhavati tanmē vijānāhīti** (chā.6.4.7) **annamaśitaṁ trēdhā vidhīyatē tasya yaḥ sthaviṣṭhō bhāgastatpurīṣaṁ bhavati yō madhyamastanmāṁsaṁ yō'ṇiṣṭhaḥ tanmanaḥ** (chā.6.5.1) ityādinā । tathā pūrvasminnapi vākyē **yadagnē rōhitaṁ rūpaṁ tējasastadrūpaṁ yacchuklaṁ tadapāṁ yatkr̥ṣṇaṁ tadannasya** (chāṁ.6.5.1) ityādinā caturmukhasr̥ṣṭāgnyādityacandravidyutsu trivr̥tkaraṇaṁ pradarśyatē। nāmarūpavyākaraṇōttarakālaṁ ca trivr̥tkaraṇaṁ śrūyatē। sēyaṁ dēvatā, imāstisrō dēvatāḥ anēna jīvēnā'tmanā'nupraviśya nāmarūpē vyākarōttāsāṁ trivr̥tantrivr̥tamēkaikāmakarōt (chā.6.3.4) iti । tatrāha॥

**286. māṁsādi bhaumaṁ yathāśabdamitarayōśca ॥ 2–4–18 ॥**

#### śaṅkānuvādapūrvakaṁ sūtrārthamukhēna parihāraḥ

yaduktamaṇḍasr̥ṣṭyuttarakālaṁ caturmukhasr̥ṣṭadēvatādiviṣayō'yaṁ **tāsāṁ trivr̥taṁ trivr̥tamēkaikāmakarōt** (chā.6.3.2) iti trivr̥tkaraṇōpadēśa iti ॥

tannōpapadyatē, **annamaśitaṁ trēdhā vidhīyatē** (chā.6.5.1) ityatra māṁsamanasōḥ purīṣādaṇutvēnāṇīyastvēna ca vyapadiṣṭayōḥ kāraṇānuvidhāyitvēnāpyataijasatvaprasaṅgāt **āpaḥ pītāḥ** (chā.6.5.2) ityatrāpi mūtraprāṇayōḥ sthaviṣṭhāṇīyasōḥ pārthivatvataijasatvaprasaṅgācca।

na caivamiṣyatē; māṁsādi bhaumamiṣyatē – purīṣavanmāṁsamanasī api bhaumē – pārthivē iṣyētē **annamaśitaṁ trēdhā** (chā.6.5.2) iti prakramāt।

yathāśabdamitarayōśca – itarayōrapi **āpaḥpītāḥ** (chāṁ.6.5.2) **tējō'śitam** (chāṁ.6.5.2) iti paryāyayōryathāśabdaṁ vikārā iṣyantē।

**āpaḥ pītāstrēdhā vidhīyantē** (chāṁ.6.5.2) ityapāmēva trēdhā pariṇāmaḥ śabdātpratīyatē; tathā **tējō'śitaṁ trēdhā vidhīyatē** (chāṁ.6.5.2) ityapi tējasa ēva trēdhā pariṇāmaḥ śabdātpratīyatē; ataḥ purīṣamāṁsamanāṁsi pr̥thivīvikārāḥ, mūtralōhitaprāṇāḥ abvikārāḥ, asthimajjāvācastējōvikārā iti pratipattavyam ॥

**annamayaṁ hi sōmya manaḥ, āpōmayaḥ prāṇastējōmayī vāk** (chāṁ.6.5.2) iti vākyaśēṣāvirōdhācca ।

ataḥ **tāsāṁ trivr̥taṁ trivr̥tamēkaikāmakarōt** (chā.6.3.4) ityuktastrivr̥tkaraṇaprakāraḥ **annamaśitam** (chāṁ.6.5.2) ityādinā na pradarśyatē । tathā sati manaḥ prāṇavācāṁ trayāṇāmapyaṇīyastvēna taijasatvāt **annamayaṁ hi sōmya manaḥ** (chāṁ.6.5.2) ityādirvirudhyatē।

prāgēva trivr̥tkr̥tānāṁ pr̥thivyādīnāṁ puruṣaṁ prāptānām **annamaśitam** (chāṁ.6.5.2) ityādinaikaikasya trēdhā pariṇāma ucyatē। aṇḍasr̥ṣṭēḥ prāgēva ca tējōbannānāṁ trivr̥tkaraṇēna bhavitavyam, atrivr̥tkr̥tānāṁ tēṣāṁ kāryārambhāsāmarthyāt। anyōnyasaṁyuktānāmēva hi kāryārambhasāmarthyam; tadēva ca trivr̥tkaraṇam। tathā ca smaryatē **nānāvīryāḥ pr̥thagbhūtāstatastē saṁhatiṁ vinā। nāśaknuvan prajāssraṣṭumasamāgamya kr̥tsnaśaḥ॥ samētyānyōnyasaṁyōgaṁ parasparasamāśrayāḥ। mahadādyā viśēṣāntā hyaṇḍamutpādayanti tē** (vi.pu.1.2.52) iti। ata ēva ca **anēna jīvēnā'tmanā'nupraviśya nāmarūpē vyākarōt tāsāṁ trivr̥taṁ trivr̥tamēkaikāmakarōt** (chā.6.3.4) iti pāṭhakramō'rthakramēṇa bādhyatē ।

#### agnyādiṣu trivr̥tkaraṇapradarśanaprayōjanam

aṇḍāntarvartiṣvagnyādityādiṣu trivr̥tkaraṇapradarśanaṁ śvētakētōśśuśruṣōraṇḍāntarvartitvēna; tasya bahiṣṭhavastuṣu trivr̥tkaraṇapradarśanāyōgāt trivr̥tkr̥tānāṁ kāryēṣu agnyādityādiṣu kriyatē ॥18॥

#### trirūpasya ēkaikarūpēṇa vyapadēśōpapattiḥ

syādētat; **annamaśitam** (chā.6.5.1) **āpaḥ pītāḥ** (chāṁ.6.5.2) **tējō'śitam** (chāṁ.6.5.3) iti trivr̥tkr̥tānāmannādīnāmēkaikasya tējōbannātmakatvēna trirūpasya kathamannamāpastēja ityēkaikarūpēṇa vyapadēśa upapadyata iti; tatrāha –

287. vaiśēṣyāttu tadvādastadvādaḥ ॥ 2–4–19 ॥

vaiśēṣyaṁ – viśēṣabhāvaḥ । trivr̥tkaraṇēna trirūpē'pyēkaikasminnannādyādhikyāttatra tatrānnādivādaḥ। dviruktiradhyāyasamāptiṁ dyōtayati ॥19॥

**iti śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē sañjñāmūrtikl̥ptyadhikaraṇam ॥ 8 ॥**

**iti śrībhagavadrāmānujaviracitē śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyēdvitīyasyādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ॥ 4॥**

# +3 sādhanam

**śrībhagavadrāmānujaviracitē śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē**

**tr̥tīyaḥ sādhanādhyāyaḥ ॥3 ॥**

## adhikaraṇāni – 55, sūtrāṇi 182

## adhyāyārthaḥ – paramakāraṇa-paramapuruṣārthabhūtabrahmaṇaḥ prāptyupāyatayā vēdāntanihitānāṁ vidyānāṁ cintanam

## +1 vairāgyam

**prathamaḥ vairāgyapādaḥ 3-1**

### adhikaraṇāni – 6, sūtrāṇi – 27

### pādārthaḥ – saṁsāracakrē parivartamānasya jīvasya jāgradavasthāśēṣabhūtānām apuruṣārthabhūtānāṁ dōṣāṇāṁ cintanam

### 01 tadantarapratipattyadhikaraṇam

**tadantarapratipattyidhakaraṇam॥**

**viṣayaḥ**—
pañcāgnividyāviṣayaḥ – chā.u.5-3-10

**adhikaraṇārthaḥ**—
dēhād dēhāntaraṁ gacchatāṁ jīvānāṁ gatāgatī  
dēhārambhahētubhiḥ bhūta-sūkṣmaiḥ sahaiva

**288. tadantarapratipattau raṁhati sampariṣvaktaḥ praśnanirūpaṇābhyām ॥ 3–1–1 ॥**

#### saṅgatyarthaṁ pūrvōttaradvikārtha (siddha-sādhya) saṅkṣēpaḥ

atikrāntādhyāyadvayēna nikhilajagadēkakāraṇaṁ nirastanikhiladōṣagandhamaparimitōdāra-guṇasāgaraṁ sakalētaravilakṣaṇaṁ paraṁ brahma mumukṣubhirupāsyatayā vēdāntāḥ pratipādayantītyayamarthaḥ smr̥tinyāya-virōdhiparihāraparapakṣapratikṣēpavēdāntavākyaparasparavirōdhaparihārarūpakāryasvarūpasaṁśōdhanaiḥ taddurdharṣaṇatvahētubhissaha sthāpitaḥ; atō'dhyāyadvayēna brahmasvarūpaṁ pratipāditam ॥

uttarēṇēdānīṁ tatprāptyupāyaissaha prāptiprakāraścintayitumiṣyatē ॥

#### tr̥tīyādhyāyārthasaṅkṣēpaḥ

tatra tr̥tīyādhyāyē upāyabhūtōpāsanaviṣayā cintā vartatē। upāsanārambhābhyarhitōpāyaśca prāpyavastuvyatiriktavaitr̥ṣṇyam, prāpyatr̥ṣṇā cēti; tatsiddhyarthaṁ jīvasya lōkāntarēṣu sañcaratō jāgratassvapatassuṣuptasya mūrcchataśca dōṣāḥ, parasya ca brahmaṇastadrahitatā, kalyāṇaguṇākaratvaṁ ca prathamadvitīyayōḥ pādayōḥ pratipādyantē ॥

#### prakr̥tādhikaraṇīyaḥ saṁśayaḥ

tatra dēhāddēhāntaraṁ gacchannayaṁ jīvō dēhāntarārambhahētubhirbhūtasūkṣmaissampariṣvakta ēva gacchati, uta nēti cintāyām –

#### sayuktikaḥ pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ

yatra yatra jīvō yāti; tatra tatra bhūtasūkṣmāṇāṁ sulabhatvādasampariṣvaktō yātīti prāptam। paścādapi pūrvapakṣabījānyupanyasya nirasiṣyati॥

#### sūtrataḥ siddhāntasvarūpavarṇanam

tatra siddhāntamāha – tadantarapratipattau raṁhati sampariṣvaktaḥ- iti। **sañjñāmūrtikl̥ptiḥ** (bra.sū. 2.4.17) iti mūrtiśabdēna dēhaḥ prastutaḥ; sa tacchabdēna parāmr̥śyatē । tadantarapratipattau – dēhāntaragamanē bhūtasūkṣmaissampariṣvaktō jīvō raṁhati – gacchatītyarthaḥ।

kutaḥ? praśnanirūpaṇābhyāṁ – praśnaprativacanābhyām।

#### sūtrōpāttayōḥ praśna-prativacanayōḥ nirūpaṇam

pañcāgnividyāyāmēvaṁ praśnaprativacanē āmnāyētē – śvētakētuṁ kilāruṇēyaṁ pāñcālaḥ pravāhaṇaḥ karmiṇāṁ gantavyadēśaṁ, punarāvr̥ttiprakāraṁ, dēvayānapitr̥yāṇapathavyāvartanē, amuṣya lōkasyāprāptāraṁ ca vētthēti pr̥ṣṭvēdamapi papraccha – **vēttha yathā pañcamyāmāhutāvāpaḥ puruṣavacasō bhavanti** (chāṁ. 5.3.3) iti। tata imaṁ paścimaṁ praśnaṁ pratibruvaṁśca dyulōkamagnitvēna rūpayitvā **tasminnētasminnagnau dēvāḥ śraddhāṁ juhvati tasyā āhutēssōmō rājā sambhavati** (chā.5.4.2) ityādinā – dēvākhyāḥ jīvasya prāṇāḥ agnitvēna rūpitē dyulōkē śraddhākhyaṁ vastu prakṣipanti; sā ca śraddhā sōmarājākhyāmr̥tamayadēharūpēṇa pariṇamatē; taṁ cāmr̥tamayaṁ dēhaṁ ta ēva prāṇāḥ parjanyē'gnitvēna rūpitē prakṣipanti; sa ca dēhastatra prakṣiptō varṣaṁ bhavati; tacca varṣaṁ ta ēva prāṇāḥ pr̥thivyāmagnitvarūpitāyāṁ prakṣipanti; tacca tatra prakṣiptamannaṁ bhavati; taccānnaṁ ta ēva puruṣē'gnitvarūpitē prakṣipanti; tacca tatra rētō bhavati; tacca ta ēva yōṣāyāmagnitvarūpitāyāṁ prakṣipanti; tacca tatra prakṣiptaṁ garbhō bhavatītyuktvā āha – **iti tu pañcamyāmāhutāvāpaḥ puruṣavacasō bhavanti** (chā.5.9.1) iti । ēvaṁ pañcamyāmāhutau hutāyāmāpaḥ puruṣaśabdābhilapyā bhavantītyarthaḥ ॥

#### uktārthasiddhērnigamanam

ēvamuktē – pūrvāsvapyāhutiṣvanuvartamānānāmēvāpāṁ sūkṣmarūpāṇāmidānīṁ puruṣākāratvaṁ bhavatītyuktaṁ bhavati। ata ēvaṁ praśnaprativacanābhyāṁ dēhahētubhūtairbhūtasūkṣmaissaha tatra tatrayātīti gamyatē॥1॥

#### adbhiḥ pariṣvaṅgavacasaḥ sarvabhūtasūkṣmapariṣvaṅgaparatā

nanu **āpaḥ puruṣavacasaḥ** (chā.5.9.1) ityuktē apāṁ puruṣākārapariṇāmapratītērgacchatā jīvēna tāsāmēva pariṣvaṅgaḥ pratīyatē; ataḥ kathaṁ sarvēṣāṁ bhūtasūkṣmāṇāṁ pariṣvaṅga iti; tatrāha –

**289. tryātmakatvāttu bhūyastvāt ॥ 3–1–2 ॥**

tuśabdaścōdyaṁ vyāvartayati। dēhārambhakāṇāmapāṁ kēvalānāṁ na dēhārambhasambhavaḥ dēhādyārambhāya hi **tāsāṁ trivr̥taṁ trivr̥tamēkaikāmakarōt** (chā.6.3.3) iti trivr̥tkaraṇam। kēvalānāmapāṁ śravaṇaṁ tu tāsāṁ bhūyastvāt। dēhē ca lōhitādibhūyastvēnārambhakēṣvapāṁ bhūyastvaṁ gamyatē॥2॥

#### prāṇagatiśravaṇānyathānupapattyā'pi bhūtasūkṣmapariṣvaṅgasiddhiḥ

**290. prāṇagatēśca॥ 3–1–3 ॥**

itaśca bhūtasūkṣmapariṣvaktasya gamanamiti gamyatē। utkrāmati jīvē prāṇānāṁ tadanugatiśśrūyatē – **tamutkrāmantaṁ prāṇō'nūtkrāmati prāṇamanūtkrāmantaṁ sarvē prāṇā anūtkrāmanti** (br̥. 6.4.2) iti। smaryatē ca **manaṣṣaṣṭhānīndriyāṇi prakr̥tisthāni karṣati। śarīraṁ yadavāpnōti yaccāpyutkrāmatīśvaraḥ gr̥hītvaitāni saṁyāti vāyurgandhānivāśayāt** (bha.gī.15.7) iti। na ca nirāśrayāṇāṁ gatirupapadyata iti tadāśrayabhūtānāṁ bhūtasūkṣmāṇāmapi gatirabhyupagantavyā ॥3॥

#### vāgādīnāṁ prāṇānām agnyādyapyayaśrutērgauṇatayā nirvāhaḥ

**291. agnyādigataśrutēriti cēnna bhāktatvāt ॥ 3–1–4 ॥**

**yatrāsya puruṣasya mr̥tasyāgniṁ vāgapyēti, vātaṁ prāṇaścakṣurādityam** (br̥.5.2.13) ityādinā prāṇānāṁ jīvamaraṇakālē agnyādiṣvapyayaśravaṇānna tēṣāṁ jīvēna saha gamanamiti gatiśrutiranyathā nēyēti cēt – na, bhāktatvāt agnyādiṣvapyayaśravaṇasya। kathaṁ bhāktatvam?
**ōṣadhīrlōmāni vanaspatīn kēśāḥ** (br̥.5.2.3) ityanapiyadbhirlōmādibhissaha śravaṇāt। ataścakṣurādyapyayaśrutiḥ adhiṣṭhātr̥dēvatāpakramaṇaparā ॥4॥

#### prathamahōmē apām aśravaṇaśaṅkā, śraddhāśabdēna apāmabhidhānātparihāraśca

**292. prathamē'śravaṇāditi cēnna tā ēva hyupapattēḥ ॥ 3–1–5 ॥**

yaduktamadbhissūkṣmābhirbhūtāntarasaṁsr̥ṣṭābhiḥ pariṣvaktō jīvō gacchatīti praśnaprativacanābhyāmavagamyata iti; tannōpapadyatē, dyulōkāgniviṣayē prathamē hōmē apāṁ hōmyatvāśravaṇāt। **tasminnētasminnagnau** dēvāḥ **śraddhāṁ juhvati** (chā.5.5.2) iti śraddhaiva hōmyatvēna śrutā। śraddhā nāma jīvasya manōvr̥ttiviśēṣatvēna prasiddhā । atō nāpastatra hōmyā iti cēt – na, yataḥ tāḥ āpa ēva śraddhāśabdēna tatrābhidhīyantē; kutaḥ? praśnaprativacanōpapattēḥ ॥

#### praśna-prativacanayōrupādānam

**vēttha yathā pañcamyāmāhutāvāpaḥ puruṣavacasō**
**bhavanti** (chāṁ.5.3.3) iti praśnasya prativanacōpakramē hi śraddhā dyulōkāgnau hōmyatvēna śrutā; tatra yadi śraddhāśabdēnāpō nōcyēran; tatō'nyathā praśnō'nyathā prativacanamityasaṅgataṁ syāt**। iti tu pañcamyāmāhutāvāpaḥ puruṣavacasaḥ** (chā.5.9.1) iti prativacananigamanaṁ ca śraddhāyā aptvamēva sūcayati। **vēttha yathā** (chā. 5-3-3) iti hi praśnagataḥ prakāraḥ **iti tu pañcamyām** (chāṁ.5.3.3) itītiśabdēna parihārē nigamyatē। śraddhāsōmarājavarṣānnarētōgarbharūpēṇāpāṁ pariṇāmamuktvā hyēvamāpaḥ puruṣavacasa iti nigamyatē।

#### śraddhāśabdasya apparatvōpapattiḥ

śraddhāśabdasya cāpsu vaidikaprayōgō dr̥śyatē – **apaḥ praṇayati śraddhā vā āpaḥ** iti। **śraddhāṁ juhvati** (tai.brā.2.4.33) tathā **āhutēssōmō rājā sambhavati** (chāṁ.5.4.2) iti sōmākārēṇa pariṇāmaścāpāmēvōpapadyatē। atō bhūtāntarasaṁsr̥ṣṭābhiradbhissampariṣvaktō jīvō raṁhatītyupapannam ॥5॥

#### śrutau jīvasyāśravaṇāt appariṣvaktajīvagamanāsiddhiśaṅkā-parihārau

**293. aśrutatvāditi cēnnēṣṭādikāriṇāṁ pratītēḥ ॥ 3–1–6 ॥**

yatpunaruktamadbhissampariṣvaktō jīvō yātītyayamartha ētasmādvākyādavagamyata iti; tannōpapadyatē, asminvākyē jīvasyāśravaṇāt । atra hi śraddhādaya ēvāvasthāviśēṣā hōmyatvēna śrutāḥ; na tu jīvastatpariṣvakta iti cēt – tanna, iṣṭādikāriṇāṁ pratītēḥ – asminnēva vākyē hyuttaratra brahmajñānavidhurēṣṭāpūrtadattakāriṇō dyulōkaṁ prāpya sōmarājānō bhavanti; puṇyakarmāvasānē ca punarāgatya garbhaṁ prāpnuvantītyucyatē **atha ya imē grāmē iṣṭāpūrtē dattamityupāsatē tē dhūmamabhisambhavanti** (chā.5.10.3) ityārabhya **pitr̥lōkādākāśamākāśāccandramasamēṣa sōmō rājā taddēvānāmannaṁ taṁ dēvā bhakṣayanti** (chāṁ.5.10.3)
**tasminyāvatsampātamuṣitvā'thaitamēvādhvānaṁ punarnivartantē** (chāṁ.5.10.3) **yō yō hyannamatti yō rētassiñcati tadbhūya ēva bhavati** (chāṁ.5.10.3) iti । atrāpi dyulōkāgnau śraddhāṁ juhvati tasyā āhutēssōmō rājā sambhavati iti tadēkārthatvāchraddhāvasthadēhaviśiṣṭassōmarūpadēhaviśiṣṭō bhavatītyuktamiti gamyatē। dēhasya jīvaviśēṣaṇataikasvarūpasya vācakaḥ śabdō viśēṣyē jīva ēva paryavasyati; atassampariṣvaktō jīvō yātītyupapadyatē॥6॥

#### sōmarājapadasya jīvaparatvābhāvaśaṅkā-parihārau

nanu ca **taṁ dēvā bhakṣayanti** (chāṁ.5.1.-3) iti dēvairbhakṣyamāṇatvavacanāt **sōmō rājā** (chāṁ.5.10.4) iti na jīva ucyatē, jīvasyānadanīyatvāt; tatrāha

**294. bhāktaṁ vā'nātmavitvāttathā hi darśayati ॥ 3–1–7 ॥**

vāśabdaścōdyaṁ vyāvartayati। iṣṭādikāriṇō'nātmavittvātsa dēvānāṁ bhōgōpakaraṇatvēna ihāmutra ca vartatē। ihēṣṭādinā tadārādhanaṁ kurvannupakarōti; ārādhanaprītairdēvairdattamamuṁ lōkaṁ prāpya tatra tatsamānabhōgastadupakaraṇaṁ bhavati । yathā **paśurēvaṁ sa dēvānām** (br̥.3.4.10) ityanātmavidō dēvānāmupakaraṇatvaṁ darśayati śrutiḥ । smr̥tirapyātmavidāṁ brahmaprāptimanātmavidāṁ ca dēvabhōgyatvaṁ darśayati **dēvān dēvayajō yānti madbhaktā yānti māmapi** (gī.7-23) iti। atō jīvasya dēvānāṁ bhōgōpakaraṇatvābhiprāyamannatvēna bhakṣyatvavacanam; atastadbhāktam। tēna tr̥ptirēva ca dēvānāṁ bhakṣaṇamiti śrūyatē **na vai dēvā aśnanti na pibanti ētadēvāmr̥taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tr̥pyanti** (chā.3.6.1) iti। tasmādbhūtasūkṣmaissampariṣvaktō jīvō raṁhatīti siddham॥7॥

**iti śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē tadantarapratipattyadhikaraṇam॥1॥**

### 02 kr̥tātyayādhikaraṇam

**śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē kr̥tātyayādhikaraṇam॥2॥**

**adhikaraṇārthaḥ**—
sukr̥taphalamanubhūya amuṣmāllōkānnivartamānasya bhuktaśēṣēṇa karmaṇā sahaiva jīvasya pratyavarōhaḥ

**295. kr̥tātyayē'nuśayavāndr̥ṣṭasmr̥tibhyāṁ yathētamanēvaṁ ca ॥ 3–1–8 ॥**

#### saṅgatipratipādanaṁ viṣayaśca

kēvalēṣṭāpūrtadattakāriṇāṁ dhūmādinā pitr̥yāṇēna pathā gamanaṁ karmaphalāvasānē punarāvartanaṁ cāmnātaṁ **yāvatsampātamuṣitvā'thaitamēvādhvānaṁ punirnivartantē** (chā.5.10.3) iti ॥

#### adhikaraṇīyaḥ saṁśayaḥ

tatra pratyavarōhan jīvaḥ kimanuśayavān pratyavarōhati, uta nēti saṁśayyatē ।

#### pūrvapakṣaḥ sayuktikaḥ

kiṁ yuktam? karmaṇaḥ kr̥tsnasyōpabhuktatvāt nānuśayavāniti prāptam । anuśayō hyupabhuktaśiṣṭaṁ karma। tacca kr̥tsnaphalōpabhōgē sati nāvaśiṣyatē ।
**yāvatsampātamuṣitvā** (chā.5.10.4) iti vacanāt kr̥tsnōpabhōgaśca jñāyatē । sampatantyanēna svargaṁ lōkamiti sampātaḥ karmōcyatē। śrutyantaraṁ ca
prāpyāntaṁ karmaṇastasya yatkiñcēha karōtyayam ।
**tasmāllōkātpunarētyasmai lōkāya karmaṇē** (br̥.6.4.6) iti॥

#### siddhāntasya pratipādanam

ēvaṁ prāptē'bhidhīyatē – anuśayavān pratyavarōhati – iti। kutaḥ? dr̥ṣṭasmr̥tibhyām – śrutismr̥tibhyāmityarthaḥ। śrutistāvat – **tadya iha ramaṇīyacaraṇā abhyāśō ha yattē ramaṇīyāṁ yōnimāpadyēran brāhmaṇayōniṁ kṣatriyayōniṁ vaiśyayōniṁ vā atha ya iha kapūyacaraṇā abhyāśō ha yattē kapūyāṁ yōnimāpadyēran śvayōniṁ vā sūkarayōniṁ vā caṇḍalāyōniṁ vā** (chā.5.10.7) iti pratyavarūḍhān prati śrūyatē। amuṣmāllōkātpratyavarūḍhēṣu ramaṇīyakarmāṇō ramaṇīyāṁ brāhmaṇādiyōniṁ pratipadyantē; kapūyacaraṇāḥ – kutsitakarmāṇaḥ kutsitāṁ śvasūkaracaṇḍalādiyōniṁ pratipadyanta iti pratyavarūḍhānāṁ puṇyapāpakarmayōgaṁ darśayati । smr̥tirapi
**varṇā āśramāśca svakarmaniṣṭhāḥ prētya karmaphalamanubhūya tataḥ śēṣēṇa viśiṣṭadēśajātikularūpāyuśśrutavittavr̥ttasukhamēdhasō janma pratipadyantē viṣvañcō viparītā naśyanti** (gautama.2.11.12,13) iti । tathā **tataḥ parivr̥ttau karmaphalaśēṣēṇa jātiṁ rūpaṁ varṇaṁ balaṁ mēdhāṁ prajñāṁ dravyāṇi dharmānuṣṭhānamiti pratipadyantē taccakravadubhayōrlōkayōssukha ēva vartatē** (āpastamba.2.1.2,3) iti । yāvatsampātam (chā.5.10.7) iti phaladānapravr̥ttakarmaviśēṣaviṣayam;
**yatkiñcēha karōtyayam** (br̥.6.4.6) itīdamapi tadviṣayamēva । abhuktaphalānāmakr̥taprāyaścittānāṁ ca karmaṇāṁ karmāntaraphalānubhavānnāśō'pyanupapannaḥ। atō'muṁ lōkaṁ gatāssānuśayā ēva yathētamanēvaṁ ca punarnivartantē – ārōhaṇaprakārēṇa prakārāntarēṇa ca punarnivartanta ityarthaḥ ।

#### ārōhaṇāvarōhaṇakramayōḥ vivaraṇam

ārōhaṇaṁ hi dhūmarātryaparapakṣadakṣiṇāyanaṣaṇmāsapitr̥lōkākāśacandrakramēṇa। avarōhaṇaṁ tu candramasaḥ sthānādākāśa-vāyudhūmābhramēghakramēṇa। tatrākāśāvarōhaṇādyathētam; vāyvādiprāptēḥ pitr̥lōkādyaprāptēścānēvam ॥8॥

#### caraṇa śabdasya puṇyapāpaparatvābhāvaśaṅkā-parihārau

**296. caraṇāditi cēnna tadupalakṣaṇārthēti kārṣṇājiniḥ॥ 3–1–9 ॥**

**ramaṇīyacaraṇāḥ** (chā.5.10.7) **kapūyacaraṇāḥ** (chāṁ.5.10.7) iti na caraṇaśabdēna puṇyapāparūpaṁ karmābhidhīyatē, caraṇaśabdasya lōkavēdayōrācārē prasiddhēḥ । laukikāḥ khalu caraṇamācāraḥ śīlaṁ vr̥ttamiti paryāyānabhimanyatē । vēdē ca **yānyanavadyāni karmāṇi tāni sēvitavyāni** (tai.śi.11.2) **yānyasmākaṁ sucaritāni tāni tvayōpāsyāni** (tai.śi. 11.2) iti caraṇakarmaṇī bhēdēna vyapadiśyētē, ataḥ caraṇāt – śīlāt yōniviśēṣaprāptiḥ, nānuśayāditi cēt – tanna, caraṇaśrutiḥ karmōpalakṣaṇārthēti kārṣṇājinirācāryō manyatē, kēvalādācārātsukhaduḥkhaprāptyasambhavāt। sukhaduḥkhē hi puṇyapāparūpakarmaphalē॥9॥

#### ācāravaiphalyāt tadvidhānānarthakyaśaṅkā-parihārau

**297. ānarthakyamiti cēnna tadapēkṣatvāt ॥ 3–1–10 ॥**

ēvaṁ tarhyaphalatvādācārasya smr̥tivihitasyānarthakyamēvēti cēt – tanna tadapēkṣatvātpuṇyasya karmaṇaḥ। ācāravata ēva puṇyakarmasvadhikāraḥ –
**sandhyāhīnō'śucirnityamanarhāssarvakarmasu** (dakṣa.smr̥. 2-22)
**ācārahīnaṁ na punanti vēdāḥ** ityādivacanēbhyaḥ। ataścaraṇaśrutiḥ karmōpalakṣaṇārthēti kārṣṇājinērabhiprāyaḥ ॥10॥

#### caraṇaśabdābhidhēyatvaṁ puṇyapāpakarmaṇōrēvēti bādaryāśayaḥ

**298. sukr̥taduṣkr̥tē ēvēti tu bādariḥ ॥ 3–1–11 ॥**

puṇyaṁ karmācarati, pāpaṁ karmācarati iti karmaṇi caratēḥ prayōgāt pr̥thaṅnirdēśasya ca pratyakṣaśrutisiddhācārānumitaśrutisiddhaviṣayatvēna gōbalīvardanyāyēnōpapattēḥ। mukhyē sambhavati na lakṣaṇā nyāyyēti sukr̥taduṣkr̥tē ēva caraṇaśabdābhidhēyē; iti bādarirācāryō manyatē ।

#### asmin viṣayē bādarimatasyaiva bādarāyaṇamatatvam

atra bādarimatamēva svamatam; ācārānumitaśrutivihitasandhyāvandanādēḥ karmāntarādhikāra-sampādanaṁ phalamiti tu svīkr̥tam। atassānuśayā ēva pratyavarōhanti॥ 11॥

**iti śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē kr̥tātyayādhikaraṇam॥2॥**

### 03 aniṣṭādikāryadhikaraṇam

**śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē aniṣṭādikāryadhikaraṇam॥3॥**

**adhikaraṇārthaḥ**—
kēvalapāpakāriṇāṁ candrārōhāvarōhau vinaiva gatāgatī

**299. aniṣṭādikāriṇāmapi ca śrutam ॥ 3–1–12 ॥**

#### saṅgatiḥ, adhikaraṇavicāryōṁśaśca

kēvalēṣṭāpūrtadattakāriṇaścandramasaṁ gatvā sānuśayā ēva nivartanta ityuktam; idānīmaniṣṭādikāriṇō'pi candramasaṁ gacchanti, nēti cintyatē । yē vihitaṁ na kurvanti, niṣiddhaṁ ca kurvanti, ta ubhayē'pi pāpakarmāṇō'niṣṭādikāriṇaḥ ।

#### pūrvapakṣārambhaḥ sayuktikaḥ

kiṁ yuktam? tē'pi candramasaṁ gacchantīti, kutaḥ? tēṣāmapi hi tadgamanaṁ śrutaṁ – **yē vai kēcāsmāllōkātprayanti candramasamēva tē sarvē gacchanti** (kauṣī.1.2) ityaviśēṣēṇa sarvēṣāmēva gatiśravaṇāt॥12॥

#### puṇyapāpakarmaṇōrubhayōrapi gatitaulyaśaṅkā-parihārau

ēvaṁ tarhi sukr̥taduṣkr̥takāriṇōrubhayōrapyaviśiṣṭaiva gatissyāt; nētyāha –

**300. saṁyamanē tvanubhūyētarēṣāmārōhāvarōhau tadgatidarśanāt ॥ 3–1–13 ॥**

tu śabdaśśaṅkāṁ vyāvartayati; itarēṣām aniṣṭādikāriṇāṁ candrārōhāvarōhau saṁyamanē – yamaśāsanē tatprayuktayātanā anubhūyaiva, nānyathā; kutaḥ? tadgatidarśanāt – dr̥śyatē hi pāpakarmaṇāṁ yamavaśyatayā tadgamanam **ayaṁ lōkō nāsti na para iti mānī punaḥpunarvaśamāpadyatē mē** (kaṭha.1-2- 6) **vaivasvataṁ saṅgamanaṁ janānāṁ yamaṁ rājānam** (tai.āraṇ.2.1) ityādiṣu॥3॥

#### aviśēṣēṇa sarvēṣāṁ yamavaśyatāsmr̥tiḥ

**301. smaranti ca ॥3–1–14॥**

smaranti ca sarvēṣāṁ yamavaśyatāṁ parāśarādayaḥ **sarvē caitē vaśaṁ yānti yamasya bhagavankila** (vi.pu 3-7-5) ityādiṣu॥14॥

#### pāpakāribhirgantavyāḥ sapta narakāḥ

**302. api sapta॥ 3–1–15 ॥**

pāpakarmaṇāṁ gantavyatvēna rauravādīn sapta narakānapi smaranti॥15॥

nanu saptasu lōkēṣu gacchatāṁ kathaṁ yamasadanaprāptiḥ, ata āha –

#### saptalōkēṣu yamasambandhōpapattiḥ

**303. tatrāpi tadvyāpārādavirōdhaḥ ॥ 3–1–16 ॥**

tēṣvapi saptasu yamājñayaiva gamanādavirōdhaḥ ।

#### pūrvapakṣōpasaṁharaṇam

atō'niṣṭādikāriṇāmapi yamalōkaṁ prāpya svakarmānurūpaṁ yātanāścānubhūya paścāccandrārōhāvarōhau staḥ ॥16॥

#### siddhāntārambhaḥ

iti prāpta ucyatē –

**304. vidyākarmaṇōriti tu prakr̥tatvāt ॥ 3–1–17 ॥**

tu śabdaḥ pakṣavyāvr̥ttyarthaḥ। aniṣṭādikāriṇāmapi candraprāptirastītyētannōpapadyatē; kutaḥ? vidyākarmaṇōriti vidyākarmaṇōḥ phalabhōgārthatvāddēvayānapitr̥yāṇayōḥ।

#### vidyāprasaṅgasya dr̥ṣṭāntārthatvam

ētaduktaṁ bhavati – aniṣṭādikāriṇāṁ yathā vidyāvidhuratvāddēvayānēna pathā gamanaṁ na sambhavati; tadvadēvēṣṭāpūrtadattavidhuratvātpitr̥yāṇēna candragamanamapi na sambhavati – iti ।

#### uktavibhāgāvagamakapradarśanam

dēvayānapitr̥yāṇayōḥ vidyāviṣayatvaṁ puṇyakarmaviṣayatvaṁ ca kathamavagamyata iti cēt – prakr̥tatvāttayōḥ। prakr̥tā hi dēvayānē vidyā, **pitr̥yāṇē ca karma tadya itthaṁ viduryē cēmē'raṇyē śraddhā tapa ityupāsatē** (chā.5.10.1) ityuktvā
**tē'rciṣamabhisambhavantyarciṣō'haḥ** (chā.5.10.1) ityādinā dēvayānavacanāt,
**atha ya imē grāma iṣṭāpūrtē dattamityupāsatē** (chāṁ.5.10.3) ityuktvā **tē dhūmamabhisambhavanti** (chā.5.10.3) ityādinā pitr̥yāṇavacanācca **yē vai kē cāsmāllōkātprayanti candramasamēva tē sarvē gacchanti** (kauṣī.1.2) ityētadapi vacanaṁ ya iṣṭādikāriṇaḥ tē sarvē iti pariṇēyam ॥

#### pāpakarmiṇāṁ candragamanābhāvē śarīrānārambhaśaṅkā-parihārau

nanu pāpakarmaṇāṁ candragamanābhāvē pañcamāhutyasambhavāccharīrārambha ēva nōpapadyatē; **pañcamyāmāhutāvāpaḥ puruṣavacasō bhavanti** (chā.5.9.1) iti hi śarīrāmbhaśśrūyatē, sā cāhutiścandraprāptipūrvikēti darśitam; ataśśarīrārambhāyaiva tēṣāmapi candrārōhāvarōhāvavaśyābhyupētyau ityata āha –

**305. na tr̥tīyē tathōpalabdhēḥ ॥ 3–1–18 ॥**

tr̥tīyasthānasya śarīrārambhāya na pañcamāhutyapēkṣā; kutaḥ? tathōpalabdhēḥ – tr̥tīyasthānaśabdēna kēvalapāpakarmāṇa ucyantē, tēṣāṁ dēhārambhē pañcamāhutyanapēkṣatvamupalabhyatē **vēttha yathā kēnāsau lōkāē na sampūryatē** (chā.5.3.3) ityasya praśnasya prativacanē **athaitayōḥ pathōrna katarēṇa ca tānīmāni kṣudrāṇyasakr̥dāvartīni bhūtāni bhavanti jāyasva mriyasvētyētattr̥tīyaṁ sthānaṁ tēnāsau lōkō na sampūryatē** (chā.5.10.8) iti tr̥tīyasthānasya dyulōkārōhāvarōhābhāvēna dyulōkāsampūrtivacanādasya tr̥tīyasthānasya śarīrārambhāya na pañcamāhutyapēkṣā । **pañcamyāmāhutau** (chā.6.3.1) iti cāpāṁ pañcamāgnisambandhasya puruṣavacastvahētutvamātraṁ pratipādayati, nānyannivārayati, avadhāraṇāśravaṇāt ॥18॥

#### manuṣyēṣvapi kēṣucit dēhārambhē pañcamāhutyanapēkṣā

**306. smaryatē'pi ca lōkē ॥ 3–1–19 ॥**

puṇyakarmaṇāmapi kēṣāñcitpañcamāhutyanapēkṣayā dēhārambhō lōkē smaryatē draupadīdhr̥ṣṭadyumnaprabhr̥tīnām॥19॥

#### pañcamāhutyanapēkṣayā dēhārambhasya śrutitō'pi siddhiḥ

**307. darśanācca ॥ 3–1–20 ॥**

śrutāvapi dr̥śyatē kēṣāñcitpañcamāhutyanapēkṣayā dēhārambhaḥ **tēṣāṁ khalvēṣāṁ bhūtānāṁ trīṇyēva bījāni bhavanti āṇḍajaṁ jīvajamudbhijjam** (chāṁ. 6.3.1) iti। ēṣūdbhijjasvēdajayōḥ bhūtayōḥ pañcamāhutimantarēṇōtpattirdr̥śyatē॥20॥

#### udbhijjaśabdēna svēdajānāṁ saṅgrahaḥ

nanu svēdajānāmatra na saṅkīrtanamasti **trīṇyēva bījāni** (chāṁ.6.3.1) iti vanacāt; tatrāha –

**308. tr̥tīyaśabdāvarōdhassaṁśōkajasya॥ 3–1–21 ॥**

saṁśōkajasya – svēdajasyāpi **āṇḍajaṁ jīvajamudbhijjam** (chā.6.3.1) ityatra tr̥tīyēnōdbhijjaśabdēnāvarōdhaḥ saṅgrahō vidyata ityarthaḥ; ataḥ kēvalapāpakarmaṇāṁ candraprāptirna sambhavati॥21॥

**iti śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē aniṣṭādikāryadhikaraṇam ॥3॥**

### 04 tatsvābhāvyāpattyadhikaraṇam

**śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē tatsvābhāvyāpattyadhikaraṇam ॥4॥**

**adhikaraṇārthaḥ**—
avarōhatō jīvasya śrutyuktaḥ ākāśādibhāvaḥ ākāśādisādr̥śyarūpaḥ

**309. tatsvābhāvyāpattirupapattēḥ ॥ 3–1–22 ॥**

#### uktārthānuvādaḥ saṅgatyartham

iṣṭādikāriṇō bhūtasūkṣmapariṣvaktāssānuśayāścandramasō'varōhantītyuktam, avarōhaprakāraśca **athaitamēvādhvānaṁ punarnivartantē yathētamākāśam ākāśādvāyuḥ vāyurbhūtvā dhūmō bhavati dhūmō bhūtvā'bhraṁ bhavati abhraṁ bhūtvā mēghō bhavati, mēghō bhūtvā pravarṣati** (chā.5.10, 5.6) iti vacanāt yathētamanēvañca ityuktam ॥

#### prakr̥tō vicāraṇīyōṁśaḥ

tatrāsyākāśādipratipattau dēvamanuṣyādibhāvavadākāśādibhāvaḥ, uta tatsādr̥śyāpattimātramiti viśayē,

#### pūrvapakṣaḥ sadr̥ṣṭāntaḥ

śraddhāvasthasya sōmabhāvavadaviśēṣādākāśādibhāvaḥ – iti prāptē

#### siddhāntārthaḥ sayuktikaḥ

tatsvābhāvyāpattirēvētyucyatē। tatsvābhāvyāpattiḥ– tatsādr̥śyāpattirityarthaḥ। kuta ētat? upapattēḥ sōmabhāvamanuṣyabhāvādau hi sukhaduḥkhōpabhōgāya tadbhāvaḥ; atra tvākāśādau sukhaduḥkhōpabhōgābhāvāttadbhāvānupapattēstadāpattivacanaṁ tatsaṁsargakr̥tatatsādr̥śyāpattyabhiprāyam॥22॥

**iti śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē tatsvābhāvyāpattyadhikaraṇam॥4॥**

### 05 nāticirādhikaraṇam

**śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē nāticirādhikaraṇam॥7॥**

**310. nāticirēṇa viśēṣāt ॥ 3–1–23 ॥ (si)**

**adhikaraṇārthaḥ**—
jīvasya avarōhakālē ākāśādiṣu sthānēṣu śīghrā gatiḥ

#### saṅgativicārapūrvapakṣaḥ

ākāśaprāptiprabhr̥ti yāvadvrīhyādiprāpti kiṁ tatratatra nāticiraṁ tiṣṭhati, utāniyama iti viśayē niyamahētvabhāvādaniyamaḥ –

#### siddhāntaḥ sūtrārthataḥ

iti prāptē,

ucyatē – nāticirēṇa – iti।

kutaḥ? viśēṣāt – uttaratra vrīhyādiprāptau **atō vai khalu durniṣprapataram** (chā।5-10-6) iti viśiṣya kr̥cchraniṣkramaṇatvābhidhānāt pūrvatra hyākāśādiprāptāvaciraniṣkramaṇaṁ gamyatē। durniṣprapataramiti cchāndasastaśabdalōpaḥ; durniṣprapataraṁ – duḥkhaniṣkramaṇataramityarthaḥ॥23॥

**iti śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē nāticirādhikaraṇam॥ 5॥**

### 06 anyādhiṣṭhitādhikaraṇam

**śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē anyādhiṣṭhitādhikaraṇam ॥ 6॥**

**adhikaraṇārthaḥ**—
avarōhatō jīvasya vrīhy-ādi-bhāvaḥ,  
vrīhy-ādi-saṁślēṣa-mātram,  
na vrīhyādiśarīrakaṁ brahma

#### jīvāvarōhaḥ sasyēṣu
**vi॰pra॰**—
> **311. +++(vrīhyādau)+++ anyādhiṣṭhitē +++(jīvāvatāraḥ)+++ pūrvavad abhilāpāt॥ 3–1–24 ॥**

**English**—
> 24\. Into (plants) animated by other souls, because the statement is as in the previous cases.

**vi॰pra॰**—
> avarōhantō jīvāḥ  
vrīhyādibhāvēna jāyanta  

iti śrūyatē 

**English**—
The text declares that the descending souls are born as rice, corn, &c., 

**vi॰pra॰**—
> mēghō bhūtvā pravarṣati  
ta iha vrīhi-yavā ōṣadhi-vanaspatayas tila-māṣā jāyantē (chā.5.10.6) 

iti ।

**English**—
> 'they are born here as rice, corn, herbs, trees,' &c. 

#### saṁśayaḥ

**vi॰pra॰**—
> tē kim anyair bhōktr̥bhir vrīhyādi-śarīrair adhiṣṭhitān  
vrīhy-ādīn āśliṣyanti;  
uta tē bhōktārō vrīhy-ādi-śarīrā jāyanta  

iti viśayē,

**English**—
The question here is whether the souls cling to plants animated by other souls which have those plants for their bodies; or whether the descending souls themselves are born with those plants for their bodies.--

#### pūrvapakṣaḥ - jāyantē

**vi॰pra॰**—
**jāyantē** (chā.5.10.6.7) iti vacanād  
"dēvō jāyatē manuṣyō jāyata" itivad  
vrīhy-ādi-śarīrā ēva।

**English**—
The latter view is the right one; for the text says, 'they are born as rice, grain,' and so on, and this expression is of the same kind as when we say 'he is born as a man, as a deva,' and so on.  
The text therefore means that the souls are embodied in the different plants.

#### anyādhiṣṭhitē saṁślēṣaḥ

**vi॰pra॰**—
iti prāptē ucyatē – anyādhiṣṭhitē iti। 

**English**—
--This view the Sūtra rejects. 

**vi॰pra॰**—
jīvāntarēṇādhiṣṭhitē vrīhy-ādi-śarīrē  
tēṣāṁ saṁślēṣamātram ēva। 

**English**—
The souls merely cling to those plants which constitute the bodies of other souls; 

##### ākāśādi-ślēṣavat
**vi॰pra॰**—
kutaḥ? pūrvavad abhilāpāt –  
ākāśādi-mēgha-paryantavat  
kēvala tad-bhāvābhilāpāt । 

**English**—
'since the statement is as in the previous cases,' i.e. because the text only says that the souls become plants as it had previously been said that they become ether, and so on. 

##### karmānuktēḥ
**vi॰pra॰**—
yatra hi bhōktr̥tvam abhiprētam;  
tatra tat-sādhana-bhūtaṁ karmābhilapyatē  
**ramaṇīya-caraṇāḥ** … **kapūya-caraṇāḥ** (chā.5.10.7) iti । 

**English**—
Where the text means to say that the soul enters on the condition of an enjoying soul (i.e. of a soul assuming a new body for the purpose of retributive enjoyment), it refers to the deeds which lead to such enjoyment; so e. g. in the passage, 'Those whose works have been good obtain a good birth,' &c. 

###### karmasambandhō'nyatra
**vi॰pra॰**—
iha cākāśādivannābhilapyatē karma, 

**English**—
But in the text under discussion there is no such reference to karman. 

**vi॰pra॰**—
phala-pradānē pravr̥ttasya svargōpabhōgya-phalasyēṣṭādēḥ karmaṇaḥ  
svargōpabhōgād ēva samāptatvāt, 

**English**—
For those works – viz. sacrifices and the like – which were undertaken with a view to reward, such as enjoyment of the heavenly world, are, in the case of the descending souls, completely wiped out by the enjoyment of the heavenly world (which precedes the descent of the souls); 

**vi॰pra॰**—
anārabdhasya **ramaṇīyacaraṇāḥ**…….**kapūyacaraṇāḥ** (chā.5.10.7) iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt, 

**English**—
and those works on the other hand, the action of which has not yet begun, lead to the embodiments mentioned further on ('Those whose works are good'). 

**vi॰pra॰**—
madhyē karmāntarābhāvācca। 

**English**—
And in the interval between those two conditions no new karman originates. 

**vi॰pra॰**—
ata ākāśādi-bhāva-vacanavad  
vrīhy-ādi-bhāvēna janma-vacanam aupacārikam॥24॥

**English**—
When, therefore, the text says that the souls are born as plants, the statement cannot be taken in its literal sense.

##### svargadaṁ karma nāśuddham

**vi॰pra॰**—
> **312. aśuddham iti cēn na - śabdāt ॥ 3–1–25 ॥**

**English**—
> 25\. It is unholy. Not so, on the ground of Scripture.

###### pūrvapakṣaḥ
**vi॰pra॰**—
naitad asti – 

> yad anyādhiṣṭhitē vrīhy-ādi-śarīrē saṁślēṣa-mātram,  
bhōktr̥tva-hētv-abhāvān  
na vrīhy-ādi-bhāvēna janma – 

iti 

**English**—
The conclusion arrived at above cannot be accepted,  

**vi॰pra॰**—
bhōktr̥tvahētusadbhāvāt 

**English**—
since there is a reason why the descending soul should enter on the condition of an enjoying soul. 

**vi॰pra॰**—
svargōpabhōgya-phalam iṣṭādi-karmaivāśuddham –  
pāpa-miśram, agnī-ṣōmīyādi hiṁsā-yuktatvāt । 

**English**—
Such works as sacrifices, the fruit of which is the enjoyment of the heavenly world, are mixed with evil,  
for they imply injury to living beings as in the case of the goat offered to Agnīshomau. 

###### hisā-pāpam
**vi॰pra॰**—
hiṁsā ca  
"na hiṁsyāt sarvā bhūtāni" iti niṣiddhatvāt  
pāpam ēva।

**English**—
And such injury is evil as it is forbidden by texts such as 'let him not harm any creature.' 

###### utsargāpavāda-nyāyō na
**vi॰pra॰**—
na cātra padāhavanīyādivad utsargāpavāda-bhāvas sambhavati,  
bhinna-viṣayatvāt। 

**English**—
Nor can it be said that the injunctions of sacrificing animals constitute exceptions to the general rule of not harming any creature. --For the two injunctions refer to different things. 

**vi॰pra॰**—
agnīṣōmīya-hiṁsā-vidhir hiṁsāyāḥ kratūpakārakatvaṁ bōdhayati; 

**English**—
The injunction to kill the goat for Agnīshomau intimates that the killing of the animal subserves the accomplishment of the sacrifice, 

**vi॰pra॰**—
"na hiṁsyāt" iti tu hiṁsāyāḥ pratyavāya-phalatvam।

**English**—
while the injunction not to 'harm' teaches that such harming has disastrous consequences. 

###### vidhi-prāptē'pi
**vi॰pra॰**—
athōcyēta – 

> agnīṣōmīyādiṣu vidhitaḥ pravr̥ttēr  
na tad-viṣayaṁ niṣēdhavidhir āskandati,  
rāga-prāpta-viṣayatvāt tasya

iti; 

**viśvāsa-ṭippanī**—
prābhākara-parihārō'yam। 

**English**—
Should it be said that the prohibition of harming does not refer to such actions as the sacrifice of the goat which proceed on the basis of scriptural injunction,  
but only to such actions as spring from natural passion or desire (rāga); 

**vi॰pra॰**—
naivam, ihāpi rāga-prāptēr aviśiṣṭatvāt। 

**English**—
we remark that in the case of sacrifices also the action is equally prompted by natural desire. 

**vi॰pra॰**—
**svargakāmō yajēta** (yaju.2.5.5) ity-ēvam-ādau hi  
kāminaḥ kartavyatayā yāgādy-upadēśād  
yāgādēḥ svargādi-sādhanatvam avagamya  
phala-rāgata ēva yāgādau pravartatē । 

**English**—
Injunctions such as 'He who desires the heavenly world is to sacrifice', teach that sacrifices are to be undertaken by persons desirous of certain pleasant results, and such persons having thus learned by what means the result is to be accomplished proceed to action from the natural desire of the result. 

**vi॰pra॰**—
agnīṣōmīyādiṣv api 
tēṣāṁ phala-sādhana-bhūtasya yāgādēr upakārakatvaṁ  
śāstrād avagamya  
rāgād ēva pravartatē । 

**English**—
This applies to the killing of the goat also which is offered to Agnīshomau; man learns from Scripture that such actions help to accomplish the sacrifice which effects the result, and then performs those actions from natural desire. 

**vi॰pra॰**—
laukikyām api hiṁsāyāṁ  
kēnacit pramāṇēna hiṁsāyāḥ sva-samīhita-sādhanatvam avagamya  
rāgāt pravartata  
iti na kaścana viśēṣaḥ । 

**English**—
The case in no way differs from that of harm done in ordinary life – where the agent always is prompted by natural desire, having somehow arrived at the conclusion that his action will accomplish something aimed at by himself. 

###### nitya-karmasv api
**vi॰pra॰**—
tathā 

> **nityēṣvapi karmasu  
sarvavarṇānāṁ sva-dharmānuṣṭhānē  
param aparimitaṁ sukham**  
(āpa.śrau.2.1.2.2) 

ityādi-vacanāt phala-sādhanatvamavagamya 

**English**—
The same holds good with regard to works of permanent obligation. Men learn from Scripture that through the performance of the special duties of their caste they attain happiness of the highest kind, 

**vi॰pra॰**—
rāgād ēva pravr̥ttir iti  
tēṣām apy aśuddhi-yuktatvam ।

**English**—
and then apply themselves to their duties from a natural desire of such happiness,  
and therefore such works also are mixed with evil. 

###### pāpāṁśa-phalam
**vi॰pra॰**—
ata iṣṭādīnāṁ pāpa-miśratvēnāśuddhi-yuktānāṁ  
svargē 'nubhāvyaṁ phalaṁ  
svargē'nubhūya  
hiṁsāṁśasya phalaṁ  
vrīhy-ādi-sthāvara-bhāvēnānubhūyatē। 

**English**—
Hence the souls of those who have performed sacrifices, and so on, which contain an element of evil, at first experience in the heavenly world that result which is to be enjoyed there, and then embodying themselves in non-moving things such as plants, experience the fruit of that part of their actions which is of a harmful nature. 

**vi॰pra॰**—
sthāvara-bhāvaṁ ca pāpa-phalaṁ smaranti  

> **śarīra-jaiḥ karmadōṣair  
yāti sthāvaratāṁ naraḥ**  
(manu.1.2.9) 

iti । 

**English**—
That embodiment in non-moving beings is the result of evil deeds Smr̥ti declares: 'Owing to those defects of work which are due to the body, a man becomes a non-moving being.' 

**vi॰pra॰**—
atō vrīhyādibhāvēna bhōgāyānuśayinō jāyantē। 

**English**—
From all this it follows that the souls embody themselves in plants to the end of enjoying the fruits of their works.

###### paśōḥ svargaḥ

**vi॰pra॰**—
iti cēt –
tan na, kutaḥ?  
śabdāt – agnīṣōmīyādēs sañjñapanasya   
svarga-lōka-prāpti-hētutayā hiṁsātvābhāva-śabdāt। 

**English**—
--To this the Sūtra replies – it is not so, on account of scriptural statement. For Scripture declares that the killing of sacrificial animals makes them to go up to the heavenly world, and therefore is not of the nature of harm. 

**vi॰pra॰**—
paśōr hi sañjñapana-nimittāṁ svarga-lōka-prāptiṁ vadantaṁ śabdam āmananti,  

> hiraṇya-śarīra ūrdhvaḥ svargaṁ lōkam ēti 

ity-ādikam ।

**English**—
This is declared in the text, 'The animal killed at the sacrifice having assumed a divine body goes to the heavenly world'; 'with a golden body it ascends to the heavenly world.' 

**vi॰pra॰**—
atiśayitābhyudaya-sādhana-bhūtō vyāpārō  
'lpa-duḥkha-dō'pi  
na hiṁsā;  
pratyuta rakṣaṇam ēva । 

**English**—
An action which is the means of supreme exaltation is not of the nature of harm, even if it involves some little pain; it rather is of beneficial nature.

**vi॰pra॰**—
tathā ca mantra-varṇaḥ 

> **na vā u ētan mriyasē na riṣyasi  
dēvān idēṣi pathibhis sugēbhiḥ।  
yatra yanti sukr̥tō, nāpi duṣkr̥tas,  
tatra tvā dēvas savitā dadhātu** (tai.brā.3.7.92) 

iti। 

**English**—
--With this the mantra also agrees: 

> 'Thou dost not die, thou goest to the gods on easy paths;  
where virtuous men go, not evil-doers,  
there the divine Savitr̥ may lead thee.' 

**vi॰pra॰**—
cikitsakaṁ ca tādātvikālpa-duḥkha-kāriṇam api  
rakṣakam ēva vadanti,  
pūjayanti ca taj-jñāḥ॥25॥

**English**—
An act which has a healing tendency, although it may cause a transitory pain, men of insight declare to be preservative and beneficial.

##### rētas-sig-yōgaḥ

**vi॰pra॰**—
> **313. rētas-sig-yōgō'tha ॥ 3–1–26 ॥**

**English**—
> 26\. After that conjunction with him who performs the act of generation.

**vi॰pra॰**—
itaś caupacārikaṁ vrīhy-ādi-janma-vacanam, 

**vi॰pra॰**—
vrīhy-ādi-bhāva-vacanānantaraṁ  

> **yō yō hy annam atti  
yō rētas siñcati  
tad bhūya ēva bhavati**  
(chā.5.10.6) 

iti rētas-sig-bhāvō 'nuśayināṁ śrūyamāṇō  
yathā tad-yōga-mātraṁ pratipādayati;  
tadvad vrīhy-ādi-bhāvō 'pīty arthaḥ॥26॥

**English**—
The declaration that the descending souls _become_ rice plants, and so on,  
cannot be taken literally for that reason also,  
that the text afterwards declares them to _become_ those who perform the act of generation:  

> 'Whoever the being may be that eats the food and begets offspring, that being he (i.e. the soul that has descended) becomes.' 

Now the meaning of this latter text can only be that the soul enters into conjunction with the creature which eats the grain; and hence we have to interpret the previous text, as to the soul's becoming a plant, in the same way.

##### yōnēś śarīram
**vi॰pra॰**—
> **314. yōnēśśarīram ॥ 3–1–27 ॥**

**English**—
> 27\. From the yoni the body.

**vi॰pra॰**—
yōniprāptēḥ paścād ēvānuśayināṁ śarīra-prāptiḥ,  
tatraiva sukha-duḥkhōpabhōga-sad-bhāvāt ।  

**English**—
Only after having reached a yoni the soul, affected with a remnant of its works, obtains a new body, and only in a body there can be the enjoyment of pleasure and pain. 

**vi॰pra॰**—
tataḥ prāg  
ākāśādi-prāpti-prabhr̥ti tad-yōga-mātram ēva  
ity arthaḥ ॥ 27 ॥

**English**—
When, therefore, previous to that the soul is said to reach ether, wind, and so on, this can only mean that it enters into conjunction with them.

**vi॰pra॰**—
**iti śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē anyādhiṣṭhitādhikaraṇam ॥6॥**

**English**—
--Here terminates the adhikaraṇa of 'that animated by another soul.'

**iti śrībhagavadrāmānujaviracitē śārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyētr̥tīyasyādhyāyasya prathamaḥpādaḥ ॥1॥**

adhikaraṇāni – 8, sūtrāṇi – 40

pādārthaḥ – parasya brahmaṇaḥ nirastākhiladōṣatā samastakalyāṇaguṇākaratā ca

**vi॰pra॰**—
> atō rathādīn jīvaḥ svapnē sr̥jati,

#### siddhāntasūtraṁ savivaraṇam
##### māyāmātram
**vi॰pra॰**—
iti prāptē 'bhidhīyatē

**Thibaut**—
This view is set aside by the next Sūtra.

**vi॰pra॰**—
> **317. māyāmātraṁ tu - +++(jīvasya)+++ kārtsnyēēna +anabhivyakta-svarūpatvāt ॥ 3–2–3 ॥**

**Thibaut**—

on account of the true nature (of the soul) not being fully manifested.

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
**māyāmātram** āścarya-rūpam ēva  
anāścaryarūpaṁ na kiñcid apīty arthaḥ ।

tu-śabdaḥ pakṣaṁ vyāvartayati ।

parama-puruṣa-sr̥ṣṭam iti tu-śabda-siddhārtha uktaḥ,

svapnē ratha-puṣkariṇyādy-arthajātaṁ

**Thibaut**—
The things appearing in dreams-chariots, lotus tanks, and so on – are absolute Māyā, i.e. things created by the Supreme Person.

māyā-śabdō hy āścarya-vācī

dēvamāyēva nirmitā  
(śrīrāma.bāla.1.27)

ityādiṣu tathā darśanāt । 

**Thibaut**—
For the term 'Māyā' denotes wonderful things,  
as appears from passages such as 

> 'She was born in the race of Janaka,  
appearing like the wonderful power of the divine being in bodily shape' (devamāyā). 

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
mithyā-vyāvr̥ttyarthaṁ **māyā**-śabdaṁ vyācaṣṭē ।  
māyā-śabdō hīti - janakasyēti ।  
dēvasya āścarya-rūpā śaktir mūrtimatīvēty arthaḥ । 

**vi॰pra॰**—
atrāpi

> na tatra rathā na rathayōgā na panthānaḥ – (br̥.6.3.10)

**Thibaut**—
The sense of the passage 'there are no chariots,' &c. then is--

**vi॰pra॰**—
sakalētara-puruṣānubhāvyatayā na bhavantīty arthaḥ,

**Thibaut**—
there are no chariots and horses to be perceived by any other person but the dreaming one; 

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
> "na bhavanti" iti śrutau mithyātvaṁ pratīyata  

ity āha - atrāpīti ।  

> svāpnārthānāṁ pūrva-kālīnābhāvō mithyātvaṁ ca lōka-siddham 

iti tad-ubhaya-paratvē "na bhavanti" iti vākyasya vaiyarthyaṁ,  
mithyātva-paratvē sr̥ja-dhātv-asvārasyaṁ ca syāt।  
prasiddha-rathādyanubhavasya pratiṣēdhē 'pi vākya-vaiyarthyaṁ syāt,  
svapnē tēṣām ananubhūtatvasya lōka-siddhatvāt।  
svapna-dr̥ṣṭānāṁ hi jāgrad-dr̥ṣṭēbhyō 'nyatvaṁ lōka-siddham।  
atas tat-parihārāya prasiddha-rathādi-bhāva-pratiṣēdhēna  
vijātīya-vicitrārtha-sr̥ṣṭi-paratvaṁ vākyasyāvarjanīyaṁ,  
tathā sati tad-vaijātyam  
artha-vaśāt sakalētarān anubhāvyatva--tat-kāla--mātrāvasthāyitva-rūpam iti **māyā**-śabdō vyākhyātaḥ।  

**vi॰pra॰**—
> atha rathān rathayōgān pathaḥ sr̥jatē (br̥.6.3.10)

> svapnadr̥g-anubhāvyatayā tatkālamātrāvasānān sr̥jata  

ity āścarya-rūpatvam ēva āha ।

**Thibaut**—
and then 'he creates chariots,' &c. --  
i. e. the Supreme Person creates things to be perceived by the dreamer  
and persisting for a certain time only.  
Those things therefore are of a wonderful nature (but not illusions). 

##### jīvē īdr̥śyāḥ sr̥ṣṭēḥ ayōgaḥ

**vi॰pra॰**—
ēvaṁvidhāścarya-rūpā sr̥ṣṭis satya-saṅkalpasya parama-puruṣasyaivōpapadyatē, na jīvasya;  
tasya satya-saṅkalpatvādi-yuktasyāpi  
saṁsāra-daśāyāṁ kārtsnyēnānabhivyakta-svarūpatvāt।  

**Thibaut**—
And the creation of such wonderful things is possible for the Supreme Person who can immediately realise all his wishes;  
but not for the individual soul.  
The latter also, indeed, fundamentally possesses that power;  
but as in the Saṁsāra state the true nature of the soul is not fully manifested,  

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
tēna saha pratijñā-khaṇḍārtham āha - ēvaṁvidhēti ।  
hētu-khaṇḍaṁ vyācaṣṭē - tasyēti ।  

**vi॰pra॰**—
na jīvasya tathāvidhāścarya-sr̥ṣṭir upapadyatē ।

**Thibaut**—
it is then incapable of accomplishing such wonderful creations. 

##### kaṭhaśrutāv īśvarōktiḥ
**vi॰pra॰**—
> kāmaṁ kāmaṁ puruṣō nirmimāṇaḥ (kaṭha.2.5.8)

iti ca  
parama-puruṣam ēva nirmātāram āha –

**Thibaut**—
The text 'the person shaping one desired thing after the other' declares the Supreme Person to be the creator,  

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
pūrva-pakṣa-yuktiṁ pariharati - "kāmaṁ kāmam" iti ।  
"kāmaṁ kāmam" iti ṇamul-antaṁ padaṁ, saṅkalpyēty arthaḥ ॥ 3 ॥

**vi॰pra॰**—
> ya ēṣu suptēṣu jāgarti (kaṭha.2.5.8)

**Thibaut**—
viz. 

> 'He who is awake in those who sleep'; 

**vi॰pra॰**—
> tad ēva śukraṁ tad brahma  
tad ēvāmr̥tam ucyatē ।  
tasmin lōkāś śritās sarvē  
tad u nātyēti kaścana  
(kaṭha.2.5.8)

**Thibaut**—
and 

> 'that is the Bright, that is Brahman,  
that alone is called the Immortal;  
all worlds are contained in it  
and no one goes beyond'  
--(Ka. Up. II, 5, 8) 

**vi॰pra॰**—
ity-upakramōpasaṁhārayōḥ  
parama-puruṣāsādhāraṇa-svabhāva-pratītēḥ ।

**Thibaut**—
for the clauses immediately preceding and following that text 
mention attributes distinctively characteristic of the Supreme Person. 

##### br̥hadāraṇyakē 'pi
**vi॰pra॰**—
> atha vēśāntān puṣkariṇyaḥ sravantyaḥ sr̥jatē,  
sa hi kartā (br̥ha.6.3.10)

iti ca 

**Thibaut**—
And the Br̥. Up. text, 'For he is the maker,' 

**vi॰pra॰**—
tayā śrutyaikārthyāt parama-puruṣam ēva kartāram āha ॥3॥

**Thibaut**—
must therefore, in agreement with the Kaṭḥa-text,  
also be understood as declaring that it is the Supreme Person only that creates the things seen in a dream.

  

#### jīvasvabhāvagatasya dharmasyāpi anāvirbhāvē hētuḥ

##### śaṅkā
**vi॰pra॰**—
> svābhāvikaṁ cēj jīvasyāpahata-pāpmatvādikam,  
kutas tan nābhivyajyata 

ity ata āha –

**Thibaut**—
> But if it is the true nature of the soul to be free from all imperfections, and so on,  
why then does this not manifest itself?

To this the next Sūtra replies.

##### parābhidhānāt
**vi॰pra॰**—
> **318. parābhidhyānāt tu tirōhitaṁ**  
**tatō hy asya bandha-viparyayau ॥ 3–2–4 ॥ (si)**

**Thibaut**—
> 4. But owing to the wish of the highest it is hidden; 
for from that are its bondage and the opposite state.

**vi॰pra॰**—
**tu**-śabdaś śaṅkā-vyāvr̥ttyarthaḥ; 

**Thibaut**—
The _but_ sets the objection aside. 

**vi॰pra॰**—
**parābhidhyānāt** – parama-puruṣa-saṅkalpāt, 

**Thibaut**—
Owing to the wish of the highest, i.e. the Supreme Person, 

**vi॰pra॰**—
asya jīvasya svābhāvikaṁ rūpaṁ **tirōhitam**; 

**Thibaut**—
the essential nature of the individual soul is hidden. 

**vi॰pra॰**—
anādi-karma-paramparayā kr̥tāparādhasya hy asya  
svābhāvikaṁ kalyāṇa-rūpaṁ parama-puruṣas tirōdhāpayati; 

**Thibaut**—
The Supreme Person hides the true, essentially blessed, nature of the soul  
which is in a state of sin  
owing to the endless chain of karman. 

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
parasya nairghr̥ṇyādi-prasaṅga-parihāram āha - anādi-karmēti । 

###### bandha-mōkṣau
**vi॰pra॰**—
tataḥ tat-saṅkalpād ēva hi  
asya jīvasya bandha-mōkṣau śrutau

**Thibaut**—
For this reason we find it stated in Scripture that  
the bondage and release of the soul result from the wish of the Supreme Person only 

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
tata ityādi - tata iti vyākhyēyaṁ yadam,  
bandhasya tat-saṅkalpāyattatvē  
tad-antargatas tirōbhāvaś ca  
tat-saṅkalpa-kr̥ta iti siddham  

ity arthaḥ ॥ 4 ॥ 

**vi॰pra॰**—
> yadā hy ēvaiṣa  
ētasminn adr̥śyē 'nātmyē 'niruktē 'nilayanē  
'bhayaṁ pratiṣṭhāṁ vindatē  
atha sō 'bhayaṁ gatō bhavati।  

**Thibaut**—
> 'when he finds freedom from fear and rest in that invisible, incorporeal, undefined, unsupported; then he has gone to fearlessness '; 

**vi॰pra॰**—
> yadā hy ēvaiṣa ētasminn udaram antaraṁ kurutē  
atha tasya bhayaṁ bhavati (tai.āna.7.1)

**vi॰pra॰**—
> ēṣa hy ēvānandayāti (tai.āna.7.2)

**Thibaut**—
> 'for he alone causes blessedness'; 

**vi॰pra॰**—
> bhīṣā 'smād vātaḥ pavatē (tai.āna.8.1)

ityādiṣu ॥4॥

**Thibaut**—
> 'from fear of it the wind blows' (Taitt. Up. II, 7, 8).

##### dēhayōgāt

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
> kathaṁ bhagavat-saṅkalpasya tirōdhāyakatvaṁ  
prakr̥tēḥ karmaṇāṁ ca hi tirōdhāyakatvam 

ity-atrāha -

**vi॰pra॰**—
> **319. dēha-yōgād vā sō 'pi ॥ 3–2–5 ॥**

**Thibaut**—
> 5. Or that (results) also from connexion with the body.

**vi॰pra॰**—
sō 'pi tirōbhāvō **dēha-yōga**-dvārēṇa **vā** bhavati, 

**Thibaut**—
The obscuration of the soul's true nature results either from the soul's connexion with the body 

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
bhagavat-saṅkalpasya dvārabhūtaṁ prakr̥tyādikam ity arthaḥ,  

**vi॰pra॰**—
sūkṣmācic-chakti-yōga-dvārēṇa vā; 

**Thibaut**—
or from its connexion with the power of matter in a subtle state. 

**vi॰pra॰**—
sr̥ṣṭi-kālē dēhāvasthēnācid-vastunā saṁyōgād bhavati, 

**Thibaut**—
As long as the creation lasts, the soul is obscured by its connexion with matter in the form of a body; 

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
vā-śabdō na tulya-vikalpa-vācī,  
api tu vyavasthita-vikalpa-vācīty abhiprāyēṇāha - sr̥ṣṭi-kāla iti । 

**vi॰pra॰**—
pralaya-kālē  
nāma-rūpa-vibhāgānarhātisūkṣmācid-vastu-yōgāt । 

**Thibaut**—
at the time of a pralaya, on the other hand, by its connexion with matter of so exceedingly subtle a kind as not to admit of differentiation by means of name and form. 

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
sūkṣmācic-chakti-yōgēti - atra śakti-śabdēna bhagavad-apr̥thak-siddha-viśēṣaṇatvaṁ vivakṣitam,  
ēvam avāntara-sādhya-sādhanayōḥ parama-sādhyēnānvayaṁ darśayati ।  

##### nigamanam
**vi॰pra॰**—
atō 'nabhivyakta-svarūpatvāt  
svapnē jīvō na rathādīn saṅkalpa-mātrēṇa sraṣṭuṁ śaknōti ।

**Thibaut**—
As thus its true nature is not manifest,  
the soul is unable to create, in dreams, chariots, lotus tanks, and so on, by its mere wish. 

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
atō 'nabhivyaktētyādinā -  
"māyāmātram" iti sūtra-bhāṣyē  
parama-puruṣāsādhāraṇa-svabhāva-pratītēr iti saṅgrahēṇa uktam ।  

#### lōkāśraya-śrutiḥ
**vi॰pra॰**—
> tasmin lōkāś śritās sarvē  
tad u nātyēti kaścana (kaṭha.5.8)

**Thibaut**—
> ('in that all the worlds abide,  
and no one goes beyond it'--Ka. Up. II, 4, 9) 

**vi॰pra॰**—
iti  
sarvēṣu suptēṣu jāgaraṇaṁ  
sarva-lōkāśrayatvam ityādayō hi  
parama-puruṣasyaiva sambhavanti । 

**Thibaut**—
And what the texts say about a being  
that is awake in those who sleep  
and is the abode of all worlds 
can apply to the Supreme Person only. 

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
atra sarvēṣu suptēṣu jāgaraṇam ityādinā svabhāva-śabdārthō vivr̥taḥ, 

**vi॰pra॰**—
atō jīvānām alpālpa-karmānuguṇa-phalānubhavārthaṁ  
tāvan-mātra-kālāvasānān tad-ēkānubhāvyān arthān utpādayati ॥5॥

**Thibaut**—
The things seen by an individual soul in its dreams therefore are specially created by the Supreme Person,  
and are meant by him to be a retribution – whether reward or punishment – for deeds of minor importance:  
they therefore last for the time of the dream only,  
and are perceived by that one soul only.

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
īśvarēṇa kriyatē cēt-  
kim-artham asthira-rathādi-sr̥ṣṭir  
ity atrāha - ata iti ।  
alpālpa-karma-phalānubhavārtham asthira-tat-tad-vastu-sr̥ṣṭir ity arthaḥ ॥ 5 ॥

#### svapnasya śubhādyartha-sūcakatvataḥ jīva-sr̥ṣṭatvāyōgaḥ

**vi॰pra॰**—
> **320. sūcakaś ca hi śrutēr, ācakṣatē ca tad-vidaḥ ॥ 3–2–6 ॥**

**Thibaut**—
> 6. And it is suggestive, according to Scripture;  
this the experts also declare.

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
> jīvasya svāpna-sr̥ṣṭi-mātrōpayōgi-satya-saṅkalpatvādy-āvirbhāvas tadānīṁ syād 

iti śaṅkā-vyāvr̥ttyartham idaṁ sūtram,  

**śruta-prakāśikā - para-pakṣaḥ**—
parē tu-  
svāpnārthānām īśvara-sr̥ṣṭatayā viyad-ādivat pāramārthyaṁ pūrva-pakṣī kr̥tya  
dēśa-kāla-nimittair durnirūpatayā mithyātvaṁ siddhāntayanti।  
ēṣāṁ ca jīva-kartr̥tvam ēva "sr̥jata" ity ucyatē।  
tac caupacārikaṁ -  
sukha-duḥkha-darśana-nimitta--sukr̥ta-duṣkr̥ta-kartr̥tva-nibandhana aupacārikaḥ svāpnārtha-kartr̥tva-vyapadēśaḥ।  
"bahiṣ kulāyād amr̥taś caritvē"ti svāpna-viṣayā śrutiś ca  
bahir iva caritvēty ēvaṁ-parā,  
tasmin prakaraṇē īśvara-pratipādanaṁ jīvasya tad-ananyatvōpadēśārthaṁ  
sukha-duḥkha-sūcakatva-kr̥ta-pāramārthya-śaṅkā-vyudāsa-param  
"sūcakaś ca hi" iti sūtram।  
tac ca dvitīyaṁ sūcanīya-pāramārthyē 'pi  
sūcakaṁ strī-darśanādikaṁ mithyēti sūtra-abhiprāyaḥ ।  
īśvarād ananyatvēna jīvasya satya-saṅkalpatayā sraṣṭr̥tva-śaṅkāṁ vyudasyati  
"parābhidhyānāt tv" iti jīvasya jñānaiśvarya-śaktyādi-sarvam avidyā-tirōhitaṁ,  
tirōdhāna-nivr̥ttiḥ paramātmābhidhyānāt,  
asya bandha-mōkṣau hi paramātmādhīnau,  
sa ca tirōbhāvaḥ sūkṣma-sthūla-dēha-yōgād  
iti yōjayanti। 

**vi॰pra॰**—
itaś ca svāpnā arthā  
na jīva-saṅkalpa-pūrvakāḥ;  

**Thibaut**—
The things seen in dreams are not created by the wish of the individual soul for this reason also, 

**vi॰pra॰**—
yataḥ svapnō 'bhyudayānabhyudayayōs sūcakaḥ śrutēr avagamyatē

**Thibaut**—
that according to Scripture dreams are prophetic of future good or ill fortune. 

**vi॰pra॰**—
> yadā karmasu kāmyēṣu  
striyaṁ svapnēṣu paśyati  
samr̥ddhiṁ tatra jānīyāt  
tasmin svapna-nidarśanē॥ (chā.5-2-9)  

iti;

**Thibaut**—
> 'When a man engaged in some work undertaken for some special wish  
sees a woman in his dream,  
he may infer success from his dream vision.' 

**vi॰pra॰**—
> atha svapnē puruṣaṁ kr̥ṣṇaṁ kr̥ṣṇa-dantaṁ paśyati  
sa ēnaṁ hanti

ity-ādēś ca । 

**vi॰pra॰**—
svapnādhyāya-vidaś ca  
svapnaṁ śubhāśubhayōs sūcakam ācakṣatē । 

**Thibaut**—
Those also who understand the science of dreams teach that dreams foreshadow good and evil fortune. 

**śruta-prakāśikā**—
svapnādhyāya-vidaḥ- svapna-vāci-vēda-vākya-vidaḥ,  
ata ity adhikaraṇārthōpasaṁhāraḥ ।  

**vi॰pra॰**—
sūcakatvaṁ ca sva-saṅkalpāyattasya nōpapadyatē; 

**Thibaut**—
But that which depends on one's own wish can have no prophetic quality; 

**vi॰pra॰**—
tathā cāśubhasyāniṣṭatvāc chubhasya sūcakam ēva sr̥ṣṭvā paśyēt । +++(5)+++

**Thibaut**—
and as ill fortune is not desired the dreamer would create for himself only such visions as would indicate good fortune. 

**vi॰pra॰**—
ataḥ svapnē sr̥ṣṭir īśvarēṇaiva kr̥tā ॥6॥

**Thibaut**—
Hence the creation which takes place in dreams can be the Lord's work only.--

**vi॰pra॰**—
**iti śrī-śārīraka-mīmāṁsā-bhāṣyē sandhyādhikaraṇam ॥1॥**

**Thibaut**—
Here terminates the adhikaraṇa of 'the intermediate state.'

### 02 tadabhāvādhikaraṇam

**śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē tadabhāvādhikaraṇam॥2॥**

**adhikaraṇārthaḥ**—
jivātmanāṁ suṣuptau sthānāni hitākhyanāḍī – purītat – paramātmanastrayō'pi

**321. tadabhāvō nāḍīṣu tacchrutērātmani ca ॥ 3–2–7 ॥**

#### saṅgatiḥ viṣayanirdēśaśca

idānīṁ suṣuptisthānaṁ parīkṣyatē, idamāmnāyatē **atha yatraitatsuptassamastassamprasannaḥ svapnaṁ na vijānāti āsu tadā nāḍīṣu sr̥ptō bhavati** (chāṁ.8.3.3) iti; tathā
**atha yadā suṣuptō bhavati yadā na kasyacana vēda hitā nāma nāḍyō dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi hr̥dayātpurītatamabhipratiṣṭhantē tābhiḥ pratyavasr̥pya purītati śētē** (br̥.4.1.19) iti; tathā – **yatraitatpuruṣaḥ svapiti nāma satā sōmya tadā sampannō bhavati** (chā.6.8.1) iti। ēvaṁ nāḍyaḥ purītad brahma ca suṣuptisthānatvēna śrūyantē;

#### saṁśayaḥ pūrvapakṣaśca

kimēṣāṁ vikalpaḥ samuccayō vēti viśayē nirapēkṣatvapratītēḥ yugapadanēkasthānavr̥ttyasambhavācca vikalpaḥ-

#### siddhāntapradarśanaṁ sūtrataḥ

iti prāptē ucyatē – tadabhāva – iti। tadabhāvaḥ – svapnābhāvaḥ suṣuptiḥ nāḍīṣu purītatyātmani ca bhavati, ēṣāṁ sthānānāṁ samuccaya ityarthaḥ । kutaḥ? tacchrutēḥ trayāṇāṁ sthānatvaśrutēḥ । na ca kāryabhēdēna samuccayē sambhavati pākṣikabādhagarbhavikalpō nyāyyaḥ । sambhavati ca prāsādakhaṭvāparyaṅkavannāḍyādīnāṁ kāryabhēdaḥ। tatra nāḍīpurītatau prāsādakhaṭvāsthānīyau; brahma tu paryaṅkasthānīyam। atō brahmaiva sākṣātsuṣuptisthānam॥7॥

#### brahmaṇaḥ jīvaprabōdhāvadhisthānatā

**322. ataḥ prabōdhō'smāt ॥ 3–2–8 ॥**

yatō brahmaiva sākṣātsuṣuptisthānam, ataḥ asmāt – brahmaṇaḥ ēṣāṁ jīvānāṁ prabōdhaḥ śrūyamāṇa upapadyatē – **sata āgamya na viduḥ sata āgacchāmahē** (chā.6.10.2) ityādiṣu ॥8॥

**iti śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē tadabhāvādhikaraṇam॥2॥**

### 03 karmānusmr̥tiśabdavidhyadhikaraṇam

**śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē karmānusmr̥tiśabdavidhyadhikaraṇam॥3॥**

**adhikaraṇārthaḥ**—
jāgradavasthātaḥ suṣuptidaśāṁ prāpta ēva jīvaḥ prabudhyatē, nānyaḥ

**323. sa ēva tu karmānusmr̥tiśabdavidhibhyaḥ ॥ 3–2–9 ॥**

#### prakr̥tādhikaraṇīyaḥ saṁśayaḥ pūrvapakṣaśca

kiṁ suṣupta ēva prabōdha samayē uttiṣṭhati, utānya iti saṁśayē asya sakalōpādhivinirmuktasya brahmaṇi sampannasya muktādavilakṣaṇatvēna prācīnaśarīrēndriyādisambandhābhāvādanyaḥ – iti prāptē

#### siddhāntārthaḥ sūtrataḥ

ucyatē – sa ēva tu iti। tuśabdaḥ pakṣaṁ vyāvartayati; sa ēvōttiṣṭhati; kutaḥ? karmānusmr̥tiśabdavidhibhyaḥ। karma tāvat – suṣuptēna pūrvakr̥taṁ puṇyapāparūpaṁ tattvajñānātprāk tēnaiva bhōktavyam। anusmr̥tirapi ya ēvāhaṁ suptaḥ, sa ēva prabuddhō'smīti। śabdō'pi suṣuptaprabuddhassa ēvēti darśayati – **ta iha vyāghrō vā siṁhō vā vr̥kō vā varāhō vā kīṭō vā pataṅgō vā daṁśō vā maśakō vā yadyadbhavanti tadābhavanti** (chā.6.10.2) iti। vidhayaśca mōkṣārthāssuṣuptasya muktatvē'narthakāssyuḥ। nacāsau sarvōpādhivinirmukta āvirbhūtasvarūpaḥ – **tadyatraitatsuṣuptaḥ** (chā.8.11.2) iti suṣuptaṁ prakr̥tya **nāhaṁ khalvayamēvaṁ sampratyātmānaṁ jānātyayamahamasmīti nō ēvēmāni bhūtāni vināśamēvāpītō bhavati nāhamatra bhōgyaṁ paśyāmi** (chā.8.11.2) iti vacanāt । muktasya ca **paraṁ jyōtirusampadya svēna rūpēṇābhiniṣpadyatē** (chā.8.3.4) **sa tatra paryēti jakṣatkrīḍannamamāṇṇaḥ** (chā.8.12.3) **sa svarāḍbhavati tasya sarvēṣu lōkēṣu kāmacārō bhavati** (chā.7-25-2) **sarvaṁ hi paśyaḥ paśyati sarvamāpnōti sarvaśaḥ** (chā.7.26.2) iti sarvajñatvādi śrūyatē। atassuṣuptassaṁsarannēva āyastasarvakaraṇō jñānabhōgādyaśaktō viśramasthānaṁ paramātmānamupasampadyāśvastaḥ punarbhōgāyōttiṣṭhati॥9॥

**iti śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē karmānusmr̥tiśabdavidhyadhikaraṇam॥3॥**

### 04 mugdhādhikaraṇam

**śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē mugdhādhikaraṇam ॥4॥**

**adhikaraṇārthaḥ**—
dēhinō mūrcchāvasthāsvarūpanirṇayaḥ

**324. mugdhē'rdhasampattiḥ pariśēṣāt ॥ 3–2–10 ॥**

mugdhamadhikr̥tya cintyatē; kimiyaṁ mūrcchā suṣuptyādiṣvanyatamāvasthā, utāvasthāntaramiti viśayē suṣuptyādīnāmanyatamāvasthāyāmēva mūrcchāprasiddhyupattēḥ avasthāntara-kalpanē pramāṇābhāvādanyatamāvasthā –

#### sūtrārthavarṇanapūrvakaṁ siddhāntaḥ

iti prāptē ucyatē – mugdhē'rdhasampattiḥ iti। mugdhē puruṣē yā tasyāvasthā, sā maraṇāyārdhasampattiḥ। kutaḥ? pariśēṣāt – na tāvatsvapnajāgarau, jñānābhāvāt; nimittavairūpyādākāravairūpyācca na suṣuptimaraṇē। nimittaṁ hi mūrcchāyā abhighātādiḥ। pāriśēṣyānmaraṇāyārdhasampattirmūrchā । maraṇaṁ hi sarvaprāṇadēhasambandhōparatiḥ; sūkṣmaprāṇadēhasambandhāvasthitirmūrchā॥

**iti śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē mugdhādhikaraṇam॥ 4॥**

### 05 ubhayaliṅgādhikaraṇam

**śrīśārīrakamīmāṁsābhāṣyē ubhayaliṅgādhikaraṇam॥5॥**

**adhikaraṇārthaḥ**—
sarvatra vyāptimatyapi brahmaṇi nikhilahēyapratyanīkatā samastakalyāṇaguṇākaratā ca

#### saṅgatipradarśanam

**325. na sthānatō'pi parasyōbhayaliṅgaṁ sarvatra hi ॥ 3–2–11 ॥**

#### saṁśayapratipādanam

dōṣadarśanādvairāgyōdayāya jīvasyāvasthāviśēṣā nirūpitāḥ; idānīṁ brahmaprāptitr̥ṣṇājananāya prāpyasya brahmaṇō nirdōṣatvakalyāṇaguṇātmakatvapratipādanāyārabhatē।

tatra jāgarasvapnasuṣuptimugdhyutkrāntiṣu sthānēṣu tattatsthānaprayuktā jīvasya yē dōṣāḥ tē tadantaryāmiṇaḥ parasya brahmaṇō'pi tatra tatrāvasthitasya santi, nēti vicāryatē।

#### pūrvapakṣaḥ

##### adhikaraṇadvayārthanigamanam
kiṁ yuktam? santīti।  
kutaḥ? tattadavasthaśarīrē'vasthānāt।

##### śaṅkitasya dōṣasambandhasya ayōgākṣēpa-parihārau

nanu **sambhōgaprāptiriti cēnna vaiśēṣyāt** (śārī.1.2.8) **sthityadanābhyāṁ ca** (śārī.1.3.6) ityādiṣu parasyākarmavaśyatvēna dōṣābhāva uktaḥ, tatkathamakarmavaśyasya parasya brahmaṇastattatsthānasambandhāddōṣa ucyatē; 

itthamucyatē – karmāṇyapi dēhasambandhamāpādayantyapuruṣārthajananāni
bhavanti – iti **dēhayōgādvā** (śārī.3.2.5) ityatrōktam;  
tacca dēhasambandhasyāpuruṣārthatvēna bhavati;  
itarathā karmāṇyēva duḥkhaṁ janayiṣyanti; kiṁ dēhasambandhēna;  
atō'karmavaśyatvē satyapi nānāvidhāśucidēhasambandhō'puruṣārtha ēva;  
atastanniyamanārthaṁ svēcchayā tatpravēśē'pyapuruṣārthasambandhō'varjanīyaḥ;  
pūyaśōṇitādimajjanaṁ hi svēcchākāritamapyapuruṣārtha ēva ।

##### pūrvapakṣārthanigamanam

atō yadyapi jagadēkakāraṇaṁ sarvajñatvādikalyāṇaguṇākaraṁ ca brahma, tathāpi **yaḥ pr̥thivyāṁ tiṣṭhan** (br̥ha.5.7.3) **ya ātmani tiṣṭhan** (br̥ha.5-7-22) **yaścakṣuṣi tiṣṭhan** (br̥ha.5-7-18) **yō rētasi tiṣṭhan** (br̥ha.5.7.23) ityādivacanāt tatra tatrāvasthitasya tattatsambandharūpāpuruṣārthāssantīti॥

#### siddhāntārambhaḥ sūtrārthavivaraṇataḥ

ēvaṁ prāptē pracakṣmahē – na sthānatō'pi parasya – iti ।  

na pr̥thivyātmādisthānatō'pi parasya brahmaṇaḥ apuruṣārthagandhassambhavati ।

kutaḥ? ubhayaliṅgaṁ sarvatra hi – yataḥ sarvatra śrutismr̥tiṣu paraṁ brahma ubhayaliṅgam – ubhayalakṣaṇamabhidhīyatē, nirastanikhiladōṣatvakalyāṇaguṇākaratvalakṣaṇōpētamityarthaḥ। 

**apahatapāpmā vijarō vimr̥tyurviśōkō vijighatsō'pipāsassatyakāmaḥ satyasaṅkalpaḥ** (chā.8.1.5)  
**samastakalyāṇaguṇātmakō'sau svaśaktilēśāddhr̥tabhūtasargaḥ** (vi.pu.6.5.84)  
**tējōbalaiśvaryamahāvabōdha–suvīryaśaktyādiguṇaikarāśiḥ। paraḥ parāṇāṁ sakalā na yatra klēśādayassanti parāvarēśē** (vi.pu.6.5.85)  
**samastahēyarahitaṁ viṣṇvākhyaṁ paramaṁ padam** (vi.pu.2.22.53) 

ityādiśrutismr̥tibhyaḥ ubhayalakṣaṇaṁ hi brahmāvagatam ॥11॥

**326. bhēdāditi cēnna pratyēkamatadvacanāt ॥ 3–2–12 ॥**

yathā jīvasya prajāpativākyāvagatāpahatapāpmatvādyubhayaliṅgasyāpi dēvādidēhayōgarūpāvasthā-bhēdādapuruṣārthayōgaḥ, tathā'ntaryāmiṇaḥ parasyāpi svatō'pahatapāpmatvādyubhayaliṅgasya tattaddēvādiśarīrayōga-rūpāvasthābhēdādapuruṣārthayōgō'varjanīya iti cēt tanna, pratyēkamatadvacanāt –  
**yaḥ pr̥thivyāṁ tiṣṭhan** (br̥.5.7.3)  
**ya ātmani tiṣṭhan** (br̥ha.5.7.3)  
ityādiṣu pratiparyāyaṁ  
**sa ta ātmā'ntaryāmyamr̥taḥ** (br̥.5.7.3) ityantaryāmiṇō'mr̥tatvavacanēna tatra tatra svēcchayā niyamanaṁ kurvatastattatsambandhaprayuktāpuruṣārtha-pratiṣēdhāt ।  
jīvasya tu tatsvarūpaṁ tirōhitimiti **parābhidhyānāttu tirōhitam** (bra.sū.3.2.4) ityatrōktam।

#### apuruṣārthayōgasya karmāyattatvābhāvē'pi, vastusvabhāvāyattatvaśaṅkā-parihārau

nanu svēcchayā kurvatō'pi tattadvastusvabhāvāyattāpuruṣārthasambandhō'varjanīya ityuktam; naitadyuktam,  
nahyacidvastvapi svabhāvatō'puruṣārthasvarūpam; karmavaśyānāṁ tu karmasvabhāvānuguṇyēna paramapuruṣasaṅkalpādēkamēva vastu kālabhēdēna puruṣabhēdēna ca sukhāya duḥkhāya ca bhavati; vastusvarūpaprayuktē tu tādrūpyē sarvaṁ sarvadā sarvasya sukhāyaiva duḥkhāyaiva vā syāt; nacaivaṁ dr̥śyatē;  
tathācōktaṁ –  

> narakasvargasañjñē vai  
> pāpapuṇyē dvijōttama।  
> vastvēkamēva duḥkhāya  
> sukhāyērṣyāgamāya ca।  
> kōpāya ca yatastasmād  
> vastu vastvātmakaṁ kutaḥ।  
> 
> tadēva prītayē bhūtvā  
> punarduḥkhāya jāyatē।  
> tadēva kōpāya yataḥ  
> prasādāya ca jāyatē।  
> tasmādduḥkhātmakaṁ nāsti  
> na ca kiñcitsukhātmakam  
> 
> (vi.pu.2.6.46,47,48) 

iti ।

#### jīvaparavailakṣaṇyadr̥ḍhīkaraṇam

atō jīvasya karmavaśyatvāttattatkarmānuguṇyēna tattadvastusambandha ēvāpuruṣārthassyāt; parasya tu brahmaṇaḥ svādhīnasya sa ēva sambandhastattadvicitraniyamanarūpalīlārasāyaiva syāt॥12॥

#### brahmaṇi dēhādisambandhē'pi apuruṣārthāyōgaḥ śrutikaṇṭhōktaḥ

**327. api caivamēkē ॥ 3–2–13 ॥**

api ca ēkē śākhinaḥ ēkasminnēva dēhasaṁyōgē jīvasyāpuruṣārthaṁ parasya tu tadabhāvaṁ niyamanarūpaiśvaryāyattadīptiyōgaṁ ca svaśabdēnādhīyatē –  
**dvā suparṇā sayujā sakhāyā samānaṁ vr̥kṣaṁ pariṣasvajātē। tayōranyaḥ pippalaṁ svādvattyanaśnannanyō abhicākaśīti** (mu.3.1.1) iti ॥13॥

#### vidhi-niṣēdha-śāstra-paryavasāna-bhūmitvaṁ, dēva-manuṣyādīn prati paramātma-bhūtasyaivēti nāma-rūpa-vyākaraṇa-śrutitaḥ sidhyati, iti śaṅkā, tatparihāraśca

atha syāt – **anēna jīvēnā'tmanā'nupraviśya nāmarūpē vyākaravāṇi** (chā.6-3-2) iti brahmātmakajīvānupravēśapūrvakaṁ nāmarūpavyākaraṇamiti brahmaṇō'pi tadātmabhūtasya dēvamanuṣyādirūpatvaṁ tannāmabhāktvaṁ cāsti,  
tataśca brāhmaṇō yajēta ityādividhiniṣēdhaśāstragōcaratvēna karmavaśyatvamavarjanīyimiti; – tatrāha –

**328. arūpavadēva hi tatpradhānatvāt ॥ 3–2–14 ॥**

dēvādiśarīrānupravēśē tēna rūpēṇa yuktamapyarūpavadēva tat brahma rūparahitatulyamēva; jīvavaccharīritvanibandhanaṁ karmavaśyatvamasya na vidyata ityarthaḥ । kutaḥ? nirvāhakatvēna pradhānatvāt । **ākāśō ha vai nāmarūpayōrnirvahitā tē yadantarā tadbrahma** (chā.8.14.1) iti sarvānupravēśē'pi nāmarūpakāryāsparśēna nāmarūpayōrnirvōḍhr̥tvamēva brahmaṇaḥ pratipādayati।

#### tat-tad-antaryāmitva-kr̥ta--karma-vaśyatvāvaśyaṁ-bhāvākṣēpa-samādhānē

nanu taccharīrakatvēna tadantaryāmitvē kathamarūpavaditi rūpasambandharahitatulyatvamucyatē?  
itthaṁ – yathā jīvasya tattajjanyasukhaduḥkhabhāktvēna tatadrūpasambandhaḥ, tathā tadabhāvātparasyārūpavattvam। vidhiniṣēdhaśāstrāṇyapi karmavaśyamēvādhikurvanti; tasmādarūpatulyamēva paraṁ brahma।  
tataśca antaryāmirūpēṇāvasthitamapi brahma nirastanikhaladōṣatvakalyāṇaguṇākaratvarūpōbhayaliṅgamēva ॥14॥

#### brahmaṇa ubhayaliṅgatāyāḥ śrutyavagatanirviśēṣaprakāśarūpatvavirōdhaśaṅkā-tatparihārau

nanu ca **satyaṁ jñānamanantaṁ brahma** (tai.āna.1.1) ityādibhirnirviśēṣaprakāśaikasvarūpaṁ brahmāvagamyatē,  
anyattu sarvajñatvasatyasaṅkalpatvajagatkāraṇatvasarvāntarātmatvasatyakāmatvādikaṁ
**nēti nēti** (br̥.4.3.6) ityādibhiḥ pratiṣidhyamānatvēna mithyābhūtamityavagantavyam;  
tatkathaṁ kalyāṇaguṇākaratva-nirastanikhiladōṣatvarūpōbhayaliṅgatvaṁ brahmaṇi iti;  

**329. prakāśavaccāvaiyarthyāt ॥ 3–2–15 ॥**

yathā **satyaṁ jñānamanantaṁ brahma** (tai.āna.1.1) ityādivākyāvaiyarthyātprakāśasvarūpatvaṁ brahmaṇō'bhyupagamyatē; tathā satyasaṅkalpatvasarvajñatvajagatkāraṇatva sarvātmakatvanirastanikhila-avidyādidōṣatvādyabhidhāyivākyāvaiyarthyādubhayaliṅgamēva brahma ॥15॥

#### satyādivākyasya guṇaniṣēdhakatvābhāvaḥ

**330. āha ca tanmātram ॥ 3–2–16 ॥**

kiñca **satyaṁ jñānamanantam** (tai.āna.1.1) ityādivākyaṁ brahmaṇaḥ prakāśasvarūpatāmātraṁ pratipādayati, nānyatsatyasaṅkalpatvādikaṁ vākyāntarāvagataṁ niṣēdhati, **nēti nēti** (br̥.4.3.6) iti ca niṣēdhaviṣayō'nantaramēva vakṣyatē॥

#### guṇānāṁ śrutyādipratipannatvaspaṣṭīkaraṇam

**331. darśayati cāthō api smaryatē ॥ 3–2–17 ॥**

darśayati ca vēdāntagaṇaḥ kalyāṇaguṇākaratvaṁ nirastanikhiladōṣatvaṁ ca
**tamīśvarāṇāṁ paramaṁ mahēśvaraṁ taṁ daivatānāṁ paramaṁ ca daivatam। sa kāraṇaṁ karaṇādhipādhipō na cāsya kaścijjanitā na cādhipaḥ । na tasya kāryaṁ karaṇaṁ ca vidyatē na tatsamaścābhyadhikaśca dr̥śyatē। parā'sya śaktirvividhaiva śrūyatē svābhāvikī jñānabalakriyā ca** (śvē.6.7,8)  
**yassarvajñassarvavit yasya jñānamayaṁ tapaḥ** (mu.1.1.9)  
**bhīṣā'smādvātaḥ pavatē bhīṣōdēti sūryaḥ** (tai.ā.8.4)  
**sa ēkō brahmaṇa ānandaḥ** (tai.ā.8.4)  
**yatō vācō nivartantē, aprāpya manasā saha। ānandaṁ brahmaṇō vidvān na bibhēti kutaścanēti** (tai.ā.9.1)  
**niṣkalaṁ niṣkriyaṁ śāntaṁ niravadyaṁ nirañjanam** (śvē.6.19) ityādi । 

smaryatē ca **yō māmajamanādiṁ ca vētti lōkamahēśvaram** (bha.gī.10.3) **viṣṭabhyāhamidaṁ kr̥tsnamēkāṁśēna sthitō jagat** (bha.gī.10.42) **mayā'dhyakṣēṇa prakr̥tissūyatē sacarācaram। hētunā'nēna kauntēya jagaddhi parivartatē** (bha.gī.9.10)
**uttamaḥ puruṣastvanyaḥ paramātmētyudāhr̥taḥ। yō lōkatrayamāviśya bibhartyavyaya īśvaraḥ** (bha.gī.15.17)
**sarvajñassarvakr̥t sarvaśaktijñānabalarddhimān। anyūnaścāpyavr̥ddhiśca svādhīnō nādimānvaśī। klamatandrībhayakrōdha–kāmādibhirasaṁyutaḥ। niravadyaḥ paraḥ prāptērniradhiṣṭhō'kṣaraḥ kramaḥ** (vi.pu.5.1.47,48,49) ityādiḥ। atassarvatrāvasthitasyāpi brahmaṇa ubhayaliṅgatvāttattatsthānaprayuktā dōṣā na paraṁ brahma spr̥śanti ॥17॥

#### brahmaṇi sthāna-sambandhāyatta-dōṣa-bhāktvābhāvasya, śāstra-stha-jala-bimbita-sūryōpamāsaṅgatiḥ

**332. ata ēva cōpamā sūryakādivat ॥ 3–2–18 ॥**

yatō nānāvidhēṣu sthānēṣu sthitasyāpi parasya brahmaṇō na tatprayuktadōṣabhāktvam, ata ēva jaladarpaṇādipratibimbitasūryādivatparamātmā tatratatrāvasthitō'pi nirdōṣa iti śāstrēṣūpamā kriyatē –  
**ākāśamēkaṁ hi yathā ghaṭādiṣu pr̥thagbhavēt। tathātmaikō hyanēkasthō jalādhārēṣvivāṁśumān। ēka ēva hi bhūtātmā bhūtē bhūtē vyavasthitaḥ। ēkadhā bahudhā caiva dr̥śyatē jalacandravat** (yājñavalkya.3.144) ityādiṣu॥18॥

#### jalasūryadr̥ṣṭāntavaiṣamyaśaṅkā

atra cōdayati –

**333. ambuvadagrahaṇāttu na tathātvam ॥ 3–2–19 ॥**

tuśabdaścōdyaṁ dyōtayati।  
ambuvaditi saptamyantāt vatiḥ।  
ambudarpaṇādiṣu yathā sūryamukhādayō gr̥hyantē; na tathā pr̥thivyādiṣu sthānēṣu paramātmā gr̥hyatē । ambvādiṣu hi sūryādayō bhrāntyā tatrasthā iva gr̥hyantē, na paramārthatastatrasthāḥ ।  
iha tu **yaḥ pr̥thivyāṁ tiṣṭhan** (br̥.5.7.3) yō'psu tiṣṭhan (br̥ha.5.7.4) …. **ya ātmani tiṣṭhan** (br̥.5.7.22) ityēvamādinā paramārthata ēva paramātmā pr̥thivyādiṣu sthitō gr̥hyatē । atassūryādērambudarpaṇādiprayuktadōṣānanuṣaṅgastatratatra sthityabhāvādēva। atō na tathātvaṁ – dārṣṭāntikasya na dr̥ṣṭāntatulyatvamityarthaḥ ॥19॥

#### āpāditasya dr̥ṣṭāntavaiṣamyasya parihāraḥ

pariharati –

**334. vr̥ddhihrāsabhāktvamantarbhāvādubhayasāmañjasyādēvaṁ darśanācca ॥ 3–2–20 ॥**

pr̥thivyādisthānāntarbhāvātsthāninaḥ parasya brahmaṇaḥ svarūpatō guṇataśca pr̥thivyādisthānagata-vr̥ddhihrāsādidōṣabhāktvamātraṁ sūryādidr̥ṣṭāntēna nivartyatē। kathamidamavagamyatē? ubhayasāmañjasyādēvam – ubhayadr̥ṣṭāntasāmañjsyādēvamiti niścīyatē।  
ākāśamēkaṁ hi yathā ghaṭādiṣu pr̥thagbhavēt, **jaladhārēṣvivāṁśumān** (yājña.prāya.3.144) iti dōṣavatsvanēkēṣu vastuṣu vastutō'vasthitasya ākāśasya, vastutō'navasthitasyāṁśumataścōbhayasya dr̥ṣṭāntasyōpādānaṁ hi paramātmanaḥ pr̥thivyādigata-dōṣabhāktvanivartanamātrē pratipādyē samañjasaṁ bhavati । 
ghaṭakarakādiṣu yathā vr̥ddhihrāsabhākṣu pr̥thakpr̥thaksaṁyujyamānamapyākāśaṁ vr̥ddhihrāsādidōṣairna spr̥śyatē; yathā ca jalādhārēṣu viṣamēṣu dr̥śyamānō'ṁśumān tadgatavr̥ddhihrāsādibhirna spr̥śyatē; tathā'yaṁ paramātmā pr̥thivyādiṣu nānākārēṣvacētanēṣu cētanēṣu ca sthitastattadgatavr̥ddhihrāsādidōṣairasaṁspr̥ṣṭassarvatra vartamānō'pyēka ēva aspr̥ṣṭadōṣagandhaḥ kalyāṇaguṇākara ēva।

#### ubhayasāmañjasyaspaṣṭīkaraṇam

ētaduktaṁ bhavati – yathā jalādiṣu vastutō'navasthitasyāṁśumatō hētvabhāvājjalādi-dōṣānabhiṣvaṅgaḥ tathā pr̥thivyādiṣvavasthitasyāpi paramātmanō dōṣapratyanīkākāratayā dōṣahētvabhāvānna dōṣasambandhaḥ – iti।

#### dr̥ṣṭāntasya vivakṣitasāmyamātrē paryavasānam

darśanācca – dr̥śyatē caivaṁ sarvātmanā sādharmyābhāvē'pi vivakṣitāṁśasādharmyāddr̥ṣṭāntōpādānaṁ, siṁha iva māṇavaka ityādau। ataḥ svabhāvatō nirastanikhilājñānādidōṣagandhasya samastakalyāṇaguṇākarasya pr̥thivyādisthānatō'pi na dōṣasambhavaḥ ॥20॥

#### nēti nēti vākyād brahmaṇi sarva-viśēṣa-niṣēdhāt ubhaya-liṅgatvāsiddhi-śaṅkā--tat-parihārau

atha syāt – **dvē vāva brahmaṇō rūpē mūrtaṁ cāmūrtamēva ca** iti (br̥.4.3.1) iti prakr̥tya  
samastaṁ sthūlasūkṣmarūpaṁ prapañcaṁ brahmaṇō rūpatvēna parāmr̥śya  
**tasya ha vā ētasya puruṣasya rūpaṁ yathā māhārajanaṁ vāsaḥ** (br̥.4.3.6) ityādinā ākāraviśēṣaṁ cābhidhāya  
**athāta ādēśō nēti nēti na hyētasmāditi nētyanyatparamasti** (br̥.4.3.6) iti sarvaṁ prakr̥taṁ brahmaṇaḥ prakāramitiśabdēna parāmr̥śya  
tatsarvaṁ pratiṣidhya sarvaviśēṣādhiṣṭhānaṁ sanmātramēva brahma;  
viśēṣāstvēvaṁvidhaṁ svasvarūpamajānatā brahmaṇā kalpitā iti darśayati; ataḥ kathamubhayilaṅgatvaṁ brahmaṇa iti – atrāha –

**335. prakr̥taitāvattvaṁ hi pratiṣēdhati tatō bravīti ca bhūyaḥ ॥ 3–2–21 ॥**

naitadupapadyatē – yadbrahmaṇaḥ prakr̥tiviśēṣavattvaṁ **nēti nēti** (br̥.4.3.6) iti pratiṣidhyata – iti, tathā sati bhrāntijalpitāyamānatvāt । na hi brahmaṇō viśēṣaṇatayā pramāṇāntarāprajñātaṁ sarvaṁ tadviśēṣaṇatvēnōpadiśya punastadēvānunmattaḥ pratiṣēdhati । yadyapi nirdiśyamānēṣu kēcana padārthāḥ pramāṇāntaraprasiddhāḥ, tathāpi tēṣāṁ brahmaṇaḥ prakāratvamaprajñātamēva, itarēṣāṁ tu svarūpaṁ brahmaṇaḥ prakāratvaṁ cājñātam । atastēṣāmanuvādāsambhavādatraivōpadiśyantē।  
atastanniṣēdhō nōpapadyatē ।  
yasmād ēvaṁ  
tasmāt prakr̥taitāvattvaṁ brahmaṇaḥ pratiṣēdhatīdaṁ vākyam।  
yē brahmaṇō viśēṣāḥ prakr̥tāḥ tadviśiṣṭatayā brahmaṇaḥ pratīyamānēyattā **nēti nēti** (br̥.4.3.6) iti pratiṣidhyatē।  
nēti nēti – naivaṁ naivam, uktaprakāramātraviśiṣṭaṁ na bhavati brahma;  
uktaprakāraviśiṣṭatayā yā brahmaṇa iyattā prakr̥tā; sā'tra iti śabdēna parāmr̥śyata ityarthaḥ।  
yataśca niṣēdhānantaraṁ brahmaṇō bhūyō guṇajātaṁ bravīti, ataśca prakr̥taviśēṣaṇayōgitvamātraṁ brahmaṇaḥ pratiṣēdhati ।  
bravīti hi bhūyō guṇajātaṁ – na hyētasmāditi nētyanyatparamastyatha nāmadhēyaṁ satyasyasatyamiti **prāṇā vai satyaṁ tēṣāmēṣa satyam** (br̥.4.3.6) iti ।

#### ubhaya-vākya-śēṣasyārtha-viśadī-karaṇam

ayamarthaḥ – iti nēti yadbrahma pratipāditam, tasmādētasmādanyadvastu paraṁ nahyasti, brahmaṇō'nyat svarūpatō guṇataścōtkr̥ṣṭaṁ nāstītyarthaḥ।  
tasya ca brahmaṇaḥ satyasya satyamiti nāmadhēyam ।  
tasya ca nirvacanaṁ **prāṇā vai satyaṁ tēṣāmēva satyam** (br̥.4.3.6) iti। prāṇaśabdēna prāṇasāhacaryājjīvāḥ parāmr̥śyantē । tē tāvatsatyam, viyadādi-vatsvarūpānyathābhāvarūpapariṇāmābhāvāt। tēṣāmēṣa satyam – tēbhyō'pyēṣa paramapuruṣassatyam । jīvānāṁ karmānuguṇyēna jñānasaṅkōcavikāsau vidyētē; paramapuruṣasya tvapahatapāpmanastau na vidyētē; atastēbhyō'pyēṣa satyam।

#### sūtrārthōpasaṁhāraḥ

ataścaivaṁ vākyaśēṣōditaguṇajātayōgāt **nēti nēti** (br̥.4.3.6) iti brahmaṇassaviśēṣatvaṁ na pratiṣidhyatē; api tu pūrvaprakr̥tēyattāmātram।  
ata ubhayaliṅgamēva paraṁ brahma ॥21॥

#### brahma-tadguṇānāṁ pramāṇāntarāgōcaratā

brahmaṇaḥ pramāṇāntarāgōcaratvēna tatsambandhitayā mūrtāmūrtādirūpānuvādēna tanniṣēdhāsambhavāt prakr̥tēyattāpratiṣēdha uktaḥ; tadēva pramāṇāntarāgōcaratvaṁ draḍhayati –

**336. tadavyaktamāha hi ॥ 3–2–22 ॥**

tat – brahma pramāṇāntarēṇa na vyajyatē,  
āha hi śāstraṁ **na sandr̥śē tiṣṭhati rūpamasya na cakṣuṣā paśyati kaścanainam** (tai.nā.1.1)  
**na cakṣuṣā gr̥hyatē nāpi vācā** (mu.3.1.8) ityādi॥

#### nididhyāsanārthaṁ brahmōpadēśaparē vākyē anuvādakatvāyōgaḥ

hētvantaraṁ cāha –

**337. api saṁrādhanē pratyakṣānumānābhyām ॥ 3–2–23 ॥**

api ca saṁrādhanē – samyakprīṇanē bhaktirūpāpannē nididhyāsana ēvāsya sākṣātkāraḥ; nānyatrēti śrutismr̥tibhyāmavagamyatē।  
**nāyamātmā pravacanēna labhyō na mēdhayā na bahunā śrutēna। yamēvaiṣa vr̥ṇutē tēna labhyastasyaiṣa ātmā vivr̥ṇutē tanūṁ svām** (mu.3-2-3)  
jñānaprasādēna viśuddhasattvastatastu **taṁ paśyati niṣkalaṁ dhyāyamānaḥ** (mu.3.1.8) iti śrutiḥ ।  
smr̥tirapi **nāhaṁ vēdairna tapasā na dānēna na cējyayā** (bha.gī.11.53) **bhaktyā tvananyayā śakya ahamēvaṁvidhō'rjuna। jñātuṁ draṣṭuṁ ca tattvēna pravēṣṭuṁ ca parantapa** (bha.gī.11.54) iti।  
bhaktirūpāpannamēvōpāsanaṁ saṁrādhanam – tasya prīṇanamiti pūrvamēvōktam।  
atō nididhyāsanāya brahmasvarūpamupadiśat **dvē vāva brahmaṇaḥ** (br̥.4.3.1) ityādiśāstraṁ brahmaṇō mūrtāmūrtarūpadvayādiviśiṣṭatāṁ prāgasiddhāṁ nānuvadituṁ kṣamam ॥23॥

#### brahmaṇaḥ mūrtāmūrtādivaiśiṣṭyasya vāma-dēvādi-yōgi-pratyakṣa-gōcaratayā, niṣēdhasya prakr̥taitāvanmātra-viṣayatā

**338. prakāśādivaccāvaiśēṣyaṁ prakāśaśca karmaṇyabhyāsāt ॥ 3–2–24 ॥**
